JUSTTNZ/flying-tesla.readme:
# Flying Tesla

Standalone side-view web game. **Not part of Shopa.**

## ▶ Play now: **[justtnz.github.io/flying-tesla](https://justtnz.github.io/flying-tesla/)**

Runs in any modern browser on desktop or mobile, with nothing to install.

Your Tesla drives through a night-time city. Hop over traffic, switch lanes, flip in the air, grab nitro and gift boxes, and switch between side-on and racing-style camera views.

## Controls

| Action | Keyboard | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fly over traffic (2s hop, then a short cooldown) | Space | FLY button or tap |
| Change lane | ↑ / ↓ (or W / S) | ▲ ▼ buttons or swipe |
| Flip while in the air (tap = one flip, hold = keep flipping) | ← / → (or A / D) | ↺ ↻ |
| Change camera / POV (Side, Chase, Cinematic, Wide, Drone, Behind, Hood, Driver) | C | CAM button |
| Pause / play | P or Esc | PAUSE button |
| Tesla colour (white / black) | T | picker on the menu |
| Mute | M | SOUND button |
| Pick difficulty on the menu | 1 / 2 / 3 | Easy / Normal / Hard |
| Start / restart | Space or R | Start button |

## Rules

- Three lanes. Hitting a car in your lane while on the ground ends the run.
- Score grows with distance; each car you fly over gives +150.
- Flips: each full front flip or backflip landed gives +300. A flip only starts
  if there's time to finish it before touching down.
- Levels: every stretch of road is a new level with faster, denser traffic and
  a new sky (dusk, midnight, neon, dawn).
- Difficulty modes (Easy / Normal / Hard) change speed, cooldown and traffic
  density, and each keeps its own best score.
- Traffic is spaced so every lane is always survivable: cars are either a tight
  pack that one hop can clear, or far enough apart to land, recharge and hop
  again. Switching lanes gives you more ways out.

## Cameras and POVs

- **Side, Chase, Cinematic, Wide:** the side-on view at different zooms and angles.
- **Drone:** a floaty camera drone with a REC/timecode HUD.
- **Behind, Hood, Driver:** racing-game style views looking down the road
  (`js/forward.js` projects the same simulation into perspective). Driver adds
  the cabin, yoke and a Tesla-style centre screen; flips spin the whole view.

## Nitro and traffic

- Blue **N₂O canisters** sit in the lanes. Drive through one for 3.5s of nitro:
  faster, double points, and any car in your way gets smashed aside (+100).
  Protection lasts until you've landed and FLY has recharged after the boost.
- Drivers honk and lean out to shout ("Excuse me sir!", "Move out, I'm late
  for home!"), especially when you cut in or land in front of them.

- **Gift boxes** (black = Grok, white = Cursor, rare gold = +1,000) award
  in-game tokens, counted top-left and saved in a wallet across runs. Some
  float high and can only be grabbed while flying. Tokens are just for fun,
  not real Grok or Cursor credits.

## Drivers

Pick a driver on the menu (or press D): Elon Musk (2× Grok tokens), Jeff Bezos
(nitro lasts 1s longer), Sundar Pichai (more gift boxes), Jensen Huang (1.5×
flip bonus) or Steve Jobs (1.5× fly-over bonus). Portraits are freely
licensed photos from Wikimedia Commons (credits in
[`assets/drivers/CREDITS.md`](assets/drivers/CREDITS.md), and shown on the menu
for the selected driver); if a photo can't load, a drawn cartoon is used.

The game pauses itself when you switch tabs.

## The city

Billboards along the street advertise SpaceX, xAI, Grok, Starship and Grok
Bots; Grok Bot robots walk among the pedestrians (and talk back); and every so
often a Starship launches behind the skyline. Picture billboards use images in
`assets/` (see `IMAGE_ADS` in `js/billboards.js`); those files are not in the
repo, and the game shows drawn ads in their place when they're missing. This is fan homage: brand names
are styled text, not official logos, and the game is not affiliated with
Tesla, SpaceX or xAI.

## Sound

All sound is synthesized with the Web Audio API: car horns (cars also honk
when you cut in or land in front of them), pass-by whooshes, the Tesla's motor
and thrusters, city rumble, crowd murmur, and people chattering and cheering
(with speech bubbles) when you fly past.

## Code layout

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `js/main.js` | Entry point: DOM, keyboard/touch input, HUD, menu, game loop |
| `js/game.js` | State and simulation: lanes, flight and flips, traffic, levels, scoring, honks |
| `js/renderer.js` | Camera modes, level sky palettes, rocket launches, frame drawing, HiDPI sizing |
| `js/vehicles.js` | Car shapes (Tesla, sedan, hatch, SUV, van, pickup) and drawing |
| `js/skyline.js` | Three parallax building layers, pre-rendered offscreen |
| `js/street.js` | Pavements, lanes, trees, lamps, pedestrians, Grok Bots, speech bubbles |
| `js/billboards.js` | Roadside billboards: drawn ads and picture ads from `assets/` |
| `js/forward.js` | Behind / Hood / Driver forward views (perspective road) |
| `js/pov.js` | Driver cabin, hood and drone HUD overlays |
| `js/gifts.js` | Gift boxes that award tokens |
| `js/drivers.js` | Selectable drivers, perks and portraits |
| `js/splash.js` | Animated splash screen before the menu |
| `js/audio.js` | Web Audio: ambience beds and one-shot effects |
| `js/storage.js` | Best score per mode and preferences in localStorage |
| `js/config.js` | Tuning values, difficulty modes, cameras, scene layout |
| `js/utils.js` | Math, colour and canvas helpers |

# Forgotten Acorns

*A squirrel's year in four seasons. Every acorn you forget becomes a tree.*

ThunderHacks 2026 · Algoma Game Jam · Theme: **Four Seasons**

## Play it

No install or build step, and no internet connection needed.

- **Double-click `index.html`.** It runs in any modern browser with WebGL (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) on desktop, Android or iOS.
- **First time?** Pressing Play starts a one-minute guided tutorial. You can skip it, or replay it from the title screen.
- Or serve the folder with `python3 -m http.server` and open `http://localhost:8000`.
- To host it, push the folder to GitHub Pages, itch.io (HTML game) or Netlify. It's all static files.

| Action | Keyboard (remappable) | Gamepad | Touch |
|---|---|---|---|
| Move | ← → / A D | stick / d-pad | ◀ ▶ |
| Jump / swim | ↑ / W / Space | A | ▲ |
| Bury (Fall) / dig up and eat (Winter) | ↓ / S / E | X or B | ▼ |
| Pause | Esc / P | Start | II |

There are only three things to do: move, jump, bury/dig. You eat automatically. A line at the top of the screen always says what the current season wants from you.

## The idea

Real squirrels bury thousands of acorns and forget most of them. Those forgotten acorns plant oak forests.

1. **Fall:** acorns drop from the oaks. Grab them (your cheeks hold 5) and press ↓ to bury them.
2. **Winter:** nothing grows. Walk to your buried acorns (they poke out of the snow, and an arrow points to the nearest one) and press ↓ to dig one up and eat it.
3. **Spring:** every acorn you *didn't* dig up sprouts into a sapling.
4. **Summer:** eat berries. When a red ring appears under you, a hawk is about to dive, so stand under a tree. Saplings grow, and next **Fall** they drop acorns too.

So every winter you choose between eating an acorn now and letting it become a tree that feeds you next year. Keep the food bar from emptying and **survive three winters** to win, then keep going in endless mode if you like. A full game takes about 5 minutes.

## How the seasons change the rules

| | Food | Danger | Ground |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Spring** | mushrooms after the rain, a few berries | nothing, so it's a breather | the stream floods, so you swim |
| **Summer** | berries everywhere | hawks (hide under a tree); the sun makes you a little hungrier | the stream dries up |
| **Fall** | acorns fall from every grown oak | wind gusts push you | the stream is shallow |
| **Winter** | only what you buried | you get hungry faster | snow slows you, the stream freezes into slippery ice, and the ground is frozen so you can dig but not bury |

The changes between seasons are part of the game: geese honk a few seconds before winter, the first snow covers acorns you left on the ground, and the spring thaw turns buried acorns into saplings (only where there's room, so where you bury matters).

## Judging checklist

- **Playable loop:** a clear goal (3 snowflakes = 3 winters survived), a way to lose (hunger hits zero), a score, a win screen, endless mode and a best-score record.
- **Theme in the mechanics:** all four seasons play differently, choices in Fall carry into Winter and the next year, the yearly cycle has to be planned around, and movement and visibility change with the weather.
- **Consistent art & audio:** a **low-poly 3D diorama** with every model built in code: jittered, flat-shaded icosahedron foliage, faceted hills, pines, a hollow-stump den, the squirrel and the hawk. It has real lighting and shadows. Each season has its own palette and light that blend at the change, and winter is a dim, snowy night. All music and sound effects are synthesized live with the Web Audio API. Each season has its own generative score and ambience (spring rain and birds, summer cicadas, fall breeze, winter wind).
- **Runs on site:** plain HTML/JS with three.js bundled in the repo: no install, no network, no build. It also works offline from a USB stick.
- **Bonus: all four seasons play differently.** See the table above.
- **Bonus: season changes are gameplay.** Geese warning, first snow, spring sprouting, fall maturing.
- **Bonus: art and audio made during the event.** 100% of the art and sound is procedural code written for this game.
- **Bonus: accessibility:** only three controls, remappable, a colour-blind friendly mode (blue/orange cues plus shape markers on berries and hazards), Easy/Normal/Hard difficulty, reduce motion, picture hints on/off, separate music and sound volumes, gamepad and touch support.
- **Bonus: tutorial.** An 8-step guided first year (about a minute): move, jump, grab acorns, bury them, dig one up in winter, watch the rest sprout in spring, hide from a hawk. Each step waits until you actually do it, and a yellow arrow shows where to go. After that, a goal line and small picture bubbles keep reminding you what to do.

## Project layout

```
index.html        page, menus, touch controls
css/style.css     menu styling
vendor/three.min.js  three.js r128 (bundled so the game runs offline)
js/art.js         constants, palettes, 2D icons for the HUD and menus
js/audio.js       Web Audio synth: generative music, ambience, SFX
js/input.js       settings storage, remappable keyboard, gamepad, touch
js/sim.js         simulation: seasons, needs, caches, sprouting, creatures
js/world3d.js     low-poly 3D renderer: models, lighting, fog, particles
js/hud.js         2D overlay: needs bars, season wheel, hints, banners
js/tutorial.js    the guided first year
js/main.js        menus, settings UI, layout, game loop
```

## Credits & third-party assets

- Design, code, art and audio: made by the team during the jam.
- **three.js r128** (MIT license, © three.js authors) for 3D rendering, bundled in `vendor/` with its license. It's the only third-party code.
- No third-party art, sound or fonts. Every model, icon, sound and piece of music is generated by our code. Fonts are the system font stack (Trebuchet MS / Segoe UI / system-ui).
- Built with three.js (WebGL), HTML5 Canvas 2D for the HUD, and the Web Aud

# Nuzaim Learns 🔺🔢🐝🖍️

A playful learning web app for **3-year-olds**, built as a single `index.html` with no installs or build step.

It has 14 sections, each switchable between **Bangla and English**: Letters (all স্বরবর্ণ, ব্যঞ্জনবর্ণ, A–Z with tracing), Numbers (1–100 in Bangla, English and Roman numerals; নামতা 1–25), Think (shapes, colors, sizes, memory, patterns), Code, Draw, Science, Travel, World (196 countries: flag, capital, currency, leaders, parliament), Explore, Move, **My Body** (tap a drawn child or face to hear each part's name; find-it game; five senses; "Touch your…"), My Day (routines, brushing and handwashing timers, safety), Stories & Rhymes, and Seasons & Festivals. A grown-ups area (press and hold 3 seconds) has a daily time limit, a lock that keeps the child inside the app, and progress.

Instructions are read aloud using the phone's text-to-speech; Bangla needs a Bangla voice installed.

## Country facts

`tools/build_countries.py` runs on every build. It fetches capitals, leaders and parliaments from Wikidata and currencies from Unicode CLDR. A leader is shown only when two Wikidata records agree; otherwise the app says to check an official source. `tools/overrides.json` holds hand-verified corrections with sources; each one expires after 180 days or as soon as Wikidata agrees. The build's release notes include a report of every disagreement.

## Videos used

All videos are live-action (real people, real animals, real places), from public YouTube channels: Blippi, Ms Rachel, Danny Go!, Dream English Kids, Nat Geo Kids, Nat Geo Animals, Art for Kids Hub, EdThings and It Starts at Home. Some presenters use on-screen graphics, but there are no cartoon shows. Every build checks each video with YouTube's embed service (see the **Check every video** step in the build log), so a removed or non-embeddable video shows up there.

## Run it

- **Locally:** open `index.html` in any modern browser (phone or computer).
- **Online for free:** in this repo go to **Settings → Pages**, set *Source* to `main` branch, `/ (root)`, and save. The app will appear at `https://<your-username>.github.io/claude/`.

## For grown-ups

Short sessions (10–15 minutes) with an adult nearby work best at this age. Stars and coding-level progress are saved only in the browser on your device; nothing is sent anywhere.

## Android app (APK)

The `android/` folder wraps the app in an Android WebView. Every push to `main` runs the **Build Android APK** workflow, which builds `nuzaim-learns.apk` and attaches it to a new release under **Releases**. Download it on an Android phone, open it, and allow installing from this source when asked. The APK is signed with a development key, so it is for personal use, not the Play Store.

madisonho/rolleria.readme:
# Papa’s Cinnaboneria

A playable cinnamon-roll cooking game with four stations and 210 original, editable SVG assets. Run a four-customer shop day, earn tips, and reopen for another day with new recipes.

## Play locally

Requires Python 3.9+ to serve/build and Node.js 22+ to run tests. No dependency installation, API keys, accounts, or network services are needed.

```sh
npm run dev
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:4173/**. Alternatively run `python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1`. Use a server rather than opening HTML files directly: ES modules and the asset manifest require HTTP.

## How to play

1. **Order:** Take the customer's three-roll order. Each numbered recipe appears on the ticket.
2. **Dough:** Select each roll and drag its dough onto the board. Then work it by hand: drag the rolling pin up and down to flatten it, swipe the spatula to butter it edge to edge, shake filling over it, and push the bottom edge up to roll the log. Progress follows how much you cover. Each action button plays the same motion for keyboard players. Cut when the moving marker reaches the green zone.
3. **Bake:** Load all three rolls and pull the tray out between **17 and 23 seconds**. The oven continues while you switch stations. A burnt or underbaked batch can be rebaked before serving.
4. **Build:** Select a roll, choose its icing, drizzle, and topping, and apply each in three passes. Drag the ingredient onto the pastry or click Apply. Match every ingredient to the ticket.
5. **Serve:** Receive dough, baking, and decoration scores and tips. Serve all four regulars to finish the day. Next day retains your bank and generates fresh orders.

The game supports mouse, touch, and keyboard. Every required drag has a button equivalent. Use Tab and Enter for controls. Escape or Pause stops the clock. Help and switching browser tabs pause active cooking. Sound is optional and generated locally after enabling it.

Progress saves in this browser's local storage after actions and during cooking. Reloading offers Continue; time away never burns your rolls. Saves are local to this device/browser, not synchronized to GitHub or a server. Start fresh requires confirmation and replaces the saved game. If storage is blocked, the game remains playable in the open tab.

## Art kitchen

Open **/studio.html** or the “Art kitchen” link for the original four station previews and searchable SVG gallery. Compare expressions, preparation states, baking states, and decoration layers, or download individual SVG files and the manifest.

The gallery's explanatory text describes the artwork milestone; the playable game lives at `/`.

## Project structure

- `game-engine.js`: pure gameplay rules, state transitions, scoring, recipes, and validated save restoration.
- `game.js`, `game.css`, `index.html`: interactive game, pointer/keyboard controls, timers, sound, and responsive presentation.
- `dough-board.js`: the animated dough board. It turns pointer strokes into rolling, buttering, sprinkling, rolling-up and chopping animations, and calls the engine once per completed pass.
- `studio.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`: artwork gallery and inspection previews.
- `assets/`: 210 SVG files plus `manifest.json` with dimensions, anchors, families, and states.
- `scripts/draw_assets.py`: reproducible original SVG drawing source.
- `ART-DIRECTION.md`: drawing conventions and extension guide.
- `tests/game.test.js`: gameplay regression tests.

## Validate and build

```sh
npm test                  # gameplay rules and the complete SVG contract
node --check game.js      # browser-controller syntax
node --check dough-board.js
node --check app.js       # gallery syntax
npm run build             # validated static site in dist/
npm run assets            # regenerate artwork after editing its drawing source
```

`npm run build` also packages the source, artwork, tests, and documentation in `output/papas-cinnaboneria-starter-kit.zip`. The build validates both the source and production output, including the favicon referenced by both pages. Run these checks before pushing changes. Automated GitHub Actions configuration is not included because the current GitHub login does not grant workflow-write permission.

## Hosting

`dist/` is a portable static site; publish its contents using any static host. No backend is required. There is no deployment configured in this repository. The editable site icon is `public/favicon.svg`; verify it returns HTTP 200 in any deployed build before shipping to Vercel.

## Current scope

This version is a complete single-player shop-day loop with customers served sequentially. Simultaneous order queues, upgrades, cloud saves, and a soundtrack are future additions. Original characters and shapes were drawn for this project; supplied game screenshots are references and are not embedded assets.

DosPuppet/Pokecircle.readme:
# Pokecircle

Pokémon Trading Card Game (Standard format) in the browser: play against the AI or online against another player.
The interface and the cards are in French by default (English available).

- Rules engine in TypeScript, pure and deterministic (`packages/engine`), rules reference in `docs/rules.md`.
- Card data from [TCGdex](https://tcgdex.dev/) (`packages/cards`).
- AI opponent (`packages/ai`), online play server (`packages/server`), React interface (`packages/client`).

## Commands

```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # interface on http://localhost:5174
npm run server       # game server on :8788 (online play)
npm test             # unit tests
npm run verify -- --ci
```

Pokémon and its trademarks belong to their owners; this non-commercial project stores no card image (images are
loaded from TCGdex).

# Kitefall

Online competitive 3D kite-fighting for mobile – *"Read the wind, win the cross, cut the line."*

Unity 6 LTS · C# · URP (mobile) · New Input System · Android first (iOS-ready) · Unity Gaming Services

The game design is in [`docs/KITEFALL_GAME_SPEC.md`](docs/KITEFALL_GAME_SPEC.md) (single source of truth).

---

## What is in this repository

| Area | Status |
|---|---|
| **All 14 milestones** of spec section 16 | Code complete – see [`docs/MILESTONES.md`](docs/MILESTONES.md) for what each one contains and how it was verified |
| **Offline game** (tutorial, duels and FFA vs labelled bots, every menu, local economy, test ads/store) | Playable in the editor and on a phone right after setup |
| **Online** (accounts, server economy, leaderboards, online matches, ads, IAP) | Code complete; needs **your** Unity Cloud project, ad and store accounts → [`docs/ONLINE_SETUP.md`](docs/ONLINE_SETUP.md) |
| **Upgrade v1.4** | Animated characters, shoulder camera, wardrobe, squad lobby, warmup plaza, rooftop choice + roof hopping, launch ritual, emotes, quick chat + voice, training ground, new sky/kite shaders → [`docs/UPGRADE_TEST_GUIDE.md`](docs/UPGRADE_TEST_GUIDE.md) |
| **Tests** | 202 unit tests for the game rules (run in Unity or with `dotnet test Tools/CoreTests`) |
| **Server** | Cloud Code C# module `Server/KitefallEconomy` – the same rules run on the server |

Art and audio are original placeholders generated in code (kite shapes per class, skin patterns, rooftop cities, procedural sounds and music). Replace them with real assets whenever you like – nothing depends on files.

---

## Quick start (offline game, ~15 minutes)

Full step-by-step guide with screenshots-in-words: **[`docs/SETUP.md`](docs/SETUP.md)**. Short version:

Poori guide Roman Urdu mein (har cheez, shuru se Play Store tak): **[`docs/COMPLETE_SETUP_GUIDE.md`](docs/COMPLETE_SETUP_GUIDE.md)**

1. Install **Unity 6 LTS** with **Android Build Support** (Unity Hub ▸ Installs).
2. Get the code (git clone, or download the zip and extract).
3. Create a throw-away project from the **Universal 3D** template, close Unity, copy its `Packages/`, `ProjectSettings/` and `Assets/Settings/` (+ `Settings.meta`) into the Kitefall folder.
4. Unity Hub ▸ **Add project from disk** ▸ Kitefall. Make sure the **Input System** package is installed (answer **Yes** to the restart question).
5. Menu **Kitefall ▸ Build Game Scene (complete game)**.
6. Open `Assets/Scenes/Main.unity` and press **Play** ▶.

You go through: splash → login (Guest) → terms/age → name & country → 2-minute tutorial → first duel vs a practice opponent → Home.

| Action | Keyboard | Touch |
|---|---|---|
| Steer | WASD / arrows | Joystick (bottom left) |
| PULL (kheench) | hold Space | PULL |
| Release (dheel) | let go of Space | let go of PULL |
| REEL in | hold Left Shift | REEL |
| DIVE (ghotta) | Q / Left Ctrl | DIVE, or swipe down on the right |
| Menu / back | Esc | II button / Android back |

Run the tests: **Window ▸ General ▸ Test Runner ▸ EditMode ▸ Run All** (or `dotnet test Tools/CoreTests`).

---

## How it is built

```text
Assets/Scripts/
  Core/        Pure C# rules – no UnityEngine. Flight, tension, wind, tail rope, lines & contact,
               contest formula, attacks, rounds, all modes, bots, results "why", economy, ranks,
               ads policy, season pass, catalog, network codec. Runs unchanged on the server.
  Data/        ScriptableObjects (kites, dum, dor, charkhi, tunings, arenas, configs)
  App/         GameApp bootstrap, GameDatabase, AppFlow (player journey), tutorial
  Match/       Match sessions (offline / online), presenter, arena builder, kite/line/tail views,
               camera, effects, replay, showroom
  UI/          UI kit (built from code), HUD, every screen
  Services/    Backend interface + local backend, settings, audio, haptics, ads, IAP, analytics…
  Online/      Unity Gaming Services, Netcode/Relay sessions, LevelPlay, IAP, dedicated server
               (each part compiles only when its package is installed)
  Editor/      Kitefall menus: build scenes, create/reset data
Server/KitefallEconomy/   Cloud Code module (server economy, match reports, leaderboards)
Tools/CoreTests/          Runs the Core tests with plain .NET (also in GitHub Actions)
docs/                     Spec, setup, online setup, milestones, decisions, architecture, testing
```

Details: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · Assumptions and open questions: [`docs/DECISIONS.md`](docs/DECISIONS.md) · Play-test checklist: [`docs/TESTING.md`](docs/TESTING.md)

## Non-negotiable rules (spec section 0) – how the code keeps them
- **No pay-to-win:** the shop and pass only contain cosmetics; rarity never changes stats (`Core/Meta/Catalog.cs`).
- **Server authority:** every profile change goes through `EconomyCommands`; online it runs only in the Cloud Code module on protected Cloud Save data. Matches are simulated by the host / server; clients only send inputs.

frannunezrivera/holded-quest.desc: Tus finanzas de Holded convertidas en un videojuego: montañas de dinero, deudas en aviones de papel y minijuegos (Phaser 4 + Vite).
frannunezrivera/holded-quest.readme:
# Holded Quest 🐷💰

Tus finanzas de Holded convertidas en un mundo de videojuego. Pip, un cerdito-hucha, recorre un valle donde:

| Zona | Qué representa (Holded API v2) | Minijuego |
|---|---|---|
| **Montaña de Oro** | Cobros del periodo (`/v2/payments` de facturas de venta). Cada estrato es un mes y se puede escalar. | **Carrera a la Caja Fuerte**: atrapa el dinero que cae y llévalo en carretilla a la caja. Combos ×2…×5, cajas de IVA (−21 %), relojes e imanes. |
| **La Caja Fuerte** | Saldos de tesorería (`/v2/treasury/accounts`). | **Salón de Trofeos**: récords, logros y saldos. |
| **Puerto de Cobros** | Facturas de venta pendientes (`/v2/invoices?status=outstanding`). Cada globo es un cliente que te debe. | **Caza Globos**: engancha los globos antes de que se escapen. Al final, la lista de clientes a los que reclamar. |
| **Pico de las Deudas** | Facturas de compra pendientes (`/v2/purchases?status=outstanding`), en estratos por antigüedad (sin vencer → +90 días). | **Esquiva Deudas**: tus facturas son aviones de papel; las vencidas van más rápido y te persiguen. Los casi‑choques suman combo; las monedas de pago “pagan” el avión más cercano. |

Además: **Libro de cuentas** (tablas, filtros, gráficos por mes y por antigüedad), animación **“Desde tu última visita”** con lo que ha cambiado, XP y niveles, racha diaria, 13 logros, música chiptune y efectos procedurales, español/inglés, ratón, teclado y táctil.

Todo el arte y el sonido se generan por código: no hay ficheros de imagen ni audio.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Título](docs/screenshots/title.jpg) | ![Montaña de Oro](docs/screenshots/gold-mountain.jpg) |
| ![Puerto de Cobros](docs/screenshots/harbor.jpg) | ![Pico de las Deudas](docs/screenshots/debt-peak.jpg) |
| ![Carrera a la Caja Fuerte](docs/screenshots/vault-rush.jpg) | ![Libro de cuentas](docs/screenshots/ledger.jpg) |

El cielo sigue la hora real (día, atardecer, noche). Para previsualizar otra hora: `http://localhost:5173/?hour=12`.

## Arrancar

Requiere Node 22.12 o superior.

```bash
npm install
```

```bash
npm run dev
```

Abre http://localhost:5173 y elige **Jugar con datos demo** o **Conectar Holded**.

### Controles

| | Mundo | Minijuegos |
|---|---|---|
| Ratón / táctil | Clic en el suelo para andar (salta escalones solo), clic en carteles/edificios para entrar | Carretilla sigue al ratón · el cerdito vuela hacia el ratón y clic = esquive rápido · clic en un globo = gancho |
| Teclado | ←/→ o A/D andar · ↑/W/Espacio saltar · E/Enter entrar · L libro · M silencio · Esc menú | Flechas/WASD · Espacio = esquive / gancho · Esc pausa |

## Conectar tu cuenta de Holded

1. En Holded: **Configuración → API → Crear clave** (API v2).
2. Dale permisos **solo de lectura** para facturas de venta, compras, pagos y tesorería. Si falta alguno, esa zona aparece con un candado y el resto funciona.
3. En el juego: **Ajustes → Clave API de Holded → Guardar y cargar datos**.

Detalles importantes:

- **La clave nunca se guarda en ningún servidor.** Por defecto vive en `sessionStorage` (se borra al cerrar la pestaña); marca “Recordar en este dispositivo” para guardarla en `localStorage`.
- La API de Holded no permite llamadas desde el navegador (sin CORS), así que la app incluye un **proxy de solo lectura** (`server/holdedProxy.ts`): solo acepta `GET`, solo a rutas permitidas, y solo reenvía la cabecera `Authorization`.
- **Cuota de Holded**: hay planes con solo 500 llamadas al mes. Una actualización completa son ~4–8 llamadas. El juego abre siempre desde caché (IndexedDB) y solo vuelve a descargar si los datos tienen más de 12 h o si pulsas **Actualizar datos ahora**. Las llamadas restantes se muestran en Ajustes.
- Holded responde `403` tanto a una clave inválida como a un permiso que falta; si todas las zonas dan `403`, el juego te dice que revises la clave.
- La API v1 (cabecera `key`) deja de funcionar el 1 de julio de 2027; este proyecto usa la v2 (`Authorization: Bearer`).

## Desplegar (opcional)

El proyecto es un Vite estático más una función de Vercel (`api/holded.ts`) que reutiliza el mismo proxy.

```bash
npx vercel
```

Recomendado: activa **Deployment Protection** en Vercel para que la URL no sea un proxy público (sin clave no hace nada, pero mejor cerrarlo).

## Scripts

| Comando | Qué hace |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Servidor de desarrollo con el proxy en `/api/holded` |
| `npm test` | Tests (normalización, paginación, proxy, diff, progreso) |
| `npm run typecheck` | Comprobación de tipos |
| `npm run build` | Typecheck + build de producción en `dist/` |
| `npm run preview` | Sirve `dist/` con el proxy |

## Estructura

```
server/holdedProxy.ts   proxy GET-only con lista blanca (Vite dev/preview y Vercel)
api/holded.ts           función de Vercel
src/data/               cliente Holded v2, normalización, agregados, diff, demo, caché
src/game/scenes/        Boot, Title, World, Hud, VaultRush, DebtDodge, BalloonCatch, Results, Pause
src/game/art/           todo el arte, dibujado con Canvas 2D
src/audio/              efectos (ZzFX) y secuenciador chiptune (WebAudio)
src/ui/                 Libro de cuentas, Ajustes y Trofeos (DOM accesible)
tests/                  vitest + fixtures con la forma de la API v2
```

## Ideas para seguir

- Gráfico de tesorería con `/v2/treasury/accounts/{id}/bank-movements` (un río que sube y baja).
- Jefe final mensual: “El Trimestre del IVA”.
- Ranking entre socios con una base de datos compartida.

blake8086/escapement.desc: Prototype grid-only puzzle game in the spirit of Opus Magnum
blake8086/escapement.readme:
# Escapement

*Working title.* A prototype puzzle game in the spirit of Zachtronics' Opus Magnum, where everything happens on one grid. There's no instruction pane. The machine is the program: blocks slide across the board, and sensors, wires, and actuators decide where they go.

## Play

**[Play it in your browser](https://blake8086.github.io/escapement/)**, or open `docs/index.html` locally. It's a single self-contained page with no build step needed to play.

Seven levels build up from simple routing to wired logic. Each level has a "Load a solution" button with a reference machine you can watch run.

## Rules

- Blocks slide one cell per tick along their heading, and wait if the cell ahead is occupied.
- Two or more blocks entering the same cell crash, and head-on always crashes.
- **Static tiles:** filter (turns only blocks with its symbol), drain (removes blocks).
- **Sensors:** presence, kind, clock (alternates every tick), toggle (flips each time a block arrives).
- **Actuators:** redirect (turns blocks), gate (holds a block). An actuator with no wire is always on. Once wired, it acts only while lit.
- Wires run from sensors to actuators or pull emitters. Actuators react to what their sensors read on the previous tick.

## Controls

- **Place:** drag a part onto the board, or pick it and click a cell.
- **Move:** drag a placed part. Drop it off the board to remove it.
- **Wire:** click a sensor, then click actuators to connect them. Click an empty cell to stop.
- **Edit:** click a part. `R` rotates, `Del` or right-click removes.
- **Run:** `Space` plays, `←` `→` step one tick, `Ctrl+Z` undoes.

## Development

```
python3 build.py   # bundles src/ into docs/index.html
node test.js       # runs the simulation tests
```

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `src/sim.js` | The simulation: a pure, deterministic step function, plus the levels and their reference solutions |
| `src/ui.js` | Board rendering, editing, wiring, and the scrubber |
| `src/style.css` | Styles |
| `src/shell.html` | Page skeleton the build fills in |
| `test.js` | Checks that every reference solution wins, naive attempts fail, and the collision rules hold |
| `docs/index.html` | The built, playable page, published with GitHub Pages |

The simulation has no dependency on the UI, so `sim.js` runs in Node for testing. Every edit in the game re-runs the simulation from tick 0, which is what keeps the scrubber live.

jawsbaek/vr-poker-casino.readme:
# Monte Carlo VIP 3D / WebXR Poker Casino

Live deployment on Google Cloud Run: [https://vr-poker-casino-668276194475.asia-northeast3.run.app](https://vr-poker-casino-668276194475.asia-northeast3.run.app)  
Team: Jawsbar (`Sanghoon Baek`)  
Repository: [https://github.com/jawsbaek/vr-poker-casino](https://github.com/jawsbaek/vr-poker-casino)

## 1. Overview

Monte Carlo VIP is a 3D Texas Hold'em No-Limit 5-Max Sit & Go played at a private high-roller table. It is built with Three.js, WebXR (hand tracking on Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest), React 18, TypeScript, procedural 3D assets from Blender 5.2, and the Gemini media models through `@google/genai`. It runs on Google Cloud Run.

Most online poker is a flat 2D table with no one sitting at it. Here you sit with four 3D opponents and can read their body language:

- Opponents give physical tells. Bao (Seat #3) hunches over his phone scrolling short videos when his cards are weak or marginal; the screen throws cyan light on his face and you can hear the tinny speaker. When he has a monster hand he locks the phone and lays it flat on the mahogany rail (`🔥 Phone Down!`).
- Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (`gemini-3.8-flash-tts`) voices the dealer and the AI players, Lyria 3 (`lyria-3-clip-preview`) switches the soundtrack between lounge jazz and high-stakes tension, and Nano Banana (`gemini-3.1-flash-image`) draws the character portraits. Without an API key, a WebAudio and canvas synthesizer takes over, and the table still runs at 60 to 90 FPS.
- A GTO solver computes Monte Carlo equity, pot odds, stack-to-pot ratio (SPR) and a full $13 \times 13$ starting-hand matrix. It recommends either pure Nash equilibrium play (`pure_gto`) or a node-locked exploit (`exploit`), based on each opponent's VPIP/PFR/AF stats and physical tells.
- The HUD is obsidian and champagne gold and sits at the screen edges, so it never covers the dealer, the AI players or the board. Headless GPU Playwright runs check this with bounding-box audits (`npm run dogfood` and `npm run verify:ux`).

## 2. Features

### AI opponents and their tells

Four AI players sit outside the mahogany armrest, alongside the dealer. Their meshes are generated in Blender (`vip_dealer.glb`, `vip_ai_players.glb`, `vip_cards_and_chips.glb`, `vip_poker_table.glb`), and a `.usdz` export supports AR Quick Look on Apple Vision Pro.

| Seat | Persona | Archetype | Prop and tell |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Dealer | VIP Croupier | Professional | Gold silk bow tie; double-taps the felt before burning and dealing the flop, turn and river |
| Seat #1 | Viktor | Tight-aggressive shark | Glances at his gold wristwatch (`⌚ Checks Watch`) with high-equity value hands |
| Seat #2 | Elena | Ultra-tight rock | Sits upright with a champagne flute (`✨ Poised`) when she enters a pot strong |
| Seat #3 | Bao | Loose-passive calling station | Scrolls his phone (`📱 Scrolling`) with audible speaker leak on weak and medium hands; lays it flat on the rail (`🔥 Phone Down!`) on monster hands |
| Seat #4 | Marcus | Loose-aggressive maniac | Fidgets with his chip stack (`🎲 Chip Fidget`) when he runs a high-variance bluff |

### $13 \times 13$ GTO solver with node locking

The grid shows raise, call and fold frequencies for all 169 starting hands, from `AA` to `72o`. The exploit engine feeds observed tells (such as Bao's `phone_down_monster` or Marcus's `chip_fidget_bluff`) and HUD stats (`VPIP`, `PFR`, `3-Bet`, `AF`) into the calculation, then reports the expected value ($\text{EV}$) difference and grades each decision after you make it.

### Gemini audio and images (`@google/genai`)

`gemini-3.8-flash-tts` voices the croupier (`Aoede`) and the AI players (`Charon`, `Fenrir`, `Puck`, `Kore`). If it is unavailable, the game falls back to Web Speech and formant synthesis tuned per persona.

`lyria-3-clip-preview` plays late-night lounge jazz (`lounge_jazz`) and switches to a sub-bass showdown track (`high_stakes`) during all-in runouts or when a monster tell fires.

Casino sound effects are synthesized: a 14-flutter riffle shuffle, band-passed card slides on felt, clay chip clinks at several frequencies, double table knocks, and a fanfare at showdown.

### WebXR and Apple Vision Pro (`visionOS`)

`WebXRManager.ts` handles 25-joint hand tracking and ray input in one place. On Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest you look and pinch (`transient-pointer` gaze plus thumb-index pinch); on desktop you use the mouse.

At the table you drag chips into the gold betting ring to stage a bet, hold `Space` or drag a card corner to peel your hole cards, and double-tap the felt to check.

`/public/models/vip_poker_table.usdz` and `/public/models/vision_pro_ergonomics_report.json` open in visionOS Safari's AR Quick Look at 1:1 room scale.

## 3. System architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Client["Browser / WebXR Runtime (Desktop & Apple Vision Pro)"]
        UI["Sightline-Safe React 18 HUD\n(Outer-Edge Obsidian & Gold)"]
        Scene["Three.js 3D Casino Scene\n(PBR Mahogany, Felt, Spotlights)"]
        XR["WebXR Hand & Gaze Manager\n(25-Joint Pinch + AR QuickLook .USDZ)"]
        Engine["Texas Hold'em Poker Engine\n(5-Max SNG, Side Pots, All-In Runout)"]
        GTO["169-Hand GTO & Exploit Solver\n(Monte Carlo Equity + Tell Node-Lock)"]
        Audio["Spatial Casino Sound Engine\n(Foley SFX + Jazz/High-Stakes Sequencer)"]
    end

    subgraph Gemini["Google Gemini API (@google/genai)"]
        TTS["Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS\n(gemini-3.8-flash-tts)"]
        Lyria["Lyria 3 Music Generation\n(lyria-3-clip-preview)"]
        Nano["Nano Banana Image Gen\n(gemini-3.1-flash-image)"]
    end

    subgraph Cloud["Google Cloud Platform"]
        CloudRun["Google Cloud Run\n(asia-northeast3 Container)"]
        Docker["Multi-Stage Docker Build\n(Node 20 Alpine -> Nginx 1.27)"]
    end

    UI <--> Engine
    Engine <--> GTO
    Engine <--> Scene
    XR --> Scene
    Engine --> Audio
    Audio <--> TTS
    Audio <--> Lyria
    Scene <--> Nano
    Doc

Jankozeluh/Chiip.readme:
# Chiip

A tactical shooter in the spirit of Counter-Strike, with the look of a 1990s Quake-era game: you and your bot teammates against a team of bots, bomb rounds or team deathmatch, on three small maps. Play it alone against bots, or with friends online (they take the bots' places). Free, for Windows, macOS and Linux. **Created by JK · Divocakos.** Built with [Godot](https://godotengine.org) 4.7.2.

> **Version 0.1.1, the first public playtest** (0.1.0 with bullets that hit again). Website: <https://jankozeluh.github.io/Chiip/>. Expect rough edges; [docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md](docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md) lists the ones we know about. Tell us what you find.

## Download and run

Get the file for your system from the **[latest release](https://github.com/Jankozeluh/Chiip/releases/latest)** (the [website](https://jankozeluh.github.io/Chiip/download.html) offers the same buttons, and the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) lists what is new), unzip it anywhere and start Chiip. You need a computer that runs Vulkan games (any graphics card from the last eight years or so) on Windows 10 or newer, a Linux desktop (64-bit), or macOS 11 or newer (Apple silicon or Intel). The game is small and the look is retro, so it runs fast on modest machines.

The builds are **not signed** (a signing certificate costs money every year), so your system shows a warning the first time. That is expected, and this is how to get past it:

**Windows** (`Chiip-…-windows-x86_64.zip`): unzip it, double-click `Chiip.exe`. If Windows SmartScreen says *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The first time you host a game, Windows Firewall asks whether to allow Chiip: tick **Private networks** and allow it.

**macOS** (`Chiip-…-macos-universal.zip`): unzip it and drag `Chiip.app` to Applications (or anywhere). The first time, **right-click `Chiip.app` and choose Open**, then **Open** again in the dialog. On recent macOS versions that button may be missing; then open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down to *"Chiip was blocked"* and click **Open Anyway**. If macOS says the app *"is damaged"* (it isn't: it is the download's quarantine flag), clear it in Terminal and try again:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /path/to/Chiip.app
```

The first time you host a game, macOS asks whether Chiip may accept incoming connections: click **Allow**.

**Linux** (`Chiip-…-linux-x86_64.zip`): unzip it, make the file runnable, and start it:

```bash
chmod +x Chiip.x86_64
./Chiip.x86_64
```

If it doesn't start, run it from a terminal to see why; a missing Vulkan driver (Mesa's `mesa-vulkan-drivers`, or your graphics card's) is the usual reason.

**Check your download.** Each release has a file `SHA256SUMS.txt` with the SHA-256 checksum of every zip. In the folder with the zip and that file, on macOS or Linux, run `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing` (it should say *OK* for your zip); on Windows, `Get-FileHash .\Chiip-*-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256` in PowerShell and compare the hash with the line for your file.

Every download has the licences next to the game (`LICENSE`, `LICENSE-ASSETS`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`), and the game shows them under **Settings → Licences**.

## Playing

The main menu offers **Play**, **Practice**, **Settings**, **Quit**, and **Host** and **Join** for online games.

- **Play** opens the Play screen: **Team Deathmatch** (one click on its card starts the match), **Bomb** and **Practice** as cards, and under them **Custom**, the picked mode's options: the map (Depot, Square, Spillway, or the rotation of all three), team sizes (1 to 5 each, you included), the bots' difficulty (Easy, Normal, Hard), the match length and friendly fire. The game remembers your last choices.
- **Team Deathmatch** is respawning: first team to the kill limit (or the most kills when the time is up) wins.
- **Bomb** is CS-style rounds: one attacker carries the bomb; hold **E** inside site A or B to plant it, and defenders hold E next to it to defuse. A match is first to 5 rounds (sides swap at half time), with freeze time to buy (**B**), and money that carries over.
- At the start of a match a **class menu** offers two classes drawn for that match (Rifleman, Bulwark, Marksman, Scout), each with its own perk and loadout. **M** opens it again during freeze time.
- If you die in a round-based match you watch a teammate through their eyes (left click for the next one).
- **Practice** is the Shooting Range: targets at 5, 10, 20 and 40 m, a stand for every gun and grenade, and no bots until you add some with the console (`bot_add [easy|normal|hard] [ally|enemy]`).
- **Esc** opens the pause menu (Resume, Settings, Leave match). Online, the game doesn't pause.

# MVP Media: Las Vegas — The Underground Cut

**Play the full game:** serve this repository and open `/world/`, or use the landing page at `/`. The optional single-mission tutorial is `/world/?demo=1`. See [GRAPHICS.md](GRAPHICS.md) and [VELVET-BLOCK.md](VELVET-BLOCK.md) for the latest visual upgrades and verification limits.

Live game: https://mvp-velvet-hours.cocoakoala6.chatgpt.site/world/ (owner-private). This checkout includes the published artwork and local PBR texture files.

MVP Media's games, playable in the browser. No build step. **Read [GAME.md](GAME.md) for the full game guide [STORE.md](STORE.md) for the store page copy, and [CODE.md](CODE.md) for how the code works.**

| Folder | What it is |
|---|---|
| `world/` | The playable HD world: Las Vegas Blvd x Fremont Ave at night, third person, traffic and pedestrians, MVP Studios interior, starter mission with Ruby |
| `hd-demo/` | HD character demo (three r160): studio and pool sets, bloom, spring-bone physics (Off / Natural / Xtreme), photo mode, drag-and-drop `.glb` loading |
| `beyond-the-frame/` | MVP: Beyond the Frame, the 3D open-world prototype (desktop + iPhone touch controls) |
| `assets/characters/` | Finished characters (`mvp.glb`, `ruby.glb`) that the demo loads automatically; see its README |
| `uploads/` | Raw exports (FBX/GLB) waiting to be converted |
| `tools/optimize-character.sh` | FBX → GLB conversion and compression (meshopt + WebP) |

## Play it online (GitHub Pages)

Settings → Pages → Source: **Deploy from a branch** → Branch: `main`, folder `/ (root)` → Save.
After a minute the games are live at `https://mvpmedia00-commits.github.io/the-game/`.

## Run it locally

ES modules need a web server, so opening the file directly will not work:

```
npx --yes http-server@14.1.1 . -p 8080
```

Then open http://localhost:8080.

## Content

Mature themes, non-explicit. All characters are adults. If a character is modeled on a real person, get their written consent first.

# ♠ Fuat Morel

Klanın kendi Fun Run'ı. Tarayıcıda oynanan, 4 kişilik, eşyalı ve özel güçlü 2D engelli koşu yarışı.

**Oyna:** GitHub Pages açıldıktan sonra `https://KULLANICI_ADIN.github.io/fuat-morel/`

## Karakterler
Hepsinin hızı, zıplaması ve güç dolumu aynı; fark sadece görünüş ve özel güçte.

| Karakter | Özel güç |
|---|---|
| TAFTAF (kedi) | Gölge Atılımı |
| Caner (karga) | Kızıl Ay Kargaları |
| LUL (goril) | Goril Yumruğu |
| ertan (penguen) | Buz Kızağı |
| Kral (aslan) | Kral Kükremesi |
| Nuss (baykuş) | Tüy Süzülüşü |
| baso (ayı) | Bas Dalgası |

## Kontroller
- **Zıpla:** Boşluk / ↑ / W (havada tekrar bas: çift zıplama, duvarda basılı tut: tırmanma)
- **Kay / yere çakıl:** ↓ / S
- **Eşya:** E / Shift
- **Özel güç:** Q / F
- **Duraklat:** Esc / P
- Telefonda ekrandaki düğmeler (telefonu yan çevir).

## GitHub Pages'te yayınlama
1. github.com'da **New repository** → adı `fuat-morel` → **Public** → Create.
2. Bu klasörde:
   ```
   git remote add origin https://github.com/KULLANICI_ADIN/fuat-morel.git
   git push -u origin main
   ```
3. Repo sayfasında **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source: Deploy from a branch → Branch: main / (root) → Save**.
4. 1-2 dakika sonra oyun `https://KULLANICI_ADIN.github.io/fuat-morel/` adresinde açılır. Linki arkadaşlarına gönder.

İlerleme (altın, görevler, geliştirmeler) her oyuncunun kendi tarayıcısında saklanır.

## Geliştirici
- `node dev/sim.js 8 [mod] [tema|all] [yarışçı]` — oyun mantığını tarayıcısız simüle eder (ör. `node dev/sim.js 8 elim all 10`; mod: classic, elim, coins, pure, chaos; tema 0-7 ya da id).
- `node dev/deathloop.js 20 1000 [tema] [mod]` — ölüm döngüsü / bitiremeyen yarışçı avcısı.
- `node dev/shot.js "scene=race&t=8&theme=0" cikti.png 1280 720` — headless Chrome ile ekran görüntüsü (scene: race | podium | menu, theme: 0 orman, 1 şeker, 2 kar, 3 kale, 4 çöl, 5 uzay, 6 şehir, 7 tropik; mode=elim, n=10 gibi parametreler de olur).
- `node dev/net-test.js 1` — çok oyunculu ağ katmanını gerçek MQTT aracısına karşı sahte oyuncularla dener (0 EMQX, 1 Mosquitto, 2 HiveMQ, all).
- `node dev/net-browser.js` — oyunu headless Chrome'da ev sahibi yapıp node oyuncularla aynı odada dener.
- `node dev/mp-bots.js host 4 elim random 2 6 [--late=15] [--hostdrop=20] [--drop=16]` — node'da 4 gerçek istemci (çizimsiz) tam bir çok oyunculu maç oynar; sonuçların herkeste aynı olduğunu, uzak oyuncuların hareketini, olayları denetler. `node dev/mp-bots.js join KOD 3` — tarayıcıdaki odaya 3 "hayalet" oyuncu ekler.
- `node dev/mp-browser.js 0 classic 0 1 4 [klasör]` — iki headless Chrome (ev sahibi + katılan) aynı odada otomatik pilotla yarışır; iki ekranın görüntüsünü alır. 10 kişilik oda: `node dev/mp-browser.js 8 elim 0 1 10`; geç katılan izleyici: `node dev/mp-browser.js 1 classic 0 2 4 --late`.
- Tarayıcıda elle: `index.html?dev=1&mp=host&want=2` (iki kişi olunca başlar) ve `index.html?dev=1&mp=join&room=KOD`.
- Modül sözleşmesi: `docs/CONTRACT.md`; çok oyunculu tasarım, `FM.net` ve `FM.netgame` API'leri: `docs/MULTIPLAYER.md`.

0816559413zz-spec/Fantas-Stick.readme:
# ✦ Wizard Duel ✦

**▶ เล่นเลย: https://0816559413zz-spec.github.io/Fantas-Stick/**

เกมดวลเวทมนตร์ 3D มุมกล้องหลังไหล่แบบ Hogwarts Legacy — เล่นในเบราว์เซอร์ได้เลย ไม่ต้องติดตั้ง ทั้งเกมอยู่ในไฟล์ `index.html` ไฟล์เดียว

> โปรเจกต์แฟนเมดทำเล่นเองกับเพื่อน ไม่ได้ใช้เชิงพาณิชย์

## 🎮 โหมดเกม
- **Co-op ผ่านด่าน** (1–2 คน) — สู้ศัตรูเป็นคลื่นไปเรื่อยๆ เลือกพลังเสริมระหว่างด่าน บอสทุก 5 ด่าน
- **ดวล 1v1** — ชนะ 2 ใน 3 รอบ
- **FFA** (2–6 คน) — ใครได้ 10 kill ก่อนชนะ
- **ทีม 2v2 / 3v3** — ทีมไหนได้ 15 kill ก่อนชนะ

## 🗺️ แผนที่ (สุ่มทุกเกม)
- 🏰 **ลานปราสาท** — ยามค่ำคืน เทียนลอย คบเพลิง
- 🌲 **ป่ามืด** — ต้นไม้ หินโบราณ หิ่งห้อย และแมงมุมยักษ์!
- 🏟️ **สนามควิดดิช** — พระอาทิตย์ตก ห่วงประตู อัฒจันทร์ธงสีบ้าน

## 👫 เล่นกับเพื่อน
1. เปิดเกมที่ **https://0816559413zz-spec.github.io/Fantas-Stick/** ด้วย Chrome / Edge (หรือเปิดไฟล์ `index.html`)
2. คนหนึ่งกด **🏰 สร้างห้องออนไลน์** → ได้รหัสห้อง 5 ตัว
3. เพื่อนใส่รหัส → กด **🚪 เข้าร่วม**
4. โฮสต์เลือกโหมด → **▶ เริ่มเกม**
5. กด **เปิดไมค์** มุมซ้ายบน แล้ว **กด V ค้าง** เพื่อพูด

ต้องต่ออินเทอร์เน็ตตอนสร้าง/เข้าห้อง (ใช้ WebRTC ผ่าน PeerJS) — ข้อมูลเกมและเสียงวิ่งตรงระหว่างเครื่อง

## ⌨️ ปุ่มควบคุม
| ปุ่ม | ทำอะไร |
|---|---|
| คลิกที่จอ | ล็อกเมาส์ (Esc = ปล่อย) |
| WASD / เมาส์ | เดิน / หมุนกล้องและเล็ง |
| คลิกซ้าย | ยิงเวท |
| คลิกขวาค้าง | โล่ (ยกตอนโดนพอดี = Parry สะท้อนกลับ) |
| Q / E / R / F | ลูกไฟ / สตัน / ผลัก / ดึง |
| Space | หลบ (ตอนบิน = ขึ้น) |
| X | เวทโบราณ (เมื่อเกจเต็ม) |
| B / C | ขึ้น-ลงไม้กวาด / บินต่ำลง |
| Tab / V / M | ตารางคะแนน / พูดไมค์ / เปิดปิดเพลง |

## 🛠️ เทคโนโลยี
Three.js (3D + Bloom) • PeerJS (WebRTC multiplayer + voice) • Web Audio (เสียงและเพลงสังเคราะห์สด)

asivixlp44-cmyk/math-glass-bridge.readme:
# Math Glass Bridge

A Bloxity game built with Three.js and Colyseus. It is a clone of the Roblox game
"[Math Glass Bridge](https://www.roblox.com/games/106251887264209/Math-Glass-Bridge)" (reference video: `reference/Gameplay.mp4`).
It shares its engine with the other Legion games (server, Bloxity login and avatars, profiles, pets, effects).

## How it plays

- **A journey of 40 stages through space, in 4 worlds** of 10: **Space Station** (stages 1-10), **Candy Land** (11-20),
  **Ice Kingdom** (21-30) and **Lava Core** (31-40). Each world has its own glass colours, sky, fog, floating props and space dust.
  Stages get longer (8 rows on Stage 1, so the first clear takes under a minute, up to 29 on the last boss) and get more panes per row
  (2, then 3, 4 and 5). 668 questions in all, about an hour for a good player.
  The ramp is long and gentle on purpose: quick easy wins first, the hard math and the combined modifiers in Worlds 3 and 4.
  6 more world themes are ready (Jungle Temple, Deep Ocean, Desert Pyramids, Cyber City, Rainbow Galaxy, Golden Heaven):
  add worlds in `WORLD_IDS` in `shared/config.js` (and give the new stages modifiers in `STAGE_MODS`).
- **Every row is a math question.** It floats beside the row and sits in the banner at the top of the screen ("7 + 1 = ?").
  Each glass pane shows a number. Step on the right one: it lights up green, chimes and pays Cash.
  Step on the wrong one: the glass **shatters** and you fall into the void. No jumping on the glass.
- **Checkpoint islands** between the stages. Reaching one clears the stage (Cash chest + Wins) and saves your progress.
  Falling sends you back to the start of the stage you are on, never to the lobby. The lobby's **Continue** portal (and the
  "▶ Stage N" button under your Cash) take you straight back to your checkpoint; the Teleport panel lists every stage you have reached.
- **The math gets harder step by step** (a new level every 4 stages, the hardest from Stage 37), and the wrong numbers sit close
  to the answer: adding to 10; bigger sums and "biggest / smallest number"; times tables and missing numbers;
  division and "pick the EVEN number"; big sums and x12 tables; squares, percentages and two-step sums; order of operations and fractions;
  negatives, powers and roots; equations and big multiplication; then everything at the hardest. The wrong panes are the classic mistakes.
  Every run gets a fresh seed from the server, and no question repeats inside a run (`shared/questions.js`).
- **Stage modifiers** (`STAGE_MODS` in `shared/config.js`): World 1 brings them in one at a time between plain stages,
  combos start at the Stage 20 boss and fill Worlds 3 and 4:
  **Lights Out** (the glass only lights up right in front of you), **Crumbling Glass** (every pane breaks 2.4 s after you step on it
  in World 1, down to 1.6 s in World 4), **Shuffle** (the numbers swap panes every 2.6 s, down to 1.8 s), **Ghost Glass** (numbers only
  show in flashes) and **Time Limit** (15 s per row on Stage 6, down to 9 s by Stage 40, or the glass under you breaks).
  Every 10th stage is a longer **boss stage**; the last one is Lights Out + Shuffle + Time Limit with 5 panes.
- **Revive**: when you fall, a "Revive" button and a draining bar come up (like the reference). The first revive on every stage is FREE;
  after that a revive uses a Revive token (from Free! gifts and quests) or costs Bux (free with the **Infinite Revives** pass).
  Otherwise the stage starts over with new questions. Revive puts you back on the row before.
- **Rebirth** on the Golden Throne after Stage 40: back to Stage 1 with a permanent +50% Cash per rebirth (keeps everything else).
- **Cash per right answer** grows 25% per stage (15 on Stage 1, about 1K on Stage 20 and 90K on Stage 40), times your multipliers, plus a streak bonus
  (+5% per right answer in a row, up to +100%). Each stage's chest pays 4x its rows' Cash (12x on boss stages), plus 1 Win (5 on boss stages).
- **Top progress bar**: the 10 stages of the world you are in, with every player in that world on it.
- **Kill All / Show Path / Skip Stage** (Bux, top of the screen, like the reference):
  Kill All shatters the glass under every other player on a stage, Show Path turns the right panes gold (and the wrong ones dark),
  Skip Stage takes you straight to the next checkpoint.
- **Gears** in the hotbar (1-3): a free **Calculator** (a working pocket calculator, keyboard too), a **Speed Coil** ($12K, +35% speed)
  and a **Gravity Coil** ($30K, moon jumps, not on the glass).
- **Crates and pets**: Basic ($2.5K), Galaxy ($40K), Genius ($400K) and Mythic (Bux) crates at the CRATES stall. Eleven school-supply
  pets (Pencil Pup ... Infinity Kitty, plus the limited Golden Genius) follow you and multiply Cash. 3 slots (4 with VIP).
- **Trails** (x1.1 to x2.5 Cash), the **Lucky Wheel** (a free spin every 10 minutes of playtime, extra spins for Bux),
  the **Space Chest** (every 15 min) and the **Rainbow Stairs** parkour with a chest on top (every 10 min).
- **MATH RUSH**: the last 5 minutes of every 30 (server clock) are x2 Cash for everyone (a pill on the HUD counts down).
- **Friend Boost**: +10% Cash per Bloxity friend in your server (up to +50%).
- Free! gifts for playtime (1, 3, 5, 8, 11 minutes ... with big ones at 15, 30 and 60: Galaxy, Genius and Mythic crates; the HUD
  button counts down to the next one and pulses when one is ready), 7-day Daily Rewards, a quest chain (the first three are the tutorial, with guide arrows to Stage 1),
  redeem codes (`RELEASE`, `MATH`, `GLASS`, `BRIDGE`, `LEGION`, `BLOXITY`) and three leaderboards (Top Stage, Top Wins, Top Cash).
- Passes: **2x Cash**, **2x Speed**, **VIP** (x1.5 Cash, gold name, +1 pet slot), **Infinite Revives**, **Rainbow Trail**.

## Look and feel

- Deep space: a nebula sky tinted per world, twinkling stars, a ringed gas giant, a moon, spiral galaxies, drifting asteroids,
  shooting stars and a glow in the abyss under the glass. The lobby and

# 사건 게임 에디터 0.1.31

Android 8.0 이상용 세로 화면 제작 에디터. 인터넷 없이 실행합니다.

첫 화면에서 1 · 에디터 / 2 · 플레이를 고릅니다. 에디터 안에서 이야기 / 보유 항목 / 테스트 탭을 사용합니다.
위·아래 그림, 중앙 고정 대화창(너비 74%, 최대 높이 260 CSS px, 작은 화면은 화면 높이의 34%)을 사용합니다.
이름·대사·선택지는 같은 네모 안에 있고, 긴 내용은 네모 내부에서 스크롤합니다.

## 0.1.31 연출 적용 위치

연출 탭에서 [전체 · 위 그림 · 아래 그림]마다 연출을 따로 정합니다. 칸을 고르면 입자·색감·흔들림이 그 칸 안에서만 일어납니다. 미리보기는 불투명한 고정 띠에 들어가 스크롤 중에도 가리지 않습니다. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.31.md](RELEASE-v0.1.31.md).

## 0.1.30 연출 탭

사건마다 카메라 움직임, 분위기 색감, 날씨·입자, 겹침 효과, 그림 일렁임, 장면 전환, 순간 효과, 인물 겹치기를 고릅니다. 모두 기존 그림 위에 코드로 그려서 APK 용량이 거의 늘지 않습니다. 기본 프리셋 14개와 내 프리셋 저장을 제공합니다. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.30.md](RELEASE-v0.1.30.md).

## 0.1.29 투명도 100%는 그림만 · 음성/효과음 구분 · 세로 미리보기

플레이 중 투명도를 50%까지 올리면 창 바탕만 옅어집니다. 그 위로 올리면 글자·선택지·테두리도 함께 사라져서, 100%에서는 배경 그림과 흐린 투명도 막대만 남습니다. 사건 소리는 음성(대사를 넘기면 멈춤)과 효과음(끝까지 재생)으로 나눕니다. APK 창의 메인 화면 미리보기는 세로 비율이고, 고딕·누아르 테마의 시작 버튼은 색을 채웠습니다. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.29.md](RELEASE-v0.1.29.md).

## 0.1.28 휴대폰에서 불편한 부분 다듬기

휴대폰 화면으로 에디터·APK 내보내기·내보낸 게임을 점검해 찾은 30여 가지를 고쳤습니다. 더 보기 표시, 잠긴 선택지 이유, 모달 위 알림, 구체적인 오류 메시지, 키보드가 올라오면 아래 탭 숨기기, 44px 터치 영역 등. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.28.md](RELEASE-v0.1.28.md).

## 0.1.27 꽉 찬 앱 아이콘 · 4자 백업 암호

게임 APK 아이콘이 기기의 동그라미·둥근 사각형에 꽉 차게 들어갑니다(적응형 아이콘). 제작자 백업 암호는 4자 이상이면 됩니다. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.27.md](RELEASE-v0.1.27.md).

## 0.1.26 게임 APK 용량 줄이기

그림·소리가 많아도 게임 APK가 덜 커집니다. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.26.md](RELEASE-v0.1.26.md).

- 새 그림은 WebP로 저장(배경 한 장 약 2.6MB → 0.2MB). 기존 PNG·JPG 그림은 내보낼 때 WebP로 줄여 담습니다.
- WAV·FLAC 소리는 내보낼 때 Ogg Opus로 바꿉니다(약 10분의 1).
- 그림·소리는 `game.json` 안이 아니라 APK의 `assets/media/` 파일로 담고, 레트로 테마가 아니면 픽셀 글꼴을 뺍니다.
- 메인 화면·APK 창에서 담을 그림·소리 용량과 가장 큰 파일을 보여 주고, 저장 후 APK 크기를 알려 줍니다.

검증: `test-export-media-browser.cjs`.

## 0.1.25 테마·글꼴·글자 크기

UI 큰 틀은 유지하고 세부를 다듬었습니다. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.25.md](RELEASE-v0.1.25.md), 조사 근거는 [Theme-Research.md](Theme-Research.md).

- 글꼴: 고운바탕(바탕 본문)·Pretendard(이름·선택지·에디터)·갈무리14(레트로). 테마별 본문 글씨체, 어절 단위 줄바꿈.
- 선택지 15px 세미볼드의 누를 수 있는 줄, 둥근 조건 꼬리표, 장식 기호 대신 SVG 마커.
- 가방 → 글자 크기(작게·보통·크게).
- 멘탈 아이콘을 표정 얼굴로: 3 웃음 · 2 무표정 · 1 이하 찡그림.

검증: `test-typography-browser.cjs`(3개 모바일 크기).

## 0.1.24 대사 변주 · 기억

같은 사건이라도 지난 선택·보유 상태·방문 횟수에 따라 대사의 한두 문장과 선택지 하나만 달라지게 합니다. 자세한 내용은 [RELEASE-v0.1.24.md](RELEASE-v0.1.24.md), 참고 사례와 결정 근거(코드 언어 유지 포함)는 [Variations-Research.md](Variations-Research.md).

- **대사 변주 `{ }`**: `{용기? 들어간다|망설인다}`, `{!우산? 젖었다}`, `{돈>=2? …}`, `{처음|또|계속}`(방문마다), `{&아침|점심|저녁}`, `{~무작위|문구}`, `{@사건 이름? …}`, `{=돈}`. 대사·말하는 사람·선택지 문구에서 쓰고 겹쳐 쓸 수 있습니다.
- **내용 탭**: 문구를 선택하고 `＋ 조건` → 항목 고르기로 감쌉니다. 상태 칩을 눌러 같은 대사가 어떻게 바뀌는지 바로 보고, 대사 아래 선택지 목록에서 선택지를 고치고 추가합니다. 이 사건으로 오는 길로 이동합니다.
- **기억**: 가방에 보이지 않는 표시. 선택 결과 → 이 선택을 기억(버튼 한 번으로 만들기). 조건·대사 변주·숨김 선택지에 씁니다.
- **선택지**: 없을 때만 선택 가능, 안 맞으면 숨김.
- **보유 항목 → 이름 누르기**: 얻는 곳·쓰는 곳 모아 보기. 이름을 바꾸면 대사 속 참조도 함께 바뀝니다.
- **예제 · 같은 골목, 다른 밤**: 변주만으로 만든 8장면 예제를 한 번 추가합니다.
- 입력창의 오류 안내가 표시되지 않던 문제를 고쳤습니다.

검증: `test-variations.cjs`, `test-variations-browser.cjs`(3개 모바일 크기).

## 0.1.17 기본 그림·대체 문구

**이야기 → 그림 → 기본 그림·대체 문구**, 또는 **게임 관리(⋯) → 기본 그림·대체 문구**에서 이 게임의 위·아래 칸을 각각 설정합니다. 그림 선택/제거와 최대 300자 대체 문구를 입력하며 자동 저장합니다. 기본 그림도 없는 경우 대체 문구를 표시하고, 문구까지 비우면 조용히 빈 칸으로 표시합니다. 그림을 읽지 못한 경우에도 대체 문구를 표시합니다.

사건 그림이 기본 그림보다 우선합니다. 사건의 **기본 사용**은 해당 사건 그림을 지우고 게임의 기본 설정으로 돌아가며, **비우기**는 그림·대체 문구 모두 표시하지 않는 의도적인 빈 칸입니다. 위/아래 그림만 사용하거나 전체 그림 모드인 경우 사용하지 않는 칸에는 기본 문구도 표시하지 않습니다. 위치·크기 맞춤은 기존 사건 그림 조절을 그대로 사용합니다.

기존 게임의 `sampleImage`는 새 기본 설정을 만들기 전까지 기존 기본 그림으로 유지됩니다. 새로 설정한 칸의 그림을 제거하면 예제 사진이 다시 나타나지 않습니다. 기본 설정과 이미지 파일은 프로젝트에 포함하고 공유 이미지 저장/내보내기/되돌리기를 지원합니다. 편집 설정을 바꿔도 이미 저장된 플레이 버전과 진행을 덮어쓰지 않습니다. 플레이에 반영 후 새로 시작하면 변경된 기본 설정을 사용합니다.

검증: `test-default-art.cjs`, `test-default-art-browser.cjs`의 3개 모바일 크기에서 기본 그림 가져오기/제거, 위·아래 대체 문구, 미리보기와 플레이 일치, 기본 사용과 의도적 비우기, 자동 저장과 재시작, 플레이 버전 분리, 손상된 그림의 문구 처리, 고정 네모와 외부 스크롤 없음. 실제 안드로이드 기기 조작은 별도 확인 대상입니다.

## 0.1.16 이전 대화와 배경 보기

플레이/테스트의 고정 대화창 바로 아래에 **이전 대화 보기 / 배경 보기** 두 버튼을 붙였습니다. 대화창과 그림의 크기는 그대로이며 버튼은 대화창의 스크롤 영역 밖에 있습니다.

- **이전 대화 보기**: 화면 높이 전체를 사용하는 팝업에서 지나간 대사와 선택한 문구를 시간순으로 읽습니다. 가장 최근 대화의 시작 위치로 열리며, 팝업 내용만 세로 스크롤합니다. 닫기/뒤로가기 한 번으로 플레이에 돌아갑니다.
- 중앙 네모에는 현재 대화와 선택지만 표시합니다. 이전 대화를 위로 올려 찾을 필요가 없습니다. 사건/랜덤 인카운터를 넘어간 대화도 따로 기록하고 이어하기에서 복원합니다.
- **배경 보기**: 중앙 네모·상태줄·두 버튼을 숨기고 원래 위·아래 또는 전체 그림을 감상합니다. 그림을 터치하거나 뒤로가기/ESC를 누르면 같은 대화로 돌아옵니다. 타이핑/선택/대화창 스크롤 위치를 유지하고 게임을 진행하지 않습니다. 타이핑은 두 보기 화면에서 잠깐 멈추며 BGM은 계속 재생합니다. 대사 소리는 보기 화면을 열 때 정지합니다.
- 기존 버전은 이미 지난 사건의 대사를 버렸기 때문에, 기존 진행에서는 남아 있는 분기 기록만 이어받습니다. 기록 누락이 있는 경우 팝업에서 표시합니다. 새로운 진행은 첫 장면부터 기록하며 반복 플레이의 저장 증가를 막기 위해 가장 최근 1,000회 대화를 보관합니다.
- 획득 그림이 나타난 중에도 두 버튼을 쓸 수 있고, 배경 보기에서는 획득 연출을 정리합니다. 이후 선택이나 보상을 자동으로 받지 않습니다. 보기 상태 자체는 저장하지 않아서 앱을 다시 열면 대화창이 보입니다. 제작 데이터와 플레이 버전은 바꾸지 않습니다.

검증: `test-reading.cjs`의 사건 간 기록/이어하기/기존 저장 호환/되돌리기/재시작/보상 기록 검사, `test-reading-browser.cjs`의 3개 세로 모바일 크기에서 전체 높이 팝업·복귀·타이핑 일시 정지·그림 위치 유지·획득 중 보기·BGM 유지·고정 대화창·외부 스크롤 없음. 실제 안드로이드 기기 조작은 별도 확인 대상입니다.

## 0.1.15 랜덤 보상과 보유 효과

- **이야기 → 선택 결과 → 랜덤 보상**: 후보 체크, 공통 획득 수량 설정. 후보에서 최대 3종을 같은 확률로 중복 없이 뽑고 플레이어가 하나를 선택합니다. 후보가 1~2종이면 모두 표시합니다. 이미 보유한 항목도 후보이며 수량이 늘어납니다. 보상 선택은 기존 대화창 안에 표시합니다.
- **보유 항목 → 수정 → 보유 효과**: 기본 효과 하나, 선택적으로 조합 효과 하나. 체력·멘탈·돈 소모 감소와 회복/획득 증가 6종을 지원합니다. 조합은 다른 항목도 1개 이상 보유하면 적용합니다. 각 효과는 보유 중 한 번씩 적용하며 레벨/개수에 따라 배수로 늘어나거나 항목이 자동 소모되지 않습니다. 다른 항목의 효과는 합산하며 손실은 0 아래로 역전되지 않고 회복은 자원 최대치를 지킵니다.
- 조건 분기와 효과는 **선택 직전** 보유 상태에서 계산합니다. 방금 획득한 보호 효과는 이미 치른 체력 소모를 취소하지 않습니다. 할인 후 비용으로 구매 가능 여부를 판단하되, 별도 체력·돈 보유 조건은 그대로 필요합니다. 선택지에 효과 이름과 적용 전후 비용을 표시하고 가방에 효과 설명을 표시합니다.
- **선택 결과 → 자원 변화 → 보유 효과 적용 안 함**: 스토리상 고정 대가에 사용합니다. 기본 결과와 조건별 대체 결과 모두에 적용됩니다. 보상은 선택 결과의 자원·소모·고정 획득 처리 후 표시하고, 보상을 고른 뒤 지정한 다음 사건으로 갑니다. 사망 시 보상은 주지 않습니다. 보상 후보는 진행에 저장하여 이어하기 때 다시 뽑지 않습니다.
- 기존 이야기 점검 보강: 빈 보상 후보는 오류, 획득 항목의 사용처 없음·보유 효과가 적용될 자원 변화 없음·획득 후 사용 장면에 도달할 구조적 경로 없음·조합 상대의 획득 위치 없음은 경고. 분기 보유량과 랜덤 결과를 모두 증명하지 않는 보수적 구조 검사입니다.
- **2 · 플레이 → 랜덤 보상 예제 · 비가 그치기 전 → 비상 가방에서 남은 비상 물품 선택**. 보호 부적/흥정/차의 온기/붕대/간식 후보, 보호 부적 + 용기 조합을 사용합니다. 37장면·97선택지·14항목. 예전 예제의 수정본과 플레이 진행을 덮어쓰지 않고 새 예제를 한 번 추가합니다.

helico-tech/retro-sports.readme:
# RETRO SPORTS

*Greetings from Helico Island! Seven totally radical sports, 1992 style.*

A collection of 16-bit style sports games in Rust, in the spirit of
California Games, Ski or Die and Super Dodge Ball. Everything you see and
hear is generated in code: a 256x224 software framebuffer (SNES
resolution), pixel-art sprites built from skeleton poses, and a chiptune
synth. Walk the island and pick a game.

**Play in your browser: https://retro-sports.helico.app** (needs a
keyboard; sound starts after your first key press).

![Helico Island](docs/screenshots/island.png)

## The games
**DODGE OR DIE!** (dodgeball). 3 vs 3 on four courts, four crews, the five
D's of dodgeball, and a coach who throws wrenches when you fall behind.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Title](docs/screenshots/title.png) | ![Super shot](docs/screenshots/super-shot.png) |

**DISC DOGS!** (frisbee). You throw, your dog catches: leap and flip for
up to triple points. Mind the squirrel, the pond and the seagulls on the
pier.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Disc Dogs](docs/screenshots/discdogs-title.png) | ![Seagull'd](docs/screenshots/discdogs-gulled.png) |

**STALEN ZENUWEN!** (bike lifting). Your bike was stolen. Again. Take
one back on the Amsterdam canals: pick the lock, act casual, hide in the
krul, and throw your loot on Sjaak's boat before the BOA's write you a
fine. 2P: one steals, the other is the BOA.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Krul](docs/screenshots/zenuwen-krul.png) | ![Koningsdag](docs/screenshots/zenuwen-koningsdag.png) |

**TIENEN!** (street football). One goal, one keeper, and everybody
starts with ten points. Cross it, shoot it out of the air (a header takes
two, a bicycle kick five), never let it bounce into the goal, and whoever
hits exactly zero gets the billenbrand. Mind the cars and the poodle.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Header](docs/screenshots/tienen-header.png) | ![Billenbrand](docs/screenshots/tienen-billenbrand.png) |

**TEGENWIND!** (Dutch cycling). Holland's toughest bike race, against the
wind. Pedal in rhythm, tuck, draft, ring your bell at tourists, and try to
deliver the cheese. Oma Riek never stops pedalling.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Plons](docs/screenshots/tegenwind-plons.png) | ![Regenbui](docs/screenshots/tegenwind-shower.png) |

**TRAIL MIX!** (trail running). The ultra trail of Mount Helico: pace your
legs, jump roots, power hike with poles, glissade down the snow, and beat
Gerald the goat.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Shortcut](docs/screenshots/trailmix-shortcut.png) | ![Summit](docs/screenshots/trailmix-summit.png) |

**HANG TIME!** (hang gliding). Launch off the ramp, ride thermals and the
geese, fly through the balloon hoops, mind the storm cloud, and land on
the cross, not on the sheep.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Dunes](docs/screenshots/hangtime-dunes.png) | ![Storm](docs/screenshots/hangtime-storm.png) |

Every game has a 1P ladder against the CPU (with continues) and a 2P mode.

## Controls
| | Player 1 | Player 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Move | Arrows | W A S D |
| A (throw, ring, grab, shoot) | Z or `,` | F |
| B (jump, hop, flare) | X or `.` | G |
| C (pass, tuck, floater, cross) | C or `/` | H |
| Start / pause | Enter | Tab |

- On the island: arrows walk, Z or Enter plays.
- Esc goes back to the game's title, then to the island (and quits from
  the island, except in the browser). F1 toggles scanlines.
- Each game shows its own controls on its intro cards.

## Download
Get the latest build from the [Releases](../../releases) page.

- **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel): unzip `RetroSports-macos.zip` and
  open `Retro Sports.app`. The app is not signed by Apple, so the first
  time right-click it and choose *Open*, or run
  `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "Retro Sports.app"`.
- **Windows** (x86_64): unzip `retro-sports-windows-x86_64.zip` and run
  `retro-sports.exe`. Windows SmartScreen may warn because the exe is not
  signed: choose *More info* and then *Run anyway*.
- **Linux** (x86_64): unpack `retro-sports-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` and run
  `./retro-sports`. Needs OpenGL, X11 and ALSA (present on most desktops).

## Build from source
```sh
cargo run --release
```
On Linux you need `libasound2-dev libx11-dev libxi-dev libgl1-mesa-dev`.
On Windows the release build has no console window, so run the developer
tools below from a debug build to see output.

Browser version: `web/build.sh` builds it into `dist/` (needs
`rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown`). Serve it with
`python3 -m http.server -d dist` and open http://localhost:8000.

Developer tools, no window needed:
- `cargo run --release -- --shots <dir> [game]` renders screenshots of
  every screen of every game (or one game, or `hub`).
- `cargo run --release -- --sim <game> [n]` prints CPU-vs-CPU balance
  stats; `--probe <game> [n]` plays scripted "human" bots against the CPU
  ladder to find exploits. Games: `dodgeball`, `discdogs`, `zenuwen`,
  `tienen`, `tegenwind`, `trailmix`, `hangtime`.

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)
and [docs/house-style.md](docs/house-style.md) for how it is built.

stavell/xctracer-display.readme:
# Paragliding vario display

A handheld, portrait display for an XC Tracer Mini III GPS vario. The box is a Bluetooth LE central: it
connects to the tracer, reads its `$XCTRC` text lines (about 3 per second) and draws speed, glide ratio,
altitude, vertical speed, a Garmin-style compass dial, a wind estimate and a thermal map on a 2.7" Sharp
memory LCD (240x400 in use). It is also a BLE peripheral (`SharpDisplay`) so a laptop can set options,
replay a recorded flight into it and, in a legacy mode, draw frames. One user switch operates it.
Hardware: Adafruit Feather nRF52840 Sense, LiPo, PlatformIO with the Arduino framework.

- `NOTES.md`: measurements, findings and the open-items list.
- `PLAN.md`: the current review and improvement plan.
- `docs/MATH.md`: the maths: wind circle fit and Kalman filter, wind and temperature profile,
  thermal memory, home, tilt-compensated compass and calibration, heading smoothing, dithering.
- `CLAUDE.md`: rules for contributors and AI agents (layering, stack limit, how to check).
- `case/`: the 3D-printed enclosure (CadQuery model, STL/STEP, previews); see `case/README.md`.
  Screwless (clips and pegs only), prints without supports on a Bambu A1 in PETG; D-pad + A/B below
  the portrait screen, flat back for a velcro sticker, strap tunnel, swappable plain lid.

| Front | Back | Inside |
|---|---|---|
| ![Front](case/preview_front.png) | ![Back](case/preview_iso_back.png) | ![Open](case/preview_open_iso.png) |

## Screens

Rendered by the PC emulator from the same drawing code that runs on the device (2x scale).

![Screens overview](docs/screens/overview.png)

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| ![Compass](docs/screens/live.png) | ![Thermal](docs/screens/thermal_memory.png) | ![Profile](docs/screens/profile_inversion.png) | ![Home](docs/screens/home.png) |
| **Compass**: speed, glide, altitude, climb, heading-up dial (GPS track or magnetic), wind | **Thermal**: heading-up map of the recent track in the air-mass frame, remembered thermals with their climb | **Profile**: wind and temperature by altitude, inversion band shaded | **Home**: direction and distance home, required glide ratio, arrival height |
| ![Standalone](docs/screens/standalone.png) | ![Vario menu](docs/screens/list.png) | ![Calibration](docs/screens/calibrate.png) | ![Status](docs/screens/status.png) |
| **Standalone**: no tracer connected, the box is a compass with temperature and humidity | **Vario menu**: pick the tracer, sorted by signal (and Home, in the box image) | **Compass calibration**: turn the box until the bars fill (Settings app) | **Status**: connecting / waiting for data |

| ![Vario with AGL](docs/screens/live_agl.png) | ![Map](docs/screens/map.png) | ![Map, mountains](docs/screens/map_mountains.png) | |
|---|---|---|---|
| **AGL** (bottom right) with a map pack: GNSS altitude minus the terrain model | **Map** (after Thermal, only with a pack): north-up relief, contours, main roads, towns, track | The same over mountains (Stara Planina, test fixture) | |

**Centring page** (after Thermal): heading up, your newest turn in the middle, drawn thick where it climbed (the lift sectors; the bead is
the best of the turn), the core of the thermal as a target with a fat arrow from your circle's centre to it (its length is the distance to move the
circle), dotted rings at 25 and 50 m, the climb now as a number, a gauge (bar = turn average, diamond = best of the turn, triangle = now),
the lean of the thermal as an arrow, the trend of the lift as a glyph, and strength by height as bars on the right. No words. It needs two full turns of
circling. ![Centring page](docs/screens/center_cue.png) ![Sequence](docs/screens/center_sequence.png)

Grey tones are an 8x8 ordered dither on the 1-bit panel.

### Terrain (map pack)

With a map pack (`host/terrain/mkmappack.py`, format in `host/terrain/FORMAT.md`; Bulgaria is 1.72 MB: Copernicus GLO-90 heights
on a 200 m grid, towns and main roads from OpenStreetMap) the vario shows **AGL** (bottom right of every page; the GNSS altitude of
the tracer minus the terrain model under the fix, `--` without a fix or outside the pack) and a **map page** after the thermal page.
AGL comes from a model: typically +-10 m, up to 80 m at single peaks and gorges, and it includes trees and buildings (a surface
model). It is not the baro altitude. The map page is north-up at 100 m/px (22 x 38 km), light hillshade, contours (every 200 m,
every 5th bolder), main roads, towns (Latin names), the track of the last 20 minutes and the pilot arrow. For the first 10 s on
the page it shows the attribution: Map (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Copernicus DEM (c) DLR / Airbus, provided under
COPERNICUS by the EU and ESA. Without a pack nothing changes. The device has no pack reader yet (QSPI driver is the next step);
on the PC: `firmware/emu/build.sh play box --igc f.igc --pack bulgaria.pack` (default: the study pack if present, else the Sopot test fixture).

## Under the hood: what we are proud of

- **A game-grade 1-bit renderer on a 64 MHz microcontroller.** `firmware/src/platform/gfx/` draws straight into
  the panel's native frame buffer in whole bytes and spans instead of Adafruit_GFX's one virtual call
  per pixel. The busiest frame (thermal map, 3 minutes of track, four big numbers) went from
  **103 ms to 5-6 ms**; a 100x20 filled rectangle from 4.6 ms to 0.08 ms. The output is tested to be
  bit-identical to the library's, in all four rotations.
- **Fast text.** Fonts are pre-rotated at boot into glyph atlases laid out in the panel's native byte
  order, so a glyph is a byte copy: "1234" in a 24 pt bold font draws in 0.33 ms instead of 2.8 ms
  (22 KB of RAM for four fonts).
- **Grey on a black-and-white screen.** 17 grey levels from an 8x8 ordered (Bayer) dither anchored to
  the screen, used for the compass ring, the older track, thermal discs and the inversion band; a host
  tool converts images into 4-bit sprites.
- **The panel transfer runs in the background.** Cha

# JS30 — Learn JavaScript in 30 Days

[![Open the course](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20the%20course-dromaia.github.io%2FJavaScript-F2D21B?style=for-the-badge)](https://dromaia.github.io/JavaScript/)

**A free, 30-day JavaScript course for beginners that runs entirely in the browser.** No installation, no account:
open the link and write real JavaScript on Day 1. By Day 30 you build your own interactive web app.

👉 **Start here: <https://dromaia.github.io/JavaScript/>**

---

## What you get every day

- A short explanation with runnable examples and a **live code editor**
- A step-by-step **visualizer** that shows each variable in its box as the code runs
- Quick checks and **"Your turn"** questions (type the answer, then check or reveal)
- Guided practice: predict the output, put the lines in order, break things on purpose
- **Auto-checked problems** (🌱 ⭐ 🔥) with several model solutions
- A quiz, a puzzle, spaced-repetition review cards and a place for your notes
- **Points, levels and badges** to keep you going

Plus a free **playground** (JavaScript or a full web page), a **glossary**, printable **weekly cheat sheets**,
and a personal **certificate** after Day 30.

## The 30-day plan

| Week | Theme | Topics |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | First steps | `console.log`, variables and naming rules, data types, numbers and operators, `++`/`--`, strings and template literals |
| 2 | Decisions and loops | comparisons and logic, `if`/`else`, `switch`, `while`, `for`, a number guessing game |
| 3 | Functions, arrays and objects | functions, arrow functions and scope, arrays, `map`/`filter`/`find`, objects, a grades manager |
| 4 | JavaScript and HTML | HTML and `<script>`, the DOM, events, inputs and forms, creating elements and timers, a quiz page |
| Days 29–30 | Capstone | a calculator, a quiz game or a to-do list web app — then the certificate |

Suggested pace: about an hour a day — five lesson days, one review-and-project day and one rest day each week.
Weeks 1 and 4 follow the school chapter *Introduction to Web Programming with HTML & JavaScript*; the rest goes further.

## How it works

- Student code runs in a Web Worker (console programs) or a sandboxed preview frame (web pages). Infinite loops are
  stopped automatically, and errors are explained in plain English.
- Progress, code and notes are saved in the student's own browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
- The whole site is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript, published with GitHub Pages.

## For developers

```bash
node tools/check-lessons.js        # runs every example, answer key and solution of the 30 days
pip install playwright && python3 tools/smoke.py   # opens every page in Chromium, tests web exercises
```

How lessons are written: [`docs/lesson-style.md`](docs/lesson-style.md).

---

Created by [Dr. Omaia Al-Omari](https://dromaia.github.io/). Libraries: CodeMirror 5 and Acorn (MIT).
