# PU5 — BlackJack Pick-Up 5 (All Saints Rules)

A browser card game: you against 1–5 CPU players. The first player to run out of cards wins.

## Play

Open `index.html` in any browser. No install or server is needed.

- Tap cards in the order you want to play them. They appear in the staging row.
- Press **Play**. Tap a staged card to take it (and every card after it) back.
- Press **Pick up**, or tap the pickup deck, if you can't or don't want to play.
- **Hint** stages the move the CPU would make for you.
- Cards you can legally play next have a gold outline.

Run `npm run build` to make `dist/pu5.html`, a single file that holds the whole game, for sharing. `node scripts/build-single.js --artifact` writes the same game without the page wrapper, for hosts that add their own.

## Rules

| Card | Effect |
|---|---|
| **A** | Can be played at any time, including as the last card of any run. You pick the new suit. |
| **2** | The next player picks up 2. |
| **7** | Everyone passes their hand anticlockwise. |
| **8** | Skips the next player. |
| **Black J** | The next player picks up 5. With more than one deck, they pick up the starting hand size instead. |
| **Red J** | Cancels a pick-up that's in play. It still has to match the pile. |
| **Q** | Only goes on her own suit or another Queen. She must be covered by her suit or another Queen. If you can't cover her, you pick up 1. |
| **K** | Reverses direction. Play starts clockwise. |

- **Matching:** the first card you play must match the suit (or the suit an Ace called) or the number/letter on the pile.
- **Runs:** after the first card, each card must match the card before it by suit or number, and go in order. That means either the same number in any suit, or the same suit one up or down. For example, 5♦ → 5♠ → 5♣ → 6♣ works, and so does 4♥ → 5♥ → 4♥ (with 2 decks) or 4♥ → 5♥ → 5♠ → 4♠. 8♥ → 9♣ doesn't: different suit and different number. A covering Queen is the one exception: anything of her suit, or another Queen.
- **In play:** after a 2 or black Jack, the deck is hot. The next player must either stack a 2 or black Jack (the total keeps growing, so 2 then black Jack means pick up 7), cancel with a red Jack, or pick up the whole stack. A response run must end on a 2, black Jack or red Jack.
- **Can't play:** pick up one card and lose your turn.
- **Last cards:** if the cards left in your hand after a play could all go down together on your next turn, you must call "Last cards!" (press the button before Play). That can be one card or several, e.g. 9♦ 9♣ 10♣. It doesn't have to match the pile yet, but it has to end on a plain card, since you can't go out on a power card. If you don't call, you pick up a penalty: 2 by default, and you can pick 1, 2 or 5 on the setup screen (`lastCardPenalty`). CPUs forget now and then too. A player who called shows a LAST CARDS tag until their next turn.
- **Power cards can't start or finish the game:** the dealt starting card is never a power card, and you can't go out on one (A, 2, 7, 8, J, Q, K). A power card in the middle of your last run is fine. The first card played after the deal can be a power card, e.g. on 3♣ you can play Q♣ then 4♣ (`noFinishOnPowerCard`).
- **Setup:** the dealer is random. The player to the dealer's left starts. If the starting card is a power card, it is buried at a random spot in the pickup deck and a new card is turned over.
- **Reshuffle:** when the pickup deck runs out, the dealer keeps the top card of the play pile and shuffles the rest back into the pickup deck.

### Rules modes

Pick the mode on the setup screen.

- **All Saints:** the standard rules. Only a red Jack cancels a pick-up that's in play.
- **All Saints II:** you can also cancel with a combo. Start with any pick-up power card (2, black Jack or red Jack) and carry on with a run in order. Examples: (red J, 10), (2, 3), (black J, Q, cover). The first card must still match the pile. This is `comboCancel` in `DEFAULT_CONFIG`.

### How some rules were read

These parts of the written rules could be read more than one way. Each one is a single setting in `DEFAULT_CONFIG` in `src/engine.js`, or a small code change.

- **Only the last card of a run takes effect.** For example, 8 → 7 → 8 skips one player, and in All Saints II, 2 → 3 cancels the pick-up.
- **Red Jack must still match the pile.** It isn't wild ("so long as… the syntax is correct").
- **An Ace can end any run.** For example, 5 → 6 → A (`aceEndsAnyRun`).
- **An uncovered Queen costs 1 card** (`queenPenalty`). Your turn then ends.
- **With 2 players, K only flips direction.** It has no extra skip effect.

## Adding rules

All game logic lives in `src/engine.js`. It is pure JavaScript with no browser code:

- `canStart` decides what may start a play.
- `canFollow` decides what may follow within a run.
- `playCards` applies card effects (see the `switch (last.rank)` block).
- `pickUp` handles passing and picking up.

The CPU logic is in `src/ai.js`, and the UI is in `src/ui.js`.

```
npm test   # rules tests (Node 18+), including 40 full CPU-vs-CPU games
```

# Lữ Hành · Làng Thanh Mộc

Webgame nhập vai phiêu lưu, phong cách làng Việt xưa. Chạy trên Blogspot, máy chủ là Google Apps Script, dữ liệu nằm trong Google Sheets.

## Cấu trúc

| Thư mục | Nội dung |
|---|---|
| `src/` | Mã nguồn, tách theo phần: `01-data.js` dữ liệu mặc định (giống các Sheet) · `02-core.js` lõi máy chủ dùng chung cho Apps Script và chế độ ngoại tuyến · `03-net.js` kết nối máy chủ · `04-world.js` bản đồ · `05-player.js` luật chơi (chỉ số, trang bị, phẩm chất, gia cường, nhiệm vụ, lính) · `06-game.js` vòng lặp game · `07-ui.js` giao diện · `08-portal.js` đăng nhập, tạo nhân vật · `style.css`, `body.html` |
| `dist/` | Bản đóng gói, **không sửa tay**: `lu-hanh.js` + `lu-hanh.css` để Blogspot nạp qua jsDelivr; `lu-hanh.html` là bản một file (mở thẳng để chơi thử ngoại tuyến) |
| `apps-script/` | `Code.gs` để dán vào Apps Script (sinh tự động từ `gs-adapter.js` + dữ liệu + lõi); `sheet-ids.json` là ID các file Sheet |
| `blogspot/` | Đoạn HTML ngắn để dán vào Blogspot |
| `tools/build.mjs` | Đóng gói lại `dist/` và `Code.gs` |

## Đưa lên Blogspot

Dán nội dung `blogspot/nhung-vao-blogspot.html` vào bài viết ở chế độ HTML. Đoạn này nạp `dist/lu-hanh-boot.js` (vài KB): hiện màn hình chờ ngay, rồi tải `lu-hanh.css` + `lu-hanh.js` có đếm phần trăm.

`window.LH_API` là URL Web App (đuôi `/exec`), đã điền sẵn máy chủ Việt Nam. Để trống thì game chạy ngoại tuyến, lưu trên trình duyệt (`dist/lu-hanh-offline.html` để thử).

## Chợ phiên (trang riêng)

Trên Blogspot tạo **Trang** mới, đường dẫn `cho-phien`, dán `blogspot/cho-phien.html` (chế độ HTML). Trang này dùng chung tài khoản và máy chủ với game: ký gửi đồ Hoàn hảo, Huyền thoại, Thần, mua đồ, mua nhân vật người khác làm lính đi theo, nhận tiền bán hàng.

## Máy chủ quyết định

Từ v8, tiền, đồ rơi, gia cường, mua bán, nhiệm vụ, lính đều do máy chủ (`05-player.js` chạy trong Apps Script) quyết định. Máy người chơi chỉ gửi lệnh (gom các lần hạ quái, gửi 2,5 giây một lần) và nhận lại trạng thái. Sửa dữ liệu trên trình duyệt không tăng được tiền hay đồ.

## Cấp độ, sách, thú cưỡi (v8.1)

- Hạ quái và trả việc cho Lý trưởng được kinh nghiệm (cột `kinh_nghiem` ở tab `quai`, `thuong_kinh_nghiem` ở tab `nhiem_vu`; Sheet chưa có cột thì máy chủ tự tính: quái = máu/8, việc = đồng thưởng/10). Kinh nghiệm cần lên cấp L = `exp_goc` × L^(`exp_tang`/100). Mỗi cấp được `diem_moi_cap` điểm cộng vào 4 chỉ số. Cấp và kinh nghiệm ghi vào cột `cap`, `kinh_nghiem` của bảng `nhan_vat`.
- Sách gắn vào ô kỹ năng cộng dồn chỉ số (`sach_chi_so`, `sach_moi_cap`); luyện sách ở Đạo sĩ.
- Thú cưỡi gia cường (Lò rèn hoặc Người nuôi thú cưỡi): +1..+6 tốc độ, +7..+10 thêm công, +11..+15 thêm máu, mana, phòng ngự (`thu_cuoi_*`). Lính đánh thuê cưỡi được thú, không tốn Mệnh lệnh của người chơi.

## Sách bí truyền, lính, quái thu phục (v8.2)

- Sách Lôi (lôi quang đánh xuống), Phong (làm chậm), Băng (đóng băng), Ánh sáng (bị đánh trúng thì dọa quái bỏ chạy), Ma công (hạ quái có tỉ lệ thu phục, tăng theo Mệnh lệnh; quái chết là mất). Tỉ lệ trong `cau_hinh`: `loi_*`, `phong_*`, `bang_*`, `sang_*`, `ma_*`, `sach_ti_le_cap`.
- Tối đa 4 lính, đi theo cùng lúc nếu đủ Mệnh lệnh. Lính gục về làng chờ, nhân vật về làng thì nhập đội lại. Điểm lên cấp cộng được vào Mệnh lệnh.
- Thợ rèn gia cường vũ khí, giáp; Người nuôi thú cưỡi gia cường thú; Đạo sĩ luyện sách (máy chủ kiểm tra).

## Phản hồi tức thì (v8.3)

Mua, bán, gia cường, nhiệm vụ, thuê lính, cộng điểm chạy ngay trên máy người chơi bằng cùng luật (`05-player.js`) và cùng chuỗi ngẫu nhiên `rs` với máy chủ, hiện kết quả liền rồi gửi lên máy chủ. Máy chủ tính lại y hệt và lưu; trạng thái máy chủ luôn là chuẩn.

## Vũ khí, Mệnh lệnh, ảnh tĩnh (v8.4)

- Tab `vu_khi` (file Sheet vật phẩm): mỗi loại vũ khí có sát thương (%), tầm đánh, độ lan, thời gian một đòn, mana kỹ năng (%), thời gian hồi kỹ năng (%), nội tại mỗi đòn. Mặc định: sát thương Thương > Kiếm > Khiên > Nỏ > Cung > Gậy; tầm Gậy > Nỏ > Cung > Thương > Kiếm > Khiên; tốc đánh Kiếm > Thương > Khiên > Cung > Nỏ > Gậy; tốn mana và hồi chiêu nhanh Khiên > Cung > Thương > Nỏ > Kiếm > Gậy.
- Mỗi lính đi theo tốn số Mệnh lệnh riêng; bảng lính hiện "Mệnh lệnh đã dùng / tổng" và "Cần X / còn Y" cho từng lính.
- File `LH 11 · Hình ảnh` (tab `hinh_anh`, danh sách sinh tự động ở `apps-script/hinh-anh.csv`): dán link ảnh Google Drive vào cột `link_anh` để thay biểu tượng, đồ dùng, quái, NPC, logo, nền, chân dung, túi đồ rơi. Ô trống hoặc ảnh lỗi thì dùng hình mặc định. Ảnh Drive phải chia sẻ "Bất kỳ ai có đường liên kết".
- Hạ quái: phần thưởng tính ngay trên máy người chơi (cùng chuỗi ngẫu nhiên với máy chủ), túi đồ mở liền rồi mới gửi lên máy chủ.
- Thanh máu trùm: biểu tượng + thanh ngắn cạnh nút phiên bản.

## Một thiết bị, khung vừa màn hình (v8.5)

- Mỗi tài khoản chỉ chơi trên một thiết bị: đăng nhập ở thiết bị mới thì thiết bị cũ bị dừng (máy chủ báo `DANG_NHAP_NOI_KHAC`, game kiểm tra phiên mỗi 20 giây). Cột `token_cu` ở bảng `tai_khoan`.
- Khung game cao đúng phần màn hình nhìn thấy (trừ thanh công cụ trình duyệt điện thoại).
- Chợ phiên nhận ký gửi đồ Hoàn hảo, Huyền thoại, Thần (cột `giao_dich` ở tab `pham_chat`).

## Bản 8.9

- Chợ phiên ký gửi đồ bằng tiền, hồng ngọc hoặc cả hai. Bảng thuê lính hiện hồng ngọc.
- Nhiệm vụ của Lý trưởng chỉ thưởng tiền, làm một lần, xong thì ẩn. Phẩm chất rơi cao nhất của bản đồ: `pham_chat_roi_toi_da` trong `cau_hinh` (mặc định `p` Hoàn hảo).
- Ảnh màn hình chờ, cảnh căn lều: chạy `kiemTra` để thêm các dòng `giao_dien:nen_cho_*`, `nen_leu` vào file Hình ảnh.
- Vẽ lại người: mặt có mắt mũi miệng, viền và bóng, song kiếm cầm hai thanh rõ ràng.

## Bản 9.0: lưu theo mốc

- Mọi việc trong game (hạ quái, mua bán, gia cường, nhiệm vụ, thuê lính, cộng điểm, xếp đồ, vị trí) tính và ghi ngay trên máy (localStorage, khóa `lh-local-<mã nhân vật>`), không gửi máy chủ liên tục.
- Chỉ gửi lên máy chủ rồi tải lại túi đồ, tiền, nhân vật ở các mốc: về làng (vào vùng an toàn), qua cầu (mỗi chiều), gặp Thương nhân, rời cuộc nói chuyện với dân làng

# 🏝️ 단어섬 800

초등 필수 영어 어휘 800개(2015 개정 교육과정 초등 권장 어휘 기반)를 게임처럼 외우는 웹 앱입니다.
설치나 빌드 없이 브라우저에서 바로 실행됩니다.

## 실행

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
# 브라우저에서 http://localhost:8000 열기
```

`index.html`을 바로 열어도 동작하지만, 서버로 열면 오프라인 캐시(PWA)와 홈 화면 추가가 됩니다.

## 학습 방법

| 기능 | 설명 |
| --- | --- |
| 🏝️ 단어섬 지도 | 800단어를 20개씩 40개 섬으로 나눴어요. 퀴즈에서 별을 1개 이상 받으면 다음 섬이 열려요. |
| 🃏 카드 학습 | 카드를 뒤집어 뜻 확인, 발음 듣기. "몰라요"를 누른 단어는 끝에 한 번 더 나와요. |
| ⭐ 섬 퀴즈 | 뜻 고르기 · 영어 고르기 · 듣기 · 철자 퍼즐이 섞여 나와요. 하트 3개, 콤보 보너스. |
| 🎧 듣기 퀴즈 / 🔤 철자 퍼즐 | 소리만 듣고 뜻 고르기, 글자 조각으로 단어 만들기 |
| 🧩 짝 맞추기 | 영어 카드와 뜻 카드의 짝을 찾는 기억력 게임 |
| ⏱️ 스피드 퀴즈 | 60초 타임어택. 틀리면 -2초, 5콤보마다 +3초 |
| 🔁 오늘의 복습 | 라이트너 상자(1·2·4·7·15일 간격) 방식으로 잊어버릴 때쯤 다시 출제 |
| 📒 오답 노트 | 틀린 단어가 모이고, 맞히면 빠져요 |
| 📚 단어장 | 800단어 검색, 암기 단계별 필터 |

### 재미 요소
- **펫 키우기**: XP를 모아 레벨이 오르면 알 🥚 → 병아리 🐥 → 앵무새 🦜 → 독수리 🦅 → 용 🐉 으로 자라요.
- **연속 공부일 🔥, 코인 🪙, 배지 15종, 하루 목표**, 정답 효과음과 꽃가루 연출
- 영어 발음은 브라우저 음성 합성(Web Speech API)을 사용합니다.

## 파일 구조

```
index.html        앱 진입점
css/style.css     스타일 (라이트/다크 모드)
js/words.js       800단어 데이터 (단어|뜻|이모지)
js/app.js         화면과 게임 로직
sw.js, manifest.json, icon.svg   오프라인/홈 화면 추가
```

학습 기록은 브라우저 `localStorage`에 저장됩니다.
단어를 고치려면 `js/words.js`의 한 줄(`단어|뜻|이모지`)을 수정하면 됩니다.

buicongnguyen/new_cute_game.readme:
# Cloudback

*A cozy sky adventure on the back of a growing whale.*

You live on the back of **Bao**, a sky-whale calf, with your grandmother Nana Sumi. You grow fruit trees in the moss on Bao's back and feed Bao so it grows. Then you fly from isle to isle and free each one from **the Gloom**, a grey crystal hush that crusts everything that keeps still. Ring your bell mallet to break the crystal shells and free the animals inside, rescue the islanders, and trade at their markets. The crew grows, and each Hive you break returns a stolen Note of the pod's song. Collect all three, and Bao can dive below the clouds to wake its mother.

**Play:** https://buicongnguyen.github.io/new_cute_game/ (phones and desktop, English and Tiếng Việt)

## How to play

| | Phone | Desktop |
|---|---|---|
| Walk | Drag on the left half of the screen, or tap the ground | WASD or the arrow keys, or click |
| Use the thing in front of you | Tap it, or the big round button | F or Enter |
| Ring the mallet | It rings by itself near the Gloom; 🔔 rings on purpose | Space |
| Chime Spin, Hop, Quick Eat | 🌀 💨 🍐 | Q, E (or Shift), R |

The goal card at the top left always shows your next step.

## The loop

1. Plant seeds in the glowing moss patches.
2. Feed the fruit to Bao.
3. Make a rope at the Workbench.
4. Sail from the map table.
5. Slide down to the isle.
6. Break the Spires, rescue the caged islanders, and break the Hive.
7. Bao sings, and the isle's colour comes back.
8. When Bao has eaten enough and holds the right Note, it grows: a bigger back, more moss patches, and farther isles.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm run dev        # http://127.0.0.1:5361
npm test           # rules, economy, whole-story simulation, i18n
npm run build      # type check + production build (dist/)
node scripts/playtest.mjs   # end-to-end browser playtest against the dev server (needs Playwright)
```

Pushing to `main` runs the tests and publishes the game to GitHub Pages (`.github/workflows/pages.yml`).

## Inside

- **Writing:**
  - `docs/STORY.md`: the story, characters and chapters.
  - `docs/DESIGN.md`: every rule and number.
  - `docs/REVIEW-LOG.md`: the three drafts of the story and the three logic checks.
- **Rules:** `src/rules/` holds the rules as pure TypeScript and data. `tests/progression.test.ts` plays the whole story with a scripted player.
- **Game:**
  - `src/world/` draws the game: three.js with toon shading, baked vertex colours, instanced scenery and clouds, and the Gloom tint shader.
  - `src/ui/` is the HUD and the menus.
  - `src/game.ts` ties everything together.
- **Art:** `art/blender/kit/` holds the Blender generators for every model (`docs/ART-CONTRACT.md`). Run them with Blender 4.5 headless: `blender -b --factory-startup --python art/blender/kit/build_<name>.py -- --render`.
- **Engine:** the camera, quality governor and phone-gesture helper come from our earlier game Zoo Garden. All story, art, sound and content are new.

# Kamote Rider: Highway Escape

A portrait-mode 3D endless motorcycle arcade game built with **Flutter** and the **Flame** game engine. It is a fictional, humorous game set on Philippine-inspired highways. All characters, officers, vehicles and brands in it are made up.

You ride through five changing worlds and pick up paper money and fuel. Avoid traffic, and survive the 10-second LTO chase. Spend what you earn to release 15 impounded motorcycles.

---

## 1. How to play

| Action | Control |
|---|---|
| Change lane | Swipe left/right (one lane per ~26 px of drag) or tap the on-screen ◀ ▶ buttons |
| Desktop testing | Arrow keys or A/D; P or Esc to pause |
| Pause | ⏸ button at top-right, or the Android Back button |

**Rules**

- The bike moves forward on its own. You only steer.
- **Fuel** keeps dropping while you ride. Red jerry cans refill 28% of the tank. When the tank hits zero, you get the **Out of Fuel** ending.
- **Paper bills** (₱20/₱50/₱100) add to your run earnings. Every kilometer pays a milestone bonus. Surviving a chase pays a ₱75 escape bonus.
- **LTO checkpoint:** every run starts by riding past a checkpoint, and the officer chases you for 10 seconds.
- **Side collisions** start a 10-second LTO chase. These are scraping the guardrail, hitting the side or rear of a car, or hitting a barrier.
- A **second side collision during any chase** gives you the **Ticket & Jail** ending.
- **Potholes and cones** are minor: they slow you down and make the bike wobble, but never start a chase.
- **Hitting oncoming traffic head-on** (the two left lanes) gives you the **Ambulance** ending right away. A red ▼ warning shows at the top of the lane before an oncoming car appears.
- After any hit, you are briefly invulnerable (1.2–1.6 s depending on difficulty) while you get knocked aside. This stops one crash from counting twice.
- **Dogs, cats and chickens** sometimes cross the road. Bumping one is a minor hit: you stop short, the animal hops away unhurt, and there's no chase.
- The world changes every **1 km**: City Highway → Provincial Road → Mountain Road → Coastal Highway → Urban Road. Then the loop repeats with heavier traffic.

**Collision policy (in priority order).** If several hits happen in the same frame, only the most serious one counts:

1. Head-on with oncoming traffic: the run ends (ambulance).
2. Side collision: the chase starts. If a chase is already running, you go to jail.
3. Minor hazard: you slow down.

There is only ever **one chase timer**. The checkpoint chase counts as your first offense, and a new collision never restarts or stacks the timer.

### Difficulty

Before each run you pick a difficulty on the **Choose Difficulty** screen. Your last choice is remembered, and Medium is the default. The difficulty can't change during a run.

| | Easy, "Chill ride, idol." | Medium, "Sakto lang, pero ingat." | Hard, "Para sa tunay na kamote survivor." |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starting speed | ×0.86 | ×1.0 | ×1.1 |
| Speed growth per km (cap) | +2% (20%) | +3.5% (32%) | +4.5% (40%) |
| Traffic / obstacles | ×0.7 / ×0.7, slower ramp-up | ×1.0 | ×1.22 / ×1.25, faster ramp-up |
| Clear road before each hazard | 0.75 s | 0.5 s | 0.4 s |
| Warning before oncoming cars | 1.6 s | 1.3 s | 1.1 s |
| Fuel burn / time between fuel cans | ×0.8 / ×0.75 | ×1.0 / ×1.0 | ×1.2 / ×1.2 |
| Random challenge every | ~22 s | ~16 s | ~11 s |
| Bonus money* | ×0.75 | ×1.0 | ×1.5 |
| Recovery after a hit / steering speed | 1.6 s / ×1.15 | 1.3 s / ×1.0 | 1.2 s / ×1.0 |

\*Bonus money covers milestones, escape bonuses, near misses, streaks and challenges. Paper bills always pay face value.

On every difficulty, the 10-second chase, "second offense = jail", "head-on = game over", and "never more than 2 of 4 lanes blocked" rules stay the same. All of these values live in `lib/game/difficulty_config.dart`.

### Random highway challenges

A challenge is announced in a small banner under the top bar just before it arrives. If you clear it without touching any part of it, you get bonus pesos, paid once per challenge.

| Challenge | What happens | Base reward |
|---|---|---:|
| Animal crossing: dog / cat / chicken | A dog runs straight across, hesitates, or turns back. A cat dashes, pauses mid-road, or reverses. A flock of chickens waddles across. A "!" bubble shows before any stop or turn. | ₱30–35 |
| Tricycle incoming | A tricycle merges from the roadside with its turn signal on | ₱40 |
| Brake lights ahead | A car ahead brakes hard (brake lights, tyre screech) | ₱45 |
| Road works | A barrier and cones close one lane, with a warning sign | ₱60 |
| Pothole zone | A scattered field of potholes | ₱50 |
| Falling cargo | A truck drops a cardboard box behind it | ₱50 |
| Cash rush | A 12-bill trail that weaves across lanes, including oncoming ones. Collect every bill to win. | ₱80 |
| Fuel emergency | When fuel is low, a jerry can appears in a risky but reachable lane | — |
| LTO surprise | A checkpoint ahead waves you through if you're in the right lanes (3–4). Counterflow and you're chased. | ₱60 |
| VIP convoy | Four black SUVs with strobes block both right lanes | ₱70 |

**Fairness.** Every challenge is planned through the same lane planner as normal traffic, so it only starts if there's always an escape lane. Animals start on the shoulder above the screen and begin crossing only once visible. The game simulates their path ahead of time and only allows paths that cover at most 2 lanes when they reach you. While an animal crosses, normal traffic pauses. A pending challenge also briefly holds new traffic so the road can clear.

### Combos, near misses and memes

- **Near miss:** pass a hazard by a hair and you earn ₱10 × combo (up to ×5). Each dodge or cleared challenge adds to your combo, which shows as "x3 COMBO" in the HUD. Any collision resets it.
- **Cash streak:** collect 8 bills in quick succession for a ₱40 bonus.
- **Meme reactions:** short Taglish pop-ups react to what just happened. Examples: "AY, N

# 楓嶺 · 回音鐘 Maple Ridge

像素風(three.js 低解析度渲染 + 描邊)的解謎探險遊戲。回到過世爺爺的楓嶺,推石頭、釣魚、修水車、點古燈、闖山洞,登頂敲響回音鐘。

- 純靜態網站,不需 build:three@0.170.0 由 CDN import map 載入,直接部署到 Vercel(Framework: Other,Output: 根目錄)。
- 地形、樹、房子、角色由程式即時生成;對話頭像與道具圖示用 Gemini 生成(assets/portraits、assets/items,原圖在 art_src/);配樂 4 首用 Suno v6-mini 生成(assets/music:村莊、山徑、山洞、結局),音效為程式合成。
- 本機測試:`python -m http.server` 後開 `http://localhost:8000`。

操作:WASD/方向鍵 移動 · Shift 奔跑 · E/空白 互動、推石、上下車 · Tab/M 地圖 · B 背包 · J 旅程 · P 狗哨 · H 喇叭 · R 重置謎題 · Z 望遠鏡。手機:左半邊浮動搖桿 + E/跑/圖/包 按鈕。

系統:7 間可進入的房子(爺爺的家、阿梅雜貨店、工具棚、磨坊、老陳小屋、兩間山屋)、柴犬豆豆(餵食收養、跟隨、嗅出金楓葉、挖寶)、爺爺的小貨車「小藍」(鑰匙在爺爺書桌抽屜)、背包與採集(松果/野莓/香菇/狗餅乾/魚)。角色是體素 mini-fig 風格,對話頭像是像素畫。

`tools/` 內是設計用的 Sokoban 解題器(驗證推石謎題可解)與地圖 ASCII 輸出。

## 測試
網址加上 `?debug` 會載入 `src/debug.js`(`window.D`):`D.go(x,z)` 走路、`D.press()` 互動、`D.talk()` 跳過對話、`D.soko(moves,c0,r0,cave)` 依解題器步驟推石。整條主線(信箱→貓→釣魚→工具棚→推石→溪流謎題→營地→梯子→水車→升降台→古燈→山洞謎題→鐘槌→山頂敲鐘)已用它跑過一遍。

binhnt010896/long-ky-card-game.readme:
# Long Ký - The Game

The first game in the Long Ký universe: a single-player, offline, turn-based card strategy game about the Trần dynasty's defence of Đại Việt against the Mongol–Yuan invasions. Real people and events; our own art.

Platforms: Android, iOS, macOS, Windows. No web.

- Design plan: [docs/plan.md](docs/plan.md)
- Build spec and ticket backlog for the coding agent: [docs/build-spec.md](docs/build-spec.md)
- Rules for the coding agent: [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)

## Toolchain (pinned)

| Tool | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Flutter | 3.47.7 (stable) |
| Dart | 3.13.5 (bundled with Flutter) |
| Melos | 8.9.0 |

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `build.yml`) uses the same Flutter version.

## Layout

```
packages/lk_rules     pure Dart rules engine (state, reducer, Yuan AI, seeded RNG)
packages/lk_content   content parser, validator (bin/validate.dart) and text export (bin/export_text.dart)
apps/game             Flutter app; all content JSON in apps/game/assets/content
tools/sim             headless balance simulator and text-mode player
```

## Commands

```bash
dart pub global activate melos 8.9.0   # once; puts `melos` in ~/.pub-cache/bin
melos bootstrap
melos run analyze
melos run test
melos run generate                     # regenerate freezed / json_serializable code
dart run packages/lk_content/bin/validate.dart
dart run packages/lk_content/bin/export_text.dart   # every vi/en text + sourceRefs as CSV, for the history reviewer
dart run tools/sim/bin/sim.dart --mission ch1_m2 --games 1000
dart run tools/sim/bin/sim.dart --play --mission ch1_m2
```

Status: T-01 to T-29 are on `main`; what is left needs the owner's inputs, devices and assets. See `docs/status.md` for the handoff: what is done, what is open, and the suggested order.

AndreaAcanfora/dama.readme:
# Dama

Italian draughts (dama italiana) in the browser:

- **against the computer**, from Principiante to Maestro, a neural network trained by self-play;
- **two players** on the same phone;
- **online with a friend**: send a link, each plays from their own device.

Installable as a PWA; everything except online play works offline. Italian and English.

**Play:** https://andreaacanfora.github.io/dama/

## Rules

This is the Italian variant, which differs from English checkers and international draughts:

- 8×8 board with a dark square in each player's bottom-right corner. White moves first.
- Men move and capture one square diagonally, forward only.
- **A man can never capture a king.**
- Kings move one square in any diagonal direction (no flying kings).
- Capturing is compulsory, with this precedence:
  1. take the greatest number of pieces;
  2. if equal, capture with a king rather than a man;
  3. if equal, take the greatest number of kings;
  4. if equal, take the king that comes first in the sequence.
- A man that reaches the far row during a capture is crowned and the move ends.
- A side with no legal move loses. The game is drawn on threefold repetition or after 40 moves each without a capture or a man move.

The draw rules follow common practice; open an issue if you have the FID regulation text and it says otherwise.

## Layout

```
packages/engine     rules: bitboard move generation, FEN, game status (no dependencies)
packages/ai         alpha-beta levels, neural MCTS for Maestro, the arena script
packages/protocol   message types shared by the web app and the online server
apps/web            Vite + React + SVG app, PWA, deployed to GitHub Pages
apps/server         online game server (Node + ws), deployed to a VPS
training            Python self-play training (AlphaZero-style) and ONNX export
fixtures            engine.json and encoding.json: what every rules and encoding implementation must reproduce
```

## The engine

Squares are indexed 0..31 from White's back rank and stored as 32-bit masks. Notation numbers run 1..32 from the top-left square seen from White, so White's men start on 21..32 and moves read like `22-18` or `22x13x6`.

Perft from the starting position:

| depth | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| leaves | 7 | 49 | 302 | 1,469 | 7,361 | 36,473 | 177,532 | 828,783 |

Up to depth 5 this matches English checkers, as it should: the only captures that early are single jumps of men by men. From depth 6 the Italian "take the most pieces" rule starts pruning choices.

## The computer

Negamax alpha-beta with iterative deepening, a Zobrist transposition table, and compulsory captures searched past the horizon (a natural quiescence search, since a side that can capture must). The weaker levels score every root move at a shallow depth, add noise and occasionally play a random move, so they lose in a human way instead of collapsing at random.

| level | search |
|---|---|
| Principiante | depth 1, heavy noise, 25% random moves |
| Facile | depth 2, noise, 10% random moves |
| Medio | depth 4, light noise, 3% random moves |
| Difficile | up to 400 ms |
| Esperto | up to 1.5 s |
| Maestro | neural network trained by self-play, 800 MCTS simulations or 1.5 s |

### Maestro

Maestro is a small residual network (about 490k parameters, 1.9 MB) trained from zero, with no human games, AlphaZero-style: it played itself with Monte Carlo tree search and learned from the results. It runs in the browser with onnxruntime-web, downloaded only when you pick it. The training code is in [`training/`](training/).

| | |
|---|---|
| Self-play games | 57,600 (150 iterations × 384) |
| Training positions | 7.7 million |
| Training time | 9.9 hours on a MacBook Pro M1 Pro |
| Search during self-play | 128 simulations per move |

Measured with `pnpm --filter @dama/ai arena`: 24 games per match, each pair of games from the same 4 random opening moves with colours swapped, because both players are otherwise deterministic and would repeat the same game.

| match | wins | draws | losses | score |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maestro (800 simulations, 1.5 s) vs Esperto | 12 | 6 | 6 | 62.5% |
| network after 150 iterations, 200 simulations, vs Esperto | 3 | 17 | 4 | 47.9% |
| network after 100 iterations, 200 simulations, vs Esperto | 6 | 11 | 7 | 47.9% |
| network after 150 iterations, 200 simulations, vs Difficile | 10 | 10 | 4 | 62.5% |

With the browser's search budget Maestro scores about 90 Elo above Esperto. Twenty-four games are a small sample, so read these as rough numbers.

One lesson from the first run: self-play collapsed to about 80% draws, all by threefold repetition and often with a large material lead. The search could not see that returning to a twice-seen position ends the game, so a winning side happily repeated itself. Counting the game history inside the tree fixed it (`training/dama/mcts.py`).

## Online play

`apps/server` is a small Node WebSocket server. Each game is a room with a six-character code (`#/play/ABC234` in the app); the first player gets White, the second Black. The server is authoritative: it checks every move with the same engine as the app, so a modified client cannot cheat. Players get a token that gives them their seat back after a refresh or a network change, and a rematch swaps colours. Limits per connection and per address, an origin allow-list and idle-room cleanup keep it small: it uses about 70 MB of memory.

The app finds the server through `VITE_WS_URL` at build time; a build without it hides online play.

## Development

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev          # http://localhost:5173
pnpm test         # unit tests in every package
pnpm typecheck
pnpm --filter @dama/web exec playwright test   # end-to-end, mobile and desktop
```

To try online play locally, start the server too: `pnpm --filter @dama/server dev` (the dev app connects to `ws://localhost:8787`).

`#pos=<FEN>` in the URL opens a two-player game from that p

ls11ae/ruler-of-the-plane.desc: Geometry games for the TU Dortmund open house – web edition of Ruler of the Plane
ls11ae/ruler-of-the-plane.readme:
# Ruler of the Plane

Spiele zur algorithmischen Geometrie für den Tag der offenen Tür der TU Dortmund. Browser games that make
computational geometry tangible, for walk-up visitors and for playing at home.

**Status:** work in progress for the open house on 7 November 2026. The current version of `main` runs at
<https://ls11ae.github.io/ruler-of-the-plane/> (works offline after the first visit).

Booth edition:

- **Licht ins Verlies**: light a dungeon with as few torches as possible (art gallery problem).
- **Erobere das Land**: build castles against the computer (Voronoi game with land, water and cities).
- **Gassi gehen**: walk the dog on the shortest leash (Fréchet distance, with free-space diagram).
- **Rasenmähen**: mow a lawn with two cutters (CG:SHOP 2027 lawn mowing).
- **Straßenbau** (optional): connect all villages with as little road as possible (minimum spanning tree).

The TSP game lives in the separate project tsp-boards. The original Unity version (TU Eindhoven,
2017–2020) is at [github.com/kbuchin/ruler](https://github.com/kbuchin/ruler) and still playable at
[kbuchin.github.io/ruler](https://kbuchin.github.io/ruler/).

![Start screen of the style mockup: a parchment map of the kingdom with one place per game](docs/look/start-map.webp)

## Development

Requirements: Node 22.13 or newer and npm.

```sh
npm install
npm run dev     # development server (http://localhost:5173/ruler-of-the-plane/)
npm run check   # format check, lint, typecheck, tests, build
npm run e2e     # Playwright smoke tests against the build (screenshots in screenshots/)
npm run levels  # convert legacy/levels/ to public/levels/
```

Useful addresses: `#/demo` shows the shared UI components; `?kiosk` turns on booth mode (attract screen
after 90 s without input). The staff menu opens with Ctrl+Shift+S or a 3 s press on the compass. Build
variables are described in [`.env.example`](.env.example); the code layout in
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md).

Most of the work happens in Claude Code on the web: see [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) and
[`docs/cloud-sessions.md`](docs/cloud-sessions.md).

## Licence and credits

The code is licensed under the MIT licence ([`LICENSE`](LICENSE)). The art (Kenney, CC0) and the fonts
(Eagle Lake and Patrick Hand, SIL Open Font License 1.1) keep their own licences. The level files in
`legacy/` and the level data generated from them come from the Unity version and are not covered by the
MIT licence (see [`legacy/README.md`](legacy/README.md)). Details in [`CREDITS.md`](CREDITS.md).

tomphp/icosagon.readme:
# Icosagon

Icosagon is a simple turnbased, two-player game.

The game area is a regular icosagon (20 points layed out in a circle, connected
by straight edges).

There are two player (red and blue) and they take it in turns to connect any
two points that have not yet been connected to.

When connected two points, the line will intesect one or more polygons made up
from the previous lines. For each intersection, the polygon will be split in
two, the side to the left of the intersecting like will be the player's colour,
the side to the right will be the other players colour.

The game ends when all 20 points are connected, the winner is calcuated by
which colour occupies the most area.

## Implementation

The ideas are all mine, the code is all Claude's.

The initial implementation is a static web-page with a canvas base
implementation. Connecting dots in a click and drag motion, the line is
visibile while dragging and the colours are updated, but the turn isn't
complete until the most has been released on a point. If it is release not on a
point, then the line is reset and they player may choose a new starting
point.

Add geometric and game logic should be in pure logic files, with separate files
for UI and input.

A browser driver and testing framework such as Puppetier should be used to play example games.

## Development

Enter the dev shell with `nix develop` (provides Node.js and Chromium), run `npm install`, then:

- `npm run dev`: start the dev server
- `npm test`: run the unit tests
- `npm run test:browser`: run the browser tests (Puppeteer, using the Chromium from Nix)
- `npm run typecheck` / `npm run build`
- `npm run train -- --generations N --out models/NAME.json`: train a Neural Model (also `--population`, `--hidden`, `--survivors`, `--mutation`, `--seed`), ending with a report against Greedy, Hoarder, Clever Hoarder and Random. Each Generation every network plays Greedy, Hoarder and Clever Hoarder as well as the rest of the Population. Add `--from models/OLD.json` to continue from that Model's Population, adding to its total Generations. Ctrl-C stops early, dropping the Generation in progress and still writing the Model with the Generations completed; a second Ctrl-C quits without writing
- `npm run match -- PARTICIPANT PARTICIPANT... [--games N] [--seed N]`: play Model files, `greedy`, `hoarder`, `clever-hoarder` and `random` against each other and print a results table

Both `train` and `match` play their games on every CPU core, with the same results as on one: a seed always gives the same output.

michaelcrosato/DentedDestiny-Z7.readme:
# Dented Destiny · The Bellwether Abbey

**The crown is broken. The oath remains.**

An original Souls-inspired action RPG vertical slice, built on the **Shardfall / Pavilion** engine in Rust and WebGPU. One authored ruined abbey connects deliberate melee combat, exploration, a hidden weapon, two sanctuaries, recoverable death currency, permanent upgrades, a looping shortcut, and Vesper, a two-phase bell guardian.

**v0.2.0 combat revision:** library-driven full-body animation, a three-hit sword chain, two-handed greatblade grip, hitstop and recoil, blade trails, stronger impact audio, and cel shading. [Revision and verification](docs/game/COMBAT-REVISION.md).

The default scene is the game. The engine's original workshop and tools remain available for expansion. This repository preserves its upstream history; original engine documentation is in [the upstream README](docs/game/UPSTREAM_README.md).

## Play and build

[Download the playable release](https://github.com/michaelcrosato/DentedDestiny-Z7/releases/latest). Open `DentedDestiny-Z7.html` in Chrome or Edge with hardware acceleration; no content server is required. The Linux companion archive contains a stripped development build of `dented-destiny` for Ubuntu 26.04.

Rust 1.98.1 is pinned. The repository includes Cargo.lock. No API keys or hosted services are needed.

```bash
# Native Linux dependencies, using local package extraction when no admin access is available:
scripts/setup-dented-local.sh
scripts/build-dented.sh
./target/debug/shardfall                 # title screen
./target/debug/shardfall --scene dented/play
./target/debug/shardfall --scene dented/lab
```

The native binary retains the upstream `shardfall` executable name for tool compatibility; its default game, title, settings and save are Dented Destiny. `dented/lab` opens practice with the gates, relic and upgrade currency available; practice never writes to the campaign save. `--scene world` opens the original engine pavilion.

```bash
# Browser output; install the wasm-bindgen-cli version pinned in Cargo.lock first.
rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.129 --locked
scripts/build-web.sh --single-file --scene dented \
  --title 'Dented Destiny — The Bellwether Abbey' --out out/DentedDestiny-Z7.html
```

Open the self-contained HTML in a WebGPU-capable browser with hardware acceleration. It requires no web server. `scripts/build-web.sh` without flags produces ordinary static files in target/web. `scripts/build-windows.sh` is the upstream Windows cross-build route and requires the MinGW toolchain.

## Controls

Browsers require an initial click or key press to enable sound; gamepad input then handles play and menus.

A standard-mapped PS5 DualSense is the primary layout. Keyboard/mouse actions follow the same combat and focus-navigation model.

| Action | PS5 controller | Keyboard / mouse |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | Left stick | WASD |
| Camera | Right stick | Middle-button drag |
| Light / heavy strike | R1 / R2 | J / K or left / right click |
| Evade | Circle | Space |
| Guard / timed parry | L1 / L2 | Shift / F |
| Lock on | R3 | R |
| Amber flask | Square | X |
| Interact / confirm | Cross | E / Enter |
| Switch weapon | Triangle | Q |
| Jump | L3 | V |
| Pause | Options | Escape |
| Equipment and memories | Create | Tab |
| Menu navigation | D-pad / left stick | Arrows |
| Return | Circle | Backspace |

Tap light attack again during a swing to chain three distinct strikes. Inputs pressed during impact pauses are buffered. Dodge after contact to cancel recovery; the windup remains committed. Light and heavy attacks consume stamina. Evades have a short invulnerable window. Guarding absorbs most frontal damage at a stamina cost; a well-timed parry staggers a melee enemy. A heavy blow breaks poise. Read windups and punish recovery. The second phase of Vesper adds a spread of spectral bolts.

Rest refills health and three flasks and revives ordinary enemies. Echoes buy vitality and weapon improvements. Death leaves your carried echoes at the fall; another death replaces that cache. Opened gates, the relic, blessings, and the defeated guardian persist. Ring the final bell to complete the pilgrimage, then explore the quiet abbey or begin again.

## Attract mode and accessibility

After ten seconds without input on the title or its submenus, the same AI used by the headless tools plays the actual level. It repeats after victory or death. Any physical input immediately returns to the title. Demo progress never replaces the player's saved pilgrimage. Phones and tablets present the autonomous scene without touch combat controls.

Settings offer reduced incoming damage, impact shake, sound, contrast, and an elevated tactical camera. Menus use large text and snapping focus. FPS and frame time remain visible on desktop.

Native checkpoint saves are versioned JSON beside the executable (`dented-destiny-save.json`). Browser saves use localStorage (`dented-destiny-z7-v1`). New oath resets progression. Unknown save versions are rejected, and bounded values are validated.

## Develop and verify

```bash
scripts/test-dented.sh
./target/debug/pav play scene=dented/play bot=true seeds=10 ticks=18000
./target/debug/pav capture scene=dented/play ticks=60 width=1280 height=720 out=out/abbey.png
./target/debug/pav room_check path=crates/pav_core/src/games/dented.toml
./target/debug/pav bench scene=dented/play ticks=1200
```

The final hardware run averaged **60.01 FPS at 1920×1080** in Windows Chrome on the RTX 3060 Ti; ten seeded campaigns won 10/10. See [the verification record](docs/game/VERIFICATION.md) for checks and platform limits.

Start with [the game plan](docs/game/PLAN.md), [engine feedback](docs/game/ENGINE_FEEDBACK.md), and the engine's [MAKE_A_GAME](docs/MAKE_A_GAME.md) guide. The original brief is preserved in [BRIEF.txt](docs/game/BRIEF.txt). The 50 generated names, random selection method and suffix are recorded in [na

DuIslingr/CR2-U.readme:
# CR2-U

A from-scratch reimplementation of **Chaos Rings II** (Square Enix / Media.Vision, 2012), from the
iPad release (2.1.0), the Android release (2.1.2) and the PS Vita release (PCSG00498). The third of
the series' ports, after [CR1:U](https://github.com/DuIslingr/CR1-U) and
[CRO-U](https://github.com/DuIslingr/CRO-U).

**No game data is included, and none ever will be.** Bring your own copy; the port reads it where
it is and never changes it.

## Status

Groundwork. Chaos Rings II is not on CR1 / Omega's engine: it is built on Media.Vision's own
library, MVGL (`MVGL::Draw`, `MVGL::Sound`, `MVGL::Utilities::Database`, ...), with the game's
logic split between native classes (`FldMain`, `BtlActionCtrl`, `InterfaceMain` and about a
hundred menus) and compiled Squirrel scripts (`.nut`, the events). So the engine is new; CR1:U's
platform layers (SDL3, the renderers, audio decoding, upscaling) can carry over as it grows.

- [x] The data archive (MDB1 `.mvgl`, and the Android OBB, which is one too): read, every file
      listed and decoded (doboz) - `tools/mvgl.py`
- [x] The file types surveyed (docs/FORMATS.md)
- [x] Reverse-engineering setup (`tools/re_setup.sh`): the Android library's 18,000 exported names
      carried to the iPad and Vita builds
- [x] Textures: every `img` decodes in all three releases (PVRTC, ETC1, DXT1 / DXT3, the plain
      formats; `cr2tool images`), and agrees across them
- [x] Meshes (`geom`): the layout, vertex formats and materials; all parse (`tools/geom.py`)
- [ ] The rest: `name`, `phys`, `emta`
- [x] The scripts surveyed (docs/SCRIPTS.md): Squirrel 2.2.4 bytecode, all 139 parsed and
      disassembled (`tools/nut.py`); the native API they call - 23 tables, 219 functions - read
      out of the Android library (`tools/sq_bindings.py`)
- [x] The script VM: the game's own Squirrel 2.2.4 (`engine/third_party/squirrel2`); every
      script loads and runs its `main` in all three releases (`cr2tool scripts`), events run up to
      their first wait with the native API stubbed (`cr2tool run`)
- [ ] The native API (219 functions) for real
- [x] A model viewer (`cr2view`): any figure of any of the three releases, textured; rendered with
      Vulkan 1.3 by default, OpenGL 3.3 where Vulkan can't start (`--renderer opengl`) - CR1:U's
      device layer, with CR2's vertices and the game's shading
- [x] Skeletons (`skel`: Sony Edge Animation's, ported) and the meshes' inverse bind matrices
- [x] Animations (`anim`): Edge Animation's frame sets and keyframes, decoded and checked
      (`tools/anim.py`)
- [x] Skinning and animation in the engine: the viewer plays every figure's animations (relative
      to the base pose, as the game blends them); materials' render states (alpha test, blending,
      culling, depth writes)
- [x] The text (`message\*.dat`): eight languages, voice ids, the window's commands
      (`tools/msg.py`)
- [x] The game's own shading: its generated GLSL shaders (`shad`, one per material shader key) as
      one shader, the same formulas - lights from the maps' light figures, hemisphere ambient,
      the vertex colours' occlusion, specular, velvet, CLUT toon shading, normal maps, fog, alpha
      test, light-map masks, scrolling textures; the materials' wrap modes and filters; the
      animations' user channels (material colours: the UI's fades). `cr2tool shaders` checks the
      key decoder against every shader's source
- [ ] Shading left out: point lights, overlays, distortion, billboards (effects)
- [x] Fields: the maps' table (read from your copy's executable), the painted layers, the map's 3D
      figure, its camera, lights and points; the viewer walks a character around a map
      (`cr2view --field d0101`), scrolling as the game does, idle / walk motions
- [x] Field collision: the maps' Bullet scenes (`phys`) and the player as Bullet's kinematic
      character controller, ported - `cr2tool walk`: on every map of all three releases the
      character lands on a floor and runs in 8 directions without leaving it or passing a wall
- [x] Field exits: touching one loads the map it leads to, at its pop point (`cr2tool exits`: all
      427 lead somewhere real)
- [x] Gimmicks: the maps' NPCs, objects, effects and treasure boxes placed and drawn (NPCs idling),
      solid as in the game; `cr2tool walk` runs from every map's arrival points
- [ ] Which gimmicks the story shows (flags, scripts), talking / tapping, event boxes, the HUD, the
      fades and sounds between areas
- [ ] Engine: events, battles, menus

## What you need

One or more of:

| Release | What the port reads |
|---|---|
| iPad 2.1.0 (`ChaosRings2enHD.app`) | `CRDB.ios.mvgl`, `Sound.ios/sound/` |
| Android 2.1.2 (`com.square_enix.chaosrings2gp`) | `main.212.com.square_enix.chaosrings2gp.obb` (the APK for its code, for RE) |
| PS Vita (PCSG00498) | `CR2/resources/CRDB.psp2.mvgl`, `Sound.psp2/` |

## Tools

| | |
|---|---|
| `cr2view --data <archive> [--model name] [--anim name --time s] [--lights figure\|none] [--renderer vulkan\|opengl] [--capture out.bmp]` | the model viewer: drag to turn, the wheel to zoom, Left / Right for the other models, Up / Down for the figure's animations, Space to pause |
| `cr2view --data <archive> --field <map> [--model c001] [--at point] [--binary file] [--walk sx,sy,s]` | a field: the arrow keys run the character (Shift walks) on the floors and against the walls; the maps' table comes from the executable beside the iPad's / Vita's archive, or `--binary` (Android: `lib/armeabi-v7a/libChaosRings2.so`) |
| `cr2tool check / scripts / run / images / models / compare-models / animations / pose / shaders / walk / exits` | checks on an archive: every file decodes, every script loads and runs its `main`, a script run with the natives stubbed, every texture / mesh decodes, two releases' meshes compared, the shader keys against their GLSL, the field player on every map, every map's exits |
| `tools/mvgl.py` | `list` / `stats` / `check` / `extract` an MDB1

PhenomDevel/Quality-of-Life-Forever.readme:
# Quality of Life Forever

Many small quality-of-life improvements for World of Warcraft **Forever**.
Every feature can be turned on or off individually.

## Features

Every module is off by default unless marked *(on by default)*. Turning a
module off restores your previous game settings.

### Interface

#### Skip cinematics
Skips in-game cinematics and pre-rendered movies. Hold Shift when one starts to
watch it.
- In-game cinematics
- Movies
- Only seen movies – play each movie once, skip it afterwards

### Cooldown Manager

#### Keybinds
Shows the keybind of the matching action button on the icons of the cooldown
manager.
- Separately for essential and utility cooldowns: show, font size (8–38 px),
  position (corners, edges, center), horizontal/vertical offset (±30 px)

### Character

#### Custom player name
Shows a name of your choice on your player frame (only visible to you).
- Name – set via a button

#### Hide player name
Hides your name on the player frame.

#### Item level
Shows the item level on equipment, colored by quality.
- Show on: character frame, bags (weapons and armor), inspect frame
- Display: color by quality

#### Show durability
Durability of each equipped item in percent on the character frame.
- Hide at 100%

### Tooltip

#### Tooltip tweaks
- Position: Blizzard default, at the cursor, right or left of the cursor
- Appearance: scale, background opacity

### Camera

#### Max camera distance
Lets you zoom the camera out further.
- Zoom factor (1.0–4.0)

### Graphics

#### Advanced graphics
Graphics settings not available in the game options. Higher values cost
performance. Adjust the sliders, then press *Apply*.
- Ground clutter: density, distance, fade distance
- View distance: object view distance, object cull size, terrain detail
  distance
- Effects: always sharpen, water reflections, weather density
- Actions: Apply, Restore

### Merchant

#### Auto repair *(on by default)*
Repairs all items at a merchant that can repair.
- Use guild funds – falls back to your own gold

#### Auto sell junk *(on by default)*
Sells all grey items at a merchant.
- Show summary – number of items and gold earned

### Loot

#### Auto-confirm BoP loot
Confirms the Bind on Pickup loot dialog while you are not in a group.

#### Auto loot
Turns on the game's auto loot.

#### Fast loot
Loots everything instantly when auto loot is on.

### Quests

#### Instant quest text
Shows quest text at once instead of fading it in.

#### Quest progress in chat
Copies quest progress messages (e.g. "Wolf slain: 3/10") into the chat.

### Social

#### Auto-accept: group invites
Accepts group invites. Role checks and invites that would remove you from a
queue are left to you.
- Accept from: friends, guild members
- Messages: notify in chat

#### Auto-accept: summons
Accepts summons and resurrections while out of combat and outside boss
encounters.
- Accept: summons, resurrections
- Messages: notify in chat

#### Auto-decline: duels
Declines all duel requests.
- Notify in chat

#### Auto-decline: guild
Declines guild invites and guild charters (never your own charter).
- Decline: guild invites, guild charters
- Messages: notify in chat

### Chat

#### Class colors in chat
Colors player names in chat by class.

#### Copyable URLs
Turns web addresses in chat into links. Click one to get it in a box, ready to
copy.

#### Short channel names
`[1. General - Elwynn Forest]` → `[1.G]`, `[2. Trade]` → `[2.T]`. Custom
channels keep their name.

#### Spam filter
Channel, say and yell messages with one of your keywords are shown only in a
separate "Spam" chat tab. Nothing is deleted.
- Keywords – editable list, default `boost, goldselling, carry`
- Spam tab – recreate the tab if it was closed

### World map

#### Movable world map
Scales the windowed world map (map and quest log) and lets you move it by
dragging its title bar. The fullscreen map stays unchanged.
- Scale (default 80%)
- Movable – position is saved
- Reset position

#### Zone level ranges
Level ranges of the zones, colored by your level.
- World map: on zone maps, on continent maps, in the zone name on hover
- Minimap: range of your current zone

## Usage

Open the options via *Esc → Options → AddOns → Quality of Life Forever*, the
addon button next to the minimap, or `/qol`.

| Command                 | Effect                                        |
|-------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| `/qol`                  | Open options                                  |
| `/qol list`             | List all features and whether they are on     |
| `/qol enable <feature>` | Turn a feature on (e.g. `/qol enable fastloot`) |
| `/qol disable <feature>`| Turn a feature off                            |
| `/qol toggle <feature>` | Toggle a feature                              |
| `/qol reset`            | Reset all settings                            |

Settings are shared by all characters on your account.

## Bugs and suggestions

Please report bugs and ideas on
[GitHub](https://github.com/PhenomDevel/Quality-of-Life-Forever/issues).

## AI-assisted development

This addon is developed with the help of AI ([Claude](https://claude.ai) by
Anthropic). **Every part of the code is reviewed by a professional software
developer before it is merged.**

xaisanatvtz25-ctrl/ball-vs-ball.readme:
# Ball vs Ball

เกมลูกบอลสกิลสู้กันในกรง แบบ 2D ลูกบอลบังคับไม่ได้ เด้งเองตามฟิสิกส์ ใช้สกิลเองตามคูลดาวน์ ใคร HP หมดก่อนแพ้

**เล่นเลย:** https://xaisanatvtz25-ctrl.github.io/ball-vs-ball/

![ปกเกม](img/cover.jpg)

**แอป Android (APK):** https://github.com/xaisanatvtz25-ctrl/ball-vs-ball/releases/download/apk/ball-vs-ball.apk

## แอป Android

ไฟล์ APK สร้างอัตโนมัติด้วย GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/apk.yml`) ทุกครั้งที่ตัวเกมบน branch `main` เปลี่ยน แล้วอัปโหลดไว้ที่ release ชื่อ `apk` ลิงก์ดาวน์โหลดด้านบนจึงได้เวอร์ชันล่าสุดเสมอ

- ตัวแอปอยู่ในโฟลเดอร์ `android/` เป็น WebView ที่ฝังไฟล์เกมไว้ในตัว เล่นแบบออฟไลน์ได้ ส่วนโหมดออนไลน์ต้องต่อเน็ต
- ทุก build เซ็นด้วยกุญแจเดียวกัน (เก็บใน cache ของ Actions ไม่ได้อยู่ใน repo) จึงติดตั้งเวอร์ชันใหม่ทับของเดิมได้ ถ้ากุญแจหาย จะต้องลบแอปเก่าก่อนติดตั้งใหม่หนึ่งครั้ง
- ติดตั้ง: เปิดไฟล์ APK บนมือถือ Android แล้วอนุญาต "ติดตั้งแอปที่ไม่รู้จัก" ให้แอปที่ใช้เปิดไฟล์

## มีอะไรบ้าง

- หน้าเมนูแยกเป็นหน้าๆ: หน้าแรก → เลือกนักสู้ → สู้ → ผลแพ้ชนะ, หน้าตัวละคร, หน้าตั้งค่า
- ตัวละครพิเศษ ໂຍສາຍຊອຍ ใช้หน้าจริงและเสียงจริงของเพื่อน มีหน้า 3 แบบ (ปกติ / โดนตี / อันติ) และเสียง 3 แบบ (เปิดตัว / โดนตี / อันติ)
- ต้องเลือกบอลครบ 2 ลูกก่อนถึงจะกดเริ่มเกมได้
- เสียงเอฟเฟกต์และเพลง (เปิดปิดได้ในหน้าตั้งค่า)
- นับถอยหลัง 3-2-1, สโลว์โมชันตอนน็อก, เกิน 45 วินาทีเข้าโหมดเดือด ดาเมจ x2, ครบ 90 วินาทีตัดสินด้วย HP
- เล่นออนไลน์: ใส่ชื่อ สร้างห้อง ได้รหัส 5 หลัก ให้เพื่อนกรอกรหัสเข้ามาเล่นด้วยกัน
- ติดตั้งเป็นแอปได้ (Chrome: เมนู ⋮ → ติดตั้งแอป) และเปิดเล่นแบบออฟไลน์ได้

## นักสู้ 10 ตัว

| ตัว | สกิล | คูลดาวน์ | ดาเมจ |
|---|---|---|---|
| ໂຍສາຍຊອຍ (ตัวละครพิเศษ) | พุ่งเกาะศัตรูแล้วแทงมีด 3 ครั้ง ระหว่างเกาะศัตรูใช้สกิลใหม่ไม่ได้ | 3.9 วิ | 4 x 3 |
| ARCHER ธนู | ยิงธนูตรงใส่ศัตรู | 1.5 วิ | 7 |
| BOMBER ระเบิด | โยนระเบิดวงกว้าง ดีดกระเด็นไกล | 3.0 วิ | 16 |
| BLADE ใบมีด | ใบมีดหมุนรอบตัว 3 วิ ปัดธนูได้ | 4.2 วิ | 6 / ครั้ง |
| VOLT สายฟ้า | พุ่งชนด้วยความเร็วสูง | 2.6 วิ | 12 |
| GUARD โล่ | กางโล่ 1.8 วิ กันทุกอย่าง สะท้อนกลับ | 4.5 วิ | 9 |
| VAMPIRE แวมไพร์ | ลำแสงดูดเลือด เติม HP ตัวเอง | 4.2 วิ | 10 + ฮีล 5 |
| FROST น้ำแข็ง | เกล็ดน้ำแข็ง 3 อัน ทำให้สกิลศัตรูช้าลง | 2.9 วิ | 5 x 3 |
| BLAZE ไฟ | ทิ้งรอยไฟ ศัตรูเหยียบแล้วติดไฟ | 5.5 วิ | 2 / ครั้ง |
| MAGNET แม่เหล็ก | ดูดศัตรูเข้าหา ชนแล้วช็อต | 3.6 วิ | 13 |

**ไฟอันติของ ໂຍສາຍຊອຍ:** แทงโดนหรือโดนตีจะชาร์จเกจไฟ เต็มแล้วจะเปิดพลังเปลวไฟ กางปีกยมทูต พุ่งเข้าไปแทง 5 ครั้งแล้วระเบิดเป็นพลุไฟ (4 x 5 + 12) ปกติได้ใช้ประมาณ 1 ครั้งต่อเกม

ค่าพลังปรับจากการจำลองแมตช์หลายพันรอบ ทุกตัวมีอัตราชนะรวมอยู่ราว 46–52% คูลดาวน์ทุกสกิลสุ่มเพิ่มลด 15% ทุกครั้ง (สุ่มจาก seed เดียวกันทั้งสองเครื่อง) เพื่อไม่ให้จังหวะสกิลวนซ้ำจนผลแพ้ชนะตายตัว

## เล่นออนไลน์ยังไง

1. กด **เล่นออนไลน์** แล้วใส่ชื่อ
2. คนหนึ่งกด **สร้างห้อง** แล้วส่งรหัส 5 หลักให้เพื่อน
3. เพื่อนกรอกรหัสแล้วกด **เข้าห้อง**
4. ทั้งสองคนเลือกบอลของตัวเอง แล้วกด **พร้อม** เกมจะเริ่มเอง

ระบบออนไลน์ส่งข้อความผ่านเซิร์ฟเวอร์ MQTT สาธารณะฟรี (HiveMQ และ EMQX ใช้พร้อมกัน 2 ที่ ถ้าที่หนึ่งล่มยังเล่นได้) ไม่ต้องมีเซิร์ฟเวอร์ของตัวเอง ใครรู้รหัสห้องก็เห็นชื่อในห้องได้ จึงไม่ควรใส่ข้อมูลส่วนตัวในชื่อ

## โครงสร้างโค้ด

- `js/sim.js` ระบบฟิสิกส์และสกิล เขียนแบบ deterministic (seed เดียวกัน ได้ผลเหมือนกันทุกเครื่อง) เครื่องของผู้เล่นทั้งสองจึงจำลองแมตช์เองได้ โดยเจ้าของห้องส่งสถานะมาเทียบทุก 2 วินาที
- `js/fighters.js` ชื่อ สี และคำอธิบายนักสู้
- `js/draw.js` วาดสนาม ลูกบอล เอฟเฟกต์ และภาพปก
- `js/audio.js` เสียงทั้งหมดสังเคราะห์ด้วย WebAudio ไม่มีไฟล์เสียง
- `js/mqtt-lite.js`, `js/net.js` ระบบห้องออนไลน์
- `js/main.js` หน้าเมนูและการควบคุมเกม
- `sw.js`, `manifest.webmanifest` ทำให้ติดตั้งเป็นแอปและเล่นออฟไลน์ได้

## เครดิต

ฟอนต์ [Kanit](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Kanit), [Lilita One](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Lilita+One) และ [Noto Sans Lao](https://fonts.google.com/noto/specimen/Noto+Sans+Lao) ใช้สัญญาอนุญาต SIL Open Font License (ไฟล์อยู่ในโฟลเดอร์ `fonts/`)

รูปหน้าและเสียงของ ໂຍສາຍຊອຍ เป็นของเจ้าของตัวจริง ใช้เฉพาะในเกมนี้

# Healthcare Empire: Care & Beyond — เฮลท์แคร์ เอ็มไพร์

A Thai-first, single-player isometric nursing home and hospital management simulator, built in TypeScript, React, Vite, Zustand, Tailwind and PixiJS.
Specs: [`GDD.md`](GDD.md) · Coding rules: [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md)

> All prices, costs and stats are **fictional game-balancing values**. The game has no real patient data and makes no clinical recommendations.

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # http://localhost:5173
npm test           # Vitest simulation rule tests
npm run build      # type-check + production build to dist/
npm run preview    # serve the production build
```

Add `?debug` to the URL to expose `window.__HE__` (store + renderer) for automated browser tests.

## Milestone status

| Phase | Scope | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **0** | Scaffold, data models, deterministic engine, tests | ✅ Done |
| **1** | 20×20 isometric map, room building and validation, camera | ✅ Done (first playable build) |
| **2** | Residents, staff, needs, care plans, care tasks, role × shift roster | ✅ Done |
| **3** | Pricing, monthly invoices and payments, running costs, Financial Dashboard, 4 events, title screen, character portraits | ✅ Done |
| 4 | **Save/load ✅ done** · tutorial and balancing ⏳ next | 🟡 In progress |
| 5–6 | Premium living, home care, workforce, hospital, multi-site | ⏳ Not started |

## What you can play now

Everything playable today is **Chapter 1 — First Care Home** of the campaign in the concept art. Chapters 2–7 (30–80 beds, Tranquila villas, Home Care, PHC workforce, Neuro Hospital, multi-site empire) start after Phase 4.

### Visual upgrade from the Game Assets Pack

- **Art source:** sprites were cut automatically from the project's own *Game Assets Pack* (transparent PNG), using alpha-channel connected components. They're stored as WebP: 26 sprites, about 155 KB.
- **On the map:** beds, call-bell monitors, supply carts, desks, exercise balls, parallel bars and lockers are drawn as sprites instead of boxes, with the vector box kept as a fallback. A "HEALTHCARE EMPIRE" sign sits at the entrance.
- **Garden & decor (สวนและตกแต่ง):** a new build section with 10 items: shade tree, round tree, pink trumpet tree, flower bush, hedge, planter, garden lamp, patio table, fountain and gazebo.
  - Each item takes one empty tile. It can't overlap rooms, corridor, the entrance or other decor, and rooms and corridors can't be built over it.
  - Demolish refunds 50%, and each item costs ฿10/day in upkeep.
  - Each item adds *appeal*, capped at 30. Appeal slows residents' happiness decay and lifts mental well-being slightly. Tested: a lush garden keeps residents measurably happier.
  - Rooms and garden items are drawn back to front, so trees overlap correctly.
- **Pictures in the UI:** room pictures on the build cards, equipment pictures in the room inspector, and coin, people, smile and star icons in the desktop and phone top bars.
- **7-chapter journey:** a chapters screen with cards cropped from the campaign concept art. Chapter 1 shows "playing now" and its goal progress; chapters 2–7 are marked as unlocking later. It opens from the title screen, the goals header and the phone menu, and Escape closes it.
- **Save format:** schema 4 adds `site.decor`. Older schema-3 saves are migrated automatically on load (tested).

### Save system (Phase 4, part 1)

- **Autosave:**
  - At the start of every game day, every 60 s of real time while something changed, and whenever the tab is hidden or closed. Phones kill background tabs, so the hidden-tab save matters most there.
  - A fresh, untouched game is never autosaved, so opening the page can't overwrite a real save.
- **Slots:** one autosave plus three manual slots. Each slot shows the day, time, cash, residents, staff, reputation, how long ago it was saved, and where the newest copy lives. Overwrite, load and delete each need a second tap.
- **Opening the game:** the title screen offers **เล่นต่อ** (continue the newest save, showing its day and cash), **เกมใหม่** and **โหลดเกม**.
- **Where saves live:**
  - **This browser:** IndexedDB via Dexie, falling back to memory if IndexedDB is blocked.
  - **Your account:** on the published page, saves also go to the player's private space through the page's `db` capability (`data/users/<id>/save-<slot>`). Nobody else can read it, the page owner included. Loading picks whichever copy is newer, so a game saved on a phone continues on a PC for the same signed-in player.
  - **Offline or blocked:** without the cloud (signed out, view-only access, offline), saves stay in the browser and the save panel says so.
- **Format:**
  - Versioned (`format` 1, `schemaVersion` 3). It holds the complete `GameState` gzip-compressed (about 10× smaller), so a reloaded game continues exactly as the original would.
  - Cloud saves above 200,000 characters are split into parts, keeping every document under the 256 KiB limit.
  - Loading validates the structure and the cash-ledger invariant. Damaged, tampered or unsupported saves are refused with a message, never half-loaded.
- **Loading** pauses the game and resets the view.

### Phone layout (screens under 1024 px)

- **Layout:** the active view fills the screen. A compact top bar holds the day and time, speed, cash and today's change, occupancy, satisfaction and reputation. It also has a bell with an alert count, which opens tasks, alerts and the dashboard, and a ⋯ menu for language and new game.
- **Bottom tab bar:** Map · Residents · Shift schedule · Finance · Manage. Manage opens build, hire and admit as a bottom sheet.
- **Building:**
  - Tap 🏗 สร้าง, pick a tool, and the sheet closes so you can drag on the map with one finger. A "Placing: … / Done" chip shows what you're placing.
  - Tap a room to open its details sheet: equipment, demolish, tasks, alerts.
- **Map controls:** pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. A second finger cancels a half-drawn room without placing it. The map refits when the

rysev-a/game.readme:
# Игра-детектив (браузер, three.js)

**Играть онлайн: https://rysev-a.github.io/game/** · ДЕМО-площадка: https://rysev-a.github.io/game/demo/

На телефоне и планшете игра включает сенсорное управление сама и играется только горизонтально
(при первом касании — на весь экран). Слева — джойстик, очерченный кругами, правая часть экрана — провести пальцем,
чтобы крутить камеру, двумя пальцами — масштаб. Мирный режим: справа внизу одна кнопка «в бой», касание человека,
двери или машины рядом — сразу действие (разговор, войти, сесть или выйти), подсказка внизу — тоже кнопка.
Боевой режим (касание кнопки «в бой» или оружия в ряду внизу): кнопка справа становится прицелом — зажать и держать —
огонь, не отпуская вести палец влево/вправо — поворот, вверх/вниз — смена оружия; свайп по ряду оружия тоже меняет
оружие, кнопка 🕊 слева внизу — обратно в мирный режим. Легким наклоном телефона (гироскоп) прицел на земле точно
доводится на цель; гироскоп выключается в настройках. За рулем вместо джойстика слева педали газа и тормоза, коробка P/R/D/M (D — без газа машина ползет сама, M — справа передачи 1–6 стрелками), ручник (держать на ходу и рулить — занос со следами шин; на гоночных газ с ручником — дрифт) и скорость в км/ч над ними; руль — наклон телефона, без датчика — кнопки ◀ ▶ (`src/engine/touch-drive.js`); в ДЕМО рядом с настройками канистра: +полбака. Выйти из машины — кнопка 🚪 рядом с оружием (на ходу машина сперва сама остановится). Слева внизу — тонкие полоски жизни и эликсира и значок
инвентаря: он раскрывается на весь экран, сверху 10 слотов сохранения (касание пустого — сохранить, заполненного —
загрузить; после этого инвентарь закрывается), под ними слева вещи, справа то, что на герое и в руках.
На компьютере его можно проверить, добавив `?touch` к адресу.

Сюжет, персонажи, квесты и локации описаны в [docs/story](docs/story/README.md).
ДЕМО-площадка для проверки механик — `demo/index.html` (на сайте `/demo/`, см. [docs/mechanics/demo.md](docs/mechanics/demo.md)).
Как будут устроены квесты, диалоги, инвентарь, крафт, приборы, бои и головоломки — в [docs/mechanics](docs/mechanics/README.md).

Открывать через любой локальный сервер, например `python3 -m http.server`, и перейти на `index.html`.
(По `file://` звук и некоторые браузеры могут ругаться, а `game.json` не прочитается.)

Игра — набор классических `<script>`-файлов без сборщика. Они делят общую область видимости,
поэтому **порядок подключения в `index.html` важен**: файл использует то, что подключено выше.

```
index.html         страница: HUD, инвентарь, подсказки и порядок скриптов
game.json          настройки истории: дата начала (gameStartDate), время старта и скорость хода времени
audio/             звуки
src/
  models/          3D-модели без логики: человек с наборами (person.js: 20 персонажей сюжета по листу
                   docs/art/characters.png, прохожие: полицейский, пожилой, ребенок и др.), машина, дом, магазин, интерьер торгового центра, библиотека (library.js),
                   офис IT-компании и генератор (office.js), огромное дерево с домиком (treehouse.js),
                   уличные мелочи (props.js: скамейка, фонарь, лиственное дерево, куст),
                   вещи — объемные пиксельные модели по значкам инвентаря (items.js); demo.html — витрина людей,
                   characters.html — все персонажи сюжета сеткой, как на листе (?set=bosses — боссы)
  engine/          движок: сцена, раскладка мира, помощники, коллизии, интерьеры, здания-заготовки (buildings.js:
                   defineBuilding / placeBuilding, комнаты createRoomFloor), взаимодействие по E,
                   панель «что это» справа (hoverinfo.js),
                   диалоги, игровые часы (clock.js), настройки, управление (input.js; сенсорное — touch.js),
                   звук, миникарта, главный цикл (game.js)
  world/           мир: дороги, земля, машины, люди, сборка мира (world.js), лес, забор, погода
  player/          игрок: ходьба и камера (player.js), инвентарь, машина и вождение (driving.js),
                   дом с интерьером и гаражом (home.js), разговоры с людьми (talk.js),
                   перемещение кликом по карте (travel.js), ходьба кликом по земле (click-move.js), значки (icons.js) и сохранения (saves.js)
  content/
    buildings/     заготовки зданий: библиотека, IT-компания, домик на дереве и дом Анны Петровны
  locations/
    village/       поселок: 6 двухэтажных домов с участками, заборами, жильцами и машинами
    city/          торговый центр (mall.js), шесть городов (city.js), заправка (gas-station.js),
                   библиотека и IT-компания в городе 1 (city-buildings.js)
    zarechye/      дом Анны Петровны, участок, овраг с бревном и дерево с домиком (grandma.js)
    bridge/        река с мостом (bridge.js) и сцена у реки — завязка детектива (incident.js)
```

Как добавить новое здание: описать заготовку `defineBuilding(id, …)` в `src/content/buildings/` (модель,
интерьер, станции, жильцы — относительно центра) и поставить ее в мир `placeBuilding(id, { x, z, heading })`.
В ДЕМО она появится сама, в ряду зданий — пустой и полной.

Как добавить новое место: положить файл в свою папку, внутри вызвать `registerZone(...)`
(звук по координатам), `clearZones.push(...)` (где не растет лес), `addObstacle(...)` (стены),
`addInteractable(...)` (что делает E), подключить в `index.html` после зависимостей и до `src/world/world.js`.

## Правила мира

- **Мир.** Круглый: радиус `worldRadius` = 1100 с центром `worldCenter` (`src/engine/layout.js`), по границе — круговой забор
  (`src/world/fence.js`), выйти или выехать за него нельзя (`insideWorldCircle` в `blockedOutside`/`insideWorld`). Карта мира —
  квадрат 2200 × 2200 (описанный квадрат круга). Шесть городов (`cities` в `src/locations/city/city.js`): города 1–2 на трассе
  (z = 0), города 3–6 на севере и юге, к каждому от трассы идет своя дорога; у каждого города свои цвета, 8 прохожих
  и своя зона звука. Новый город: запись в `cities` (x, z, цвета).

laurenceroblox1-bit/hoi4-browser.readme:
# Iron Fronts — WW2 Grand Strategy in the Browser

A Hearts of Iron IV–inspired grand strategy game that runs entirely in your browser. No install, no build step.

## Play

Open `index.html` in Chrome, Firefox or Edge (double-clicking it works). If you'd rather use a local server: `python3 -m http.server`, then open http://localhost:8000.

## Features

- **World map, 1 January 1936**: ~3,200 provinces built from Natural Earth borders and redrawn to 1936 (British Raj, French and Italian Africa, Manchukuo, the Chinese warlords, Dutch East Indies, …). HoI4-style country labels, cities and victory points, sea zones, winter snow and autumn mud. Map modes: political, factions, ideology, terrain, industry.
- **World leaders**: about 80 nations, each with its 1936 leader. The major powers change leaders on historical dates (Baldwin → Chamberlain → Churchill, FDR → Truman, and so on). Portraits are loaded from Wikipedia while you play; if they can't load (for example offline), a drawn portrait is shown instead.
- **Division designer**: a 5×5 grid of combat battalions plus support companies (infantry, cavalry, mountaineers, marines, paratroopers, motorized, mechanized, light, medium and heavy tanks, artillery, anti-tank, anti-air, engineers, recon, hospitals, logistics, signal, and more). Stats update as you edit.
- **Research**: 9 categories, about 60 technologies, with an ahead-of-time penalty, doctrines and extra research slots.
- **Production and construction**: military factories produce equipment, civilian factories build new factories, and dockyards build ships.
- **Land combat**: soft and hard attack, defense, breakthrough, organization, armor and piercing, combat width, terrain, entrenchment, supply and encirclement, air support, and amphibious landings.
- **Navy**: battleships, carriers, cruisers, destroyers and submarines fight battles in sea zones. Also covers naval invasions, raiding and repair in port.
- **Air**: fighters, CAS, tactical and naval bombers. Missions are air superiority, close air support, strategic bombing and naval strike, and you can watch the planes fly.
- **Unit models**: tanks, infantry, artillery, ships and planes are drawn for each nation.
- **Diplomacy**: declare war, make peace, factions (Allies, Comintern, Axis), guarantees and military access.
- **Historical events**: Anschluss, Fall Weiss, the Winter War, Fall Gelb, Barbarossa, Pearl Harbor and more. You can turn them off.
- **Test menu** (`` ` `` key): cheats, spawn armies and fleets, start wars, annex countries, switch nations, jump in time, start a test battle, and a command console.
- Save and load (F5 / F9), stored in your browser.

## Controls

Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Left-click a unit counter to select it (Shift-click to add more, Shift- or Ctrl-drag to box-select), then right-click a province to move or attack. Space pauses, +/- change speed.

Hotkeys: L politics · R research · G diplomacy · P production · B construction · A recruit · D designer · O army · N navy · F air · `` ` `` test menu.

## Rebuilding the map

`tools/build-map.js` generates `js/data/world.js`:

```
npm i world-atlas@2 topojson-client d3-delaunay polygon-clipping
node tools/build-map.js
```

AISA-AI-web/arcade.readme:
# pD-Day 2026

An explore-the-school game for the AISA AI PD days (19–20 October 2026), in **English and Arabic**.

Teachers walk around a school with Leo the lion. Each room holds a quest that matches a real station table in the PD room:

1. Read the briefing. It sends the teacher to that station's table so colleagues on the same quest can help each other.
2. Tick off the missions. Each one has step-by-step help and screenshots from the station guide.
3. Pass Leo's quiz to earn the badge.

Earning all six station badges unlocks *Leader of the Pride*, and the badge case prints a certificate.

| Room | Station | Guide |
|------|---------|-------|
| The Level-Up Library | 1 · Differentiation & Scaffolding | `Station-1-Differentiation/` |
| The Deck Studio | 2 · Polished Lesson Decks, Fast | `Station-2-Lesson-Decks/` |
| The Hook Arena | 3 · Engagement & Active Participation | `Station-3-Engagement/` |
| The Screening Room | 4 · Turn Your Slides into a Video | `Station-4-Lesson-Video/` |
| The Code Arcade | 5 · Code Your Own Class Activities | `Station-5-Coding-Activities/` |
| The Data Vault | 6 · Student Data Anonymizer | [aisa-ai-web.github.io/data-anonymizer](https://aisa-ai-web.github.io/data-anonymizer/) |

The game also has a staff lounge, wandering colleagues and seven secret achievements. They're there for fun, so go and find them.

## Playing

- **Move:** arrow keys or WASD, or click where you want to go.
- **Talk / interact:** E, Space or Enter, or click on the thing.
- **Panels:** Q opens Quests, B opens Badges, M opens the Map. Esc closes a window.
- **Language:** use the globe button (top right), the title screen switch, or open `index.html?lang=ar`.
- **Shortcuts:** the quest log can open any quest directly, or *walk me there*.

Progress (first name, look, badges) is saved in the browser on that laptop only. Nothing is sent anywhere. The only outside request is for the Google Fonts.

## Files

```
index.html          the game
stations.html       the plain list of station guides (was index.html)
Station-*/          the station guides and screenshots
game/content.js     ← all quest text, quizzes, badges, jokes and UI text (English + Arabic)
game/world.js       builds the school map and draws the rooms and furniture
game/game.js        movement, Leo, quests, badges, sound, panels, language switching
game/art.js         Leo's portraits, the badge emblems and the UI icons (SVG)
game/styles.css     the interface (AISA brand: DM Sans / Cairo, #21076C, #D8B664)
```

No build step and no libraries. It's static files, so GitHub Pages (or any web server) can host it as-is.

## Editing the content

Everything a teacher reads is in **`game/content.js`**.

- Each piece of text is `{ en: '…', ar: '…' }`. If `ar` is missing, the English is shown.
- Wrap a button or menu name in `**double stars**`, e.g. `'Click **Generate**'`. It shows as a highlighted label and keeps the right direction inside Arabic sentences.
- `{name}` becomes the player's first name.

### Adding a station

Copy one quest object in `PD.quests`, then:

1. Give it a new `id` and `station` number.
2. Choose a `color`, a `theme` (`library`, `studio`, `arena`, `cinema`, `lab` or `vault`) and a badge `icon` (`levels`, `slides`, `hook`, `clapper`, `code`, `vault`, `paw`, `crown`, `coffee`, `paper`, `fridge`, `heart`, `compass`, `wall`, `bell`).
3. Point `dir` / `guide` at the station's folder, or set `guide` to a full URL.

The school grows a new room automatically. Rooms fill the top row first, then the bottom row, so a 7th or 8th station adds a column.

## Publishing on GitHub Pages

In the repository, open **Settings → Pages** and set **Source** to *Deploy from a branch* with branch `main` and folder `/ (root)`. The game is then at `https://aisa-ai-web.github.io/arcade/`.
