AldericCOROIR/mermaid-ocean.readme:
# Mermaid Ocean 🧜‍♀️

A gentle 3D underwater fairy-tale adventure for young children (made for a 6-year-old), playable in a phone browser. Built with [three.js](https://threejs.org) r180, no build step.

## Play

**Play online:** https://aldericcoroir.github.io/mermaid-ocean/ (always the latest version on `main`, rebuilt by GitHub Pages on every push).

Or run it locally:

Open `index.html` through any static web server:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8123   # then open http://<your-computer-ip>:8123
```

On Windows, use `python tools/serve.py` so JavaScript modules get the correct
MIME type. That helper binds to localhost; use a server bound to your LAN
address when testing from a separate phone.

Controls: left thumb = floating joystick, drag anywhere else to look around, ⬆️/⬇️ to swim up and down, ✨ to talk (💬) or do a speed dash. Swim up fast to leap out of the water. Desktop: WASD/arrows, Q/E for down/up, mouse drag to look, Space to talk/dash.

## What's inside

- **World** (`src/world.js`): seabed with dancing caustics, kelp forest, coral reef (branch, brain, lace-fan, tube, table corals, anemones), rock arch, glowing crystal trench, light shafts, shimmering surface, marine snow, bubble vents.
- **Coralia, the mermaid castle** (`src/city.js`): a large oval walled city with a walk-through shell portal, thirteen outer shell towers, eighteen shell homes, sixteen striped open-front shops, lower market lanes, a raised pearl-fountain court, four stair routes, a higher palace terrace, two raised side bridges, and an enterable throne hall with library and music aisles. The fountains have moving water and ripples. The broad steps carry the player up during normal forward swimming.
- **Characters** (`src/mermaid.js`): procedural chibi mermaids & merman guards with swimming tail animation.
- **Creatures** (`src/creatures.js`): fish schools (clownfish, blue tang, sunny fish, angelfish) that scatter around you, whale, dolphins that leap, seahorses, crabs, jellyfish, sea turtle, manta rays, pufferfish that puff up, octopus.
- **Story** (`src/quests.js`): meet Queen Coralie → find 5 magic pearls (crown reward) → bring baby seahorse Lulu home → sing with the whale → light the 3 crystals in the Deep Trench → rainbow tail. Six named district residents turn toward the player and tell short stories. Three optional castle quests reward a coral hair clip, sea-glass top and sapphire tail. The 👗 wardrobe previews and equips earned cosmetics and saves them on the device. A sparkle trail and floating star guide the main story.
- **Look** (`src/post.js`): one full-screen pass with depth of field focused on the mermaid, a Kuwahara painterly filter, soft ink edges, canvas grain and an underwater grade. Toggle in ⚙️.
- **Voice** (`src/audio.js`): every line, new goal, pearl and new friend is read aloud by the browser's speech voice (pitch per character) so children who can't read yet can follow the quest; tap the ⭐ quest pill to hear the goal again. No music or sound effects.
- English & French (auto from the phone language), progress saved on the device, automatic quality drop on slow phones.

## Painted look

Two layers make the 3D world look hand-painted:

1. **Painted surfaces** (`src/brushwork.js`): seamless painted tiles in `assets/swatch/` (sand, rock, coral, kelp, shell, brush strokes, generated with Codex/GPT Image from the concept frames) are laid on every object with triplanar mapping and tinted by the object's colour. Moving creatures carry their strokes with them.
2. **Projected paintings** (`src/projection.js`): following the "paint over the blocks, project it back" process: clean camera plates of the plain 3D world were painted with the [district references and prompts](painted/districts/prompts.md), then projected back from those exact cameras (`src/paintviews.js`). Four v4 paintings cover the aerial, lower market, fountain court and palace. Three v2 paintings still cover the throne hall, library and music gallery. Exterior plates remain visible from farther away; only the nearest exterior camera contributes at a time. The repeatable no-blur comparison is `?shot=overview&compare=1`.

Rebuild helpers: `tools/make_paintviews.py` (plates/cams.json + paintings → `src/paintviews.js` and `assets/paint/`), `tools/make_swatches.py` (paintings → seamless tiles and `src/swatches.js`).

## Screenshots & painterly concept pass

`tools/shoot.mjs` renders fixed camera views with headless Chromium (`?shot=overview|market|fountain|palace|westbridge|eastbridge`). `compare=1` disables depth-of-field and post-paint blur while keeping the geometry and projected colors. `clean=1&raw=1` produces a plain block plate for imagegen paint-over.

```sh
npm i -D playwright && node tools/shoot.mjs shots
```

Run `node tools/castle_playtest.mjs` with the server on port 8123 to check routes
from the gate to the market, fountain, both bridges, garden and palace rooms.
`node tools/check_revision.mjs` checks the mobile wardrobe, cosmetic reward,
save persistence and terrace heights. On Windows, set `CHROME_PATH` to the
installed Chrome or Edge executable to use its browser without downloading
Playwright's Chromium.

Compare the [overhead concept](painted/castle_overview_concept.png) with the
[current in-game no-blur overhead capture](painted/castle_game_overview_v4.png).
The camera is repeatable with `?shot=overview&compare=1` on the local or hosted game.

codemaskdev/aaa-snake.readme:
# AAA Snake

Snake, turned into a AAA game one industry habit per patch. A tiny, honest Snake (v1.0) gets ten patches of big-game
clichés (logos, a day-one patch, a story, always online, an open world, a skill tree, a season pass, a remaster, a Game
of the Year Edition), and every patch is measured: how long until the first apple, and how much of that time you
actually control the snake. Built with Claude Code for the CodeMask channel.

- **A parody.** Nothing is for sale: every shop, currency and loot box is fake, there is no payment code, and the game
  makes no request outside its own site. The publisher, studio and engine are invented.
- **Synthetic voices.** Warden Snek and the host of the shorts are generated with ElevenLabs text-to-speech (see
  Disclosure below).
- **Play it:** https://codemaskdev.github.io/aaa-snake/ adds one patch a day, at 19:00 UTC+3. Locally: `npm run serve`,
  then http://localhost:8080/, or open any `dist/<version>/index.html`.
- **Measure it:** `npm install`, `npx playwright install chromium`, then `npm run measure <version>`. The numbers in
  the series are single runs, in `measurements/`.
- **Site:** `npm run publish:day` runs the Pages workflow by hand, if a scheduled run was missed. It needs `gh`, logged
  in with access to the repository.

## Commands (Node 22+)

```
npm install                 # playwright 1.63.0, the only dependency (dev)
npx playwright install chromium
npm test                    # game rules, determinism, the rig, the chart, the recorder
npm run build <version>     # copy src/ to dist/<version>/ (never overwrites)
npm run measure <version>   # one headless and one visible run -> measurements/<version>.json, summary.csv ("single run")
npm run measure:final <version>  # 5 + 5 runs and their medians (not used: the series uses the single runs)
npm run reevaluate <version>  # the frame rate again from the saved runs, with the current rules
npm run fps-check           # headless vs visible window frame rate, on test loads
npm run chart               # measurements/summary.csv -> out/bloat.png
npm run short <version>     # 30-second vertical short -> out/shorts/<version>/
npm run short -- trailer v1.0 v2.0  # the trailer -> out/shorts/trailer/
npm run build-site          # the GitHub Pages site for today (UTC+3) -> site/; RELEASE_TODAY=YYYY-MM-DD to test
npm run publish:day         # gh workflow run pages.yml: publish today's patch if a scheduled run was missed
npm run voice               # voice/LINES.md, placeholders, and src/voice/ copied into every build
npm run voice -- --check    # every voice line against its slot, and every build against src/voice/
npm run voice -- --record   # record the 17 lines with the ElevenLabs API (needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment)
npm run voice -- --record host  # record the host's lines for the shorts (voice/HOST.md) into voice/host/
npm run play-share          # control share in play, from the saved runs of every version
```

`npm run measure` opens visible Chromium windows for its frame-rate runs.

## Methods

- **During the build** (since prompt 13), `npm run measure <version>` does one headless run (every metric but frame
  rate) and one run in a visible window (frame rate); measurements/summary.csv marks such a row "single run" and the
  chart puts a * after its version. The game and the bot are deterministic (v1.7's headless runs 1 and 2 both reached
  the first apple on tick 7595), so more runs would only measure timer noise.
- **Before release**, `npm run measure:final <version>` measures every version again with 5 headless and 5 visible
  runs and takes medians ("median of 5 runs"). v1.0 to v1.6 were measured that way during the build already.
- **A game that ends before 60 s of control** (v2.0, prompt 15): both control-share metrics are computed over the
  actual window up to THE END (control time / time until the end screen), and the summary.csv row and the chart mark
  it "game ended at N s". Time to first apple is unaffected. The JS heap is then read when the game has ended, and the
  frame rate is taken over the control frames the run had.
- **Frame rate with under one whole second of control** (v2.0, prompt 16): the median is taken over individual frames
  (1000 / frame ms) instead of per-second counts, the summary.csv `fps_window` cell says "median over N frames", and
  the budget check uses it. `npm run reevaluate <version>` applies the rules to a version's saved runs without
  measuring again.
- Numbers are written as measured, never rounded; every run's raw data is kept under measurements/<version>/.

## Shorts

`npm run short <version>` replays the version's median measured run on a virtual clock into a 1080 x 1920 video,
25 to 30 s. v1.0 has its own plan (its file is kept; it is not published on its own); every later version follows one
fixed plan. From frame 0 every short shows the same premise line at the top, "I turned Snake into a AAA game.", and
under it the patch line, "Patch 1.4: online only." (the version and its short name from UPDATES.md), then the patch
note. All three shrink to fit their box, and the recorder fails if any text spills out of it.

- **A** (3 s): the previous version reaches its first apple at real speed. No voice.
- **B** (3 s): the new version's patch note.
- **C**: the new version from launch to 2 s before its first apple, sped up: 16 s of clip at the largest step of
  0.05x that does not make it shorter, 4x while that fits in 21 s, faster only beyond; and faster again, in steps of
  0.05x, if the whole short would otherwise pass 30 s. The speed shows next to the premise line.
- **D**: the first apple at real speed, from 2 s before it until Warden Snek's line after it has been said in full
  (apple + 600 ms + the line's recorded length); for a version without voice lines, until 1 s after the apple. v2.0's
  D runs to the first frame of the credits (tools/short/plans.json), so it may end under 25 s.

The sound track is silence except that line

drivers, RGB and fans included, no terminal required.** [**Download**](https://sourceforge.net/projects/frametide-os/files/) · [Features](#-features) · [Screenshots](#-screenshots) · [Comparison](docs/COMPARISON.md) · [Build it yourself](#-build-it-yourself) · [Deutsch](README.de.md)
--- ## Why Frametide? Most gaming distros are built for Linux enthusiasts (CachyOS), one specific piece of hardware (SteamOS) or pure gaming (Bazzite). **Frametide is built for people who are leaving Windows** and want to keep everything working: games, office work and their hardware.
### 🎮 Hardware that just works Your graphics driver is set up on first boot: NVIDIA, AMD or Intel, including Secure Boot **without MOK enrollment**. RGB lighting and fan curves for almost every vendor are managed from one app. ### 🧰 Everything from day one Steam, Proton, GameMode and MangoHud are pre-installed. The **ArtCraft** suite gives you Word-, Excel-, PowerPoint- and PDF-style apps. Chrome, VS Code and GitHub Desktop are ready after the first boot. ### 🛡️ Stable, yet tuned Built on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS with **5 years of updates**. On top come low-latency kernel settings, `ntsync` for Proton, zram and a calm, minimal GNOME desktop.
## ✨ Features | | | |---|---| | **🚀 Zero-touch drivers** | `frametide-hwsetup` detects every GPU and installs the right driver, the 32-bit libraries for Steam, kernel parameters and hybrid-graphics support. It runs in the background and never slows down boot. | | **🛒 Frametide Store** | 95 hand-picked apps with real logos, a search across all of Flathub, and one-click **dev environments** (Python AI with CUDA/ROCm, Arch with AUR, Node.js, Rust, Go, .NET) in containers. | | **🎛️ Frametide Center** | One place for updates (system, Flatpak, ArtCraft, firmware), GPU drivers including the NVIDIA version picker, **RGB & fans** and performance options. | | **🕹️ Game check** | Shows for every Steam game whether it runs on Linux (ProtonDB) and whether **anti-cheat blocks it** (AreWeAntiCheatYet). This works for games you don't own yet, too. | | **🪟 Move from Windows** | Brings over your documents, photos, bookmarks (Chrome, Edge, Firefox …), Wi-Fi networks and installed Steam games, so they don't need to be downloaded again. Windows itself is only read, never changed. | | **📊 Frametide Bench** | A reproducible benchmark for CPU, memory, latency under load, SSD, GPU and boot time. Its JSON results can be compared against any other system. | | **🧭 Clear, classic desktop** | GNOME with a classic categorized *Applications* menu, an always-visible dock with your key apps, and app folders instead of an endless icon wall. A welcome screen on first login shows you around. | | **⚡ Fast & quiet** | Hidden boot menu, no waiting for the network, no Snap, no telemetry. Updates run with idle priority so they never steal frames. | | **🎹 Synthwave sound theme** | Custom retro-modern system sounds and a startup jingle made with analog-style synths, arpeggios and echo. | | **🌍 10 languages offline** | German, English, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Dutch, Turkish and Russian. | ## 📸 Screenshots

# ナイター対決

スマホのブラウザで遊べる、どうぶつたちの3D野球アクション。

- **ストーリー**：柴犬チーム「しばいぬズ」で、どうぶつリーグ優勝を目指す（全4話）
- **フリー対戦**：CPU相手に打つ・投げる
- **オンライン対戦**：部屋番号で友達と1対1（3回表裏）

## 遊び方

- 打つ：ボールがミットに届く直前に、ボールが通る位置をタップ
- 投げる：指を弾く向きで球種、指を離した位置でコース、弾く速さで球速
- 作戦：投球前に画面下のボタンから盗塁・エンドラン・バント・スクイズ

## 開発

```
node build.mjs     # src/ から docs/index.html を作る
```

公開は GitHub Pages（main ブランチの `/docs`）。構成と約束ごとは `CLAUDE.md` を参照。

## 実況の音声ファイル

実況は、`docs/audio/<id>.mp3` があればそのファイルを再生する（無いセリフは字幕だけ）。ファイルを足したら `node build.mjs` で一覧が更新される。
セリフの一覧は `node tools/export-voice-script.mjs` で `voice-script.csv`（id・セリフ・読み方）に出る。
AI音声などで作ったファイルを id の名前（例 `hr_1.mp3`）で `docs/audio/` に置いてコミットすればよい。

## スマホにアプリとして入れる

https://hojo0729.github.io/baseball/ をスマホのブラウザで開き、Chrome なら メニュー → 「アプリをインストール」（または「ホーム画面に追加」）。iPhone の Safari は 共有 → 「ホーム画面に追加」。全画面で開き、一度開いたあとは電波が弱くても起動する（オンライン対戦は通信が必要）。

nullsatori/game-jam-0.readme:
# game-jam-0

Игра для двухдневного геймджема. Тема — **Trash**, предмет — **Rocket**.
Unreal Engine 5.8, C++.

## Концепт

Космос, мусор, корабль, нулевая гравитация. Шутер от первого лица.

Главное — физика: ощущение перемещения, смешные столкновения, движение,
которое можно просчитать.
- Двигаешься толчками от мусора и отдачей стволов.
- Мусор можно толкать и швырять в цели по инерции.
- Лут физический: большую деталь тащишь на себе или толкаешь к кораблю.
- На этих механиках строятся простые пространственные головоломки.

Подробно: [Concept](Docs/Concept.md).

## Что реализовано

Карта `Lvl_Jam_Ship` (стартовая) — серый блок-аут концепта: каюта с
гравитацией и шлюзом, разбитый корабль, листы обшивки, топливо за поясом
камней, навигационный модуль и дробовик на планетоиде, груз. Пешка одна и
та же физическая: в каюте и на планетоиде она ходит (WASD, прыжок Space), а
снаружи летает в невесомости, без подмены пешки. По планетоиду ходишь
ногами, как в меню Psychonauts: гравитация к центру шара, уйти — прыжок и
второй прыжок в воздухе (реактивный толчок). Свет: бирюзовая
звезда, фиолетовое небо со звёздами, тёплая каюта. Подробно:
[Ship-Blockout](Docs/Ship-Blockout.md).

Карта `Lvl_Jam_ZeroG` — полигон невесомости:
- **Невесомость.** Тело 100 кг, скорость сохраняется. Вращение только мышью,
  удары и трос тело не крутят.
- **Маневровые** WASD, Space, Ctrl. Основное движение: разгон до 5 м/с
  вдоль ввода, кислород не тратят. X — стабилизатор, плавно гасит скорость.
- **Толчок** (ПКМ): от того, что перед глазами. От лёгкого мусора он
  улетает, от тяжёлого улетаешь ты.
- **Захват** (E): физическая связь с предметом, предмет держится перед
  камерой. Тяжёлый тянет тебя, бросок (ЛКМ) отталкивает в обратную сторону.
- **Трос** (T): буксировка предмета.
- **Стволы с отдачей** (1/2/3, R — перезарядка): пистолет, дробовик, снапа.
  Отдача двигает тебя, попадание толкает цель.
- **Просчёт траектории** (держать Shift): путь толчка, отдачи или броска с
  первым отскоком.
- **Столкновения:** урон, звук и тряска. Быстрый тяжёлый предмет бьёт
  стекло.
- **Кислород:** тратится только на дыхание, баллоны пополняют.
- **Стыковочная зона корабля:** считает детали с тегом `Ship.Part`.
- **Читаемость движения:** FOV 134 и линза бодикама из MindKore, пыль вокруг камеры, метка курса и
  скорости на HUD.

Все числа — в настройках компонентов. Описание с числами:
[ZeroG](Docs/ZeroG.md) · [Tether-Prediction](Docs/Tether-Prediction.md) ·
[DockZone](Docs/DockZone.md) · [RecoilWeapons](Docs/RecoilWeapons.md)

## Модули из MindKore

Перенесены и работают, у каждого есть описание в `Docs/`. Проверить можно на
наземной карте `Lvl_Jam_TestRoom`.

| Модуль | Что делает | Описание |
|---|---|---|
| Interaction | «посмотрел — нажал E» | [Interaction](Docs/Interaction.md) |
| Doors-Keys-Locks | двери, ключи, засовы | [Doors-Keys-Locks](Docs/Doors-Keys-Locks.md) |
| Switches-Gates-Shelf | рубильники, ворота, сдвижной стеллаж, лифт, лампы | [Switches-Gates-Shelf](Docs/Switches-Gates-Shelf.md) |
| Carry-Props | физические предметы, перенос и бросок | [Carry-Props](Docs/Carry-Props.md) |
| Fastener | вскрытие досок и решёток ломом | [Fastener](Docs/Fastener.md) |
| Glass | процедурно бьющееся стекло | [Glass](Docs/Glass.md) |
| Impacts-Vitals | попадания по зонам, здоровье, броня | [Impacts-Vitals](Docs/Impacts-Vitals.md) |
| BulletTime | замедление времени (Q) | [BulletTime](Docs/BulletTime.md) |
| JamCharacter | наземная пешка | [JamCharacter](Docs/JamCharacter.md) |

Лицензии контента: [CREDITS](CREDITS.md).

## Открыть и собрать

1. Установить UE 5.8, Visual Studio с C++ и [Git LFS](https://git-lfs.com).
   Выполнить `git lfs install`, затем клонировать репозиторий.
2. Открыть `MKJamStarter.uproject`. Редактор предложит собрать модуль —
   согласиться. Можно собрать и из PowerShell:

   ```powershell
   & "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat" MKJamStarterEditor Win64 Development -Project="<путь>\MKJamStarter.uproject" -WaitMutex
   ```

Карты собираются скриптами `Scripts/build_zerog.py` и
`Scripts/build_test_room.py`:

```
UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe <путь>\MKJamStarter.uproject -ExecutePythonScript="<путь>/Scripts/build_zerog.py" -unattended -nop4 -nosplash -nullrhi
```

Модуль называется `MindKore`: так перенесённый код работает без правок.
Новый код — файлы `Jam*.h/.cpp` в `Source/MindKore`.

## Git LFS

- Все двоичные файлы (`.uasset`, `.umap`, `.fbx`, `.wav`, `.png` и т. д.)
  идут через LFS. Новый арт кладётся в `Content/JamArt/`.
- `.uasset` и `.umap` блокируемые. Перед правкой —
  `git lfs lock <файл>`, после push — `git lfs unlock <файл>`. Кто что держит:
  `git lfs locks`.
- Квота LFS общая на аккаунт и почти занята, поэтому текстуры не больше 2K,
  исходники (`.blend`, `.psd`) в репозиторий не класть.

# Pocket Snake

A classic Snake game in one HTML file (no build step, no dependencies). It works in Safari on Mac and iPhone.

## Play

- **Mac:** open `index.html` in Safari or Chrome. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer, Space to pause, M to turn music on or off, Enter to restart.
- **iPhone:** host the file anywhere (GitHub Pages works), open it in Safari, then tap Share → **Add to Home Screen**. It then opens full screen like an app. Keep your thumb on the big steering pad and slide it toward a direction to turn, or swipe on the game screen.

## Features

- 20×20 board; walls wrap around, so only running into yourself ends the game
- Starts slow and speeds up a little with every piece of food
- Every 10 points: new level, new handset colors, confetti, a level-up jingle and faster music
- Chiptune background music and sound effects, made in the browser (no audio files)
- Keyboard, swipe and a large thumb steering pad; queued turns so quick double-turns register
- Best score is saved on the device
- Pauses on its own when you switch apps or tabs
- Respects iPhone safe areas (notch / home indicator) and blocks accidental zoom

## Hosting on GitHub Pages

Repository Settings → Pages → deploy from this branch, root folder. The game will be at `https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/`.

joemizumoto2/newgame.readme:
# 建国サクセス（プロトタイプ）

中世の架空の大陸で国を建て、30年かけて育てるブラウザゲームの試作。選んだことが国の挿絵に残り、何年か後に出来事として返ってくる。

遊べるページ: https://claude.ai/artifact/SBiQpEYof3u7KPHrs6X6qK

- `index.html` … Artifact 用のページ本体（`<!doctype>` などの外枠は公開時に付く）
- `docs/story-v2.md` … v2（王と家臣の版）の物語の骨組み。v3 では使っていない

## 版

- v1：8問（効果を表示）→ 100年・10期の育成 → NPC と5連戦
- v2：プロローグ → 8問（効果は伏せ、建国時に公開）→ 初代王の治世30年（事業カード、家臣4人の物語、宿敵ヴァルド）→ 治世中の3戦 → 王の称号
- v3：名前のある登場人物をやめ、選択そのものを物語にした。8問（効果は伏せる）→ 建国30年（事業カード。建てたものが国の挿絵に増え、数年後に伏線として出来事が返ってくる）→ 3戦（過去の選択が効く）→ 国の呼び名と「選択のつながり」

## コンセプト

WordBlade（文字がコマになって戦う）、スイカゲーム、動物タワーバトルの型を分解して得た式で作る。

> 既に遊び方が知られた器 × 誰でも持っている入力 × 入れた中身で結果が変わる

### 守る条件

1. 器は誰でも知っている遊び（押し合い、陣取り、じゃんけんの延長）
2. 入力は**選ぶだけ**（手書き・撮影は重い）
3. 選んだものの性質が結果に効き、**理由が読める**（ある程度客観的で、なんとなく分かる）
4. 要素が多い題材（国のように属性が多いもの）
5. 戦いがある
6. 一回で終わらず、環境が回る
7. API 代がかからない（ルールとテンプレートで作る）
8. センシティブな題材を避ける（実在の国は使わない）

## 全体の構造

```
国づくり → 建国サクセス → 共有マップに建国 → 隣国と戦う → 領土が動く → 覇権・崩壊 → 新時代
```

| 層 | 内容 | v1 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 国づくり | 8問（気候、地形、資源、人口、教育、税、食文化、モットー）。選択肢ごとに効果と理由を表示 | ○ |
| ② 建国サクセス | パワプロのサクセス型の短期育成。10期×方針選択＋イベント分岐で、ステータスと特技を得る | ○ |
| ③ 禁断の秘術 | 第8期のギャンブル（ダイジョーブ博士枠）。大成功・成功・失敗・暴走 | ○ |
| ④ 戦い | 自動観戦。三すくみの性格（守り・物量・機動）、4ステータス、戦場の地形、特技、作戦で決まる | ○（NPCと5連戦） |
| ⑤ 共有マップ | 六角形の区画の陣取り。攻撃は隣接する国にだけ。勝てば区画を奪い、負ければ失う | × |
| ⑥ 覇権サイクル | 世界制覇した国も一定期間で崩壊・分裂。挑戦者に討伐ボーナス | × |
| ⑦ 記録と共有 | 年表、国カード、歴史地図のタイムラプス | 年表と国カードのみ |

### 設計の考え方

- ステータスは4つ（攻撃・守備・機動・国力）＋民心（パワプロの体力に相当）。隠し乱数で強さを決めない
- 三すくみ：守り型は機動型に強い、機動型は物量型に強い、物量型は守り型に強い
- 特技は育成中の選択履歴で身につく（青＝通常、金＝強力、赤＝弱点）
- 無双は構造で防ぐ：広い国ほど国境が長い、攻撃回数の上限、首都は奪えない、帝国の期限と崩壊

## 未決の点

1. 対戦の見せ方（v1 は2Dの押し合いアニメ。物理演算にするかは手触りを見て決める）
2. 攻めた側が負けたときの扱い
3. シーズンの長さ、ワールドの人数、帝国の期限
4. 覇権の条件と崩壊時の分配
5. 初期配置の公平さ、孤立した国の扱い
6. 時代とエリアの選択を問いに加えるか

# Wake2Play

A [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader) plugin for the Steam Deck
that puts your Steam Remote Play host PC to sleep when the Deck sleeps, wakes it when the
Deck wakes, and reconnects the stream to the game you were playing — which is still running,
frozen in the PC's memory.

- History: [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)
- `tools/cdp_eval.py`: tiny stdlib-only Chrome DevTools client used to evaluate JS in the
  Steam UI over SSH (deploy/reload and debugging).

Fatteuf/beat-quest.readme:
## Structure

Le code source est dans `src/`. Les fichiers sont assemblés dans l'ordre de leur nom pour former `beat-quest.html`.

| Fichier | Contenu |
|---|---|
| `00-head.html` | Style (CSS) et structure des écrans |
| `10-core.js` | Moteur : sauvegarde, XP, mondes et étapes, compétences, outils, sons de batterie |
| `15-audio2.js` | Synthé, chanson de démo, mesure LUFS, export WAV, décors et monstres |
| `20-learn.js` | Questions du monde 1, quiz, Ear Gym |
| `30-screens.js` | Écrans : accueil, carte, régions, studio, Beat Forest, combats |
| `40-rigs.js` | Plugins : synthé, EQ, compresseur, reverb, delay, mixeur, automation, limiteur |
| `45-questions2.js` | Questions des mondes 2 à 7 |
| `48-worldkit.js` | Briques communes aux mondes 2 à 7 (manches de combat, Master Trials) |
| `50-caves.js` à `55-sky.js` | Un fichier par monde : leçons, boss, Master Trial |
| `60-final.js` | Le Final Track et le certificat |
| `90-boot.js` | Démarrage |

`beta0/` et `beta1/` sont les anciennes versions du jeu.

## Modifier le jeu

1. Modifie un fichier dans `src/`, jamais `beat-quest.html` directement : il est recréé à chaque build.
2. Reconstruis le jeu :
   ```
   cd src
   python build_web.py
   ```
3. Ouvre `beat-quest.html` dans le navigateur pour tester.

## Construire l'APK Android

L'appli est une WebView qui sert le jeu depuis les assets de l'APK (`android/java/…/MainActivity.java`).

Les outils de build ne sont pas dans le dépôt. Place-les dans `android/tools/` :

- `tools/bin/` : `aapt2.exe`, `zipalign.exe`, `libwinpthread-1.dll`, `dx.jar`, `apksigner.jar` (Android SDK build-tools 30.0.3) et `ecj-4.6.1.jar` (compilateur Java Eclipse) ;
- `tools/sdk/android.jar` : plateforme Android 34.

Il faut aussi Java 8 ou plus récent. Ensuite :

```
cd android
python build.py
```

Pour publier une mise à jour, augmente `VERSION_CODE` dans `build.py`.

La clé de signature (`android/beatquest.jks` et `android/signing.properties`) n'est pas dans le dépôt, volontairement. Garde-la en lieu sûr : Android refuse d'installer une mise à jour signée avec une autre clé.

Thunderman48/pokemon-war.readme:
# Pokémon War

A real-time strategy game built for phones, playable in the browser and hosted on GitHub Pages.
Gather berries and crystals, build up your base, train Pokémon, evolve them in battle, and destroy every enemy Pokémon Center (their bases).

**Play:** https://thunderman48.github.io/pokemon-war/ (after GitHub Pages is enabled; see below)

> Free, non-profit fan game. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc. or
> The Pokémon Company. Pokémon and character names are trademarks of their respective owners.
> All pixel art in `assets/` is original art made for this project.

## What's new in V2

- **Evolution needs research**: Pokémon need battle XP *and* the matching Lab research to evolve
  (e.g. research Charmeleon, then Charizard). Stones unlock Raichu and Eevee's forms.
- **New Pokémon**: Eevee (you pick Vaporeon, Jolteon or Flareon), Geodude → Graveler → Golem,
  Pidgey → Pidgeotto → Pidgeot, and the legendary **Rayquaza → Mega Rayquaza**. Rayquaza is a huge flying dragon
  whose Dragon Breath hits an area, and you can only have one. Charizard can fly too.
- **Flying units** fly over trees and water. Close-range fighters (Machop, Snorlax) can't hit them.
- **New building**: the Sky Pillar trains flying Pokémon and Rayquaza, and researches the Mega Stone.
- **More research**: Attack/Defense levels 1–3. Economy: Harvest, Big Bag, Mart Expansion. Buildings: Fortify, Training Drill, Tower Upgrade.
- **Special moves** you aim with a tap: Thunder (area damage), Heal Pulse (area heal), Sleep Powder (puts enemies to sleep) and Rayquaza's **Dragon Ascent** (rockets into the sky, then dives onto an area).
- More types: Flying, Rock and Dragon.
- The original game is still playable at `/v1/` (and saved on the `v1` branch).

## Features

- **Classic RTS**: workers, two resources, supply, buildings, tech requirements, research, fog of war.
- **VS Computer** on Easy, Normal or Hard. The AI researches, evolves, counters your army's types, uses special moves and attacks in waves.
- **Online 1v1** with a 5-letter room code. Play is peer-to-peer over WebRTC (PeerJS), so no server is needed.
- **Made for touch**: tap to select and command, drag to scroll, pinch to zoom, long-press to box-select, a minimap, and quick ARMY / IDLE / BASE buttons. Mouse and keyboard also work on desktop.
- Can be installed to the home screen (PWA manifest) for fullscreen play.

## Roster

| Building | Cost (berries / crystals) | Trains | Research |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pokémon Center | 400 | Machop | Harvest, Big Bag, Mart Expansion, Fortify, Training Drill, Tower Upgrade |
| Poké Mart | 100 | | +10 supply |
| Gym | 150 | Charmander, Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Geodude, Eevee, Pikachu* | Thunder, Heal Pulse, Sleep Powder |
| Lab (needs Gym) | 150 / 100 | Snorlax | Attack, Defense, every evolution, Thunder/Water/Fire Stone |
| Tower (needs Gym) | 100 / 50 | | Defensive, hits flyers |
| Sky Pillar (needs Lab) | 300 / 250 | Pidgey, Rayquaza (max 1) | Mega Stone, Dragon Ascent |

\*Pikachu needs a Lab.

| Line | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Machop | Fighting | Worker |
| Charmander → Charmeleon → Charizard | Fire | Ranged. Charizard flies |
| Squirtle → Wartortle → Blastoise | Water | Tough brawler, Heal Pulse |
| Bulbasaur → Ivysaur → Venusaur | Grass | Long range, Sleep Powder |
| Geodude → Graveler → Golem | Rock | Tank, strong vs Fire & Flying |
| Eevee → Vaporeon / Jolteon / Flareon | Normal → Water / Electric / Fire | You choose. Vaporeon heals, Jolteon uses Thunder |
| Pikachu → Raichu | Electric | Fast, Thunder |
| Pidgey → Pidgeotto → Pidgeot | Flying | Fast flyer |
| Snorlax | Normal | Huge tank, double damage to buildings |
| Rayquaza → Mega Rayquaza | Dragon | Legendary flyer, area Dragon Breath, only one |

All numbers are in `js/config.js` if you want to rebalance.

## Turning on GitHub Pages

1. On GitHub, open the repo's **Settings → Pages**.
2. Under **Build and deployment**, set **Source** to *Deploy from a branch*.
3. Pick the branch with the game (e.g. `main`) and the `/ (root)` folder, then **Save**.
4. After a minute the game is live at `https://<your-username>.github.io/pokemon-war/`.

There is no build step. The site is plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript modules.

## Running locally

```bash
npx http-server -c-1 .     # then open http://localhost:8080
npm test                   # feature checks + headless AI-vs-AI match
```

(Opening `index.html` directly from disk won't work because browsers block ES modules on `file://`.)

## Editing the art

All sprites are PNGs in `assets/` (units, buildings, resources, tiles). Edit them in any pixel editor and refresh the page.
They are generated by `tools/make_assets.py` (needs Python + Pillow). Re-running that script **overwrites** the PNGs,
so either edit the character grids in the script or edit the PNGs directly, but not both.

## Online play notes

- The host's device runs the match, and the guest receives about 10 small updates per second.
- Matchmaking uses the free public PeerJS server. On some strict mobile or corporate networks, WebRTC can't connect.
  If that happens, try Wi-Fi or a different network.
- Keep the game in the foreground while hosting. Phones pause background tabs.

## Code map

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `js/config.js` | Units, buildings, research, type chart, AI difficulty |
| `js/map.js` | Seeded, mirror-symmetric map generator |
| `js/world.js` | Simulation: movement, combat, gathering, evolution, fog, network snapshots |
| `js/path.js` | A* pathfinding + path smoothing |
| `js/ai.js` | Computer opponent |
| `js/render.js` | Canvas renderer, effects, fog, minimap |
| `js/game.js` | Game loop, touch/mouse input, HUD |
| `js/net.js` | PeerJS multiplayer |
| `js/main.js` | Menus and lobby |

# Signal Shift

*Connect the signal. Outsmart the grid.*

A portrait 2D logic-puzzle game for Android and iOS, built with Godot 4.7 and GDScript.
Rotate circuit tiles to route power from the source to every receiver.

- 60-level free campaign (6 chapters), 90 bundled daily puzzles, 20-level Overclock pack
- Undo, reset, hints, stars by par, move-limit levels
- Offline, no accounts; ads and purchases behind service interfaces (no SDK installed yet)

godot --path .
./tools/run_tests.sh        # 62 tests + headless boot smoke run

Andrew2142/IW4DOOM.readme:
IW4DOOM

Modern Warfare 2 (2009) gunplay in the classic Doom engine.
Real MW2 weapon logic and real 3D viewmodels, drawn in Doom's own 256-colour palette. Unofficial. Bring your own game files.

Quick start · Controls · Which Doom · How it works · FAQ · Legal · Credits

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b70fbc4a-1891-48b7-ae0e-106df93028c9 ## What is this? MW2's guns, in DOOM. The real ones. IW4DOOM takes the weapons out of your copy of Modern Warfare 2 (models, animations, sounds) and hands them to the DOOM guy. Recoil, spread, reload times, aiming down sights: all of it runs on MW2's actual weapon code. Then every gun gets crushed down to DOOM's 256 colours and DOOM's lighting, so everything blends together, without it feeling out of place. Bring your own MW2 and DOOM. One script builds the rest. ## Features

**3D viewmodels in Doom's palette.** Every triangle is shaded with Doom's light levels and quantized to the 256-colour palette. Shown here cycling through the MW2 arsenal. - **MW2 weapon behaviour.** Fire rates, burst and semi-auto, magazine and shell-by-shell reloads, raise and drop times, recoil, spread bloom, sway and sprint all come from the weapon files. - **Aim down sights and scopes.** The field of view zooms, sniper rifles get their scope overlay, and Shift holds your breath to steady the sway. - **Ballistics.** MW2 damage with range falloff for bullets, explosive RPG rockets, and a hitmarker when you connect. - **Freelook.** Look up and down with the mouse; the software renderer shears the view the way Doom ports traditionally do. - **MW2 HUD touches.** Dynamic crosshair, ammo counter, weapon names, "Press F to open" and "Press R to reload" prompts. - **MW2 sounds.** Fire, reload and handling sounds from your install, mixed beside Doom's own. - **Saves.** Savegames keep your MW2 weapons and magazines; vanilla saves still load. - **Configurable.** Remap any Doom weapon slot to any exported MW2 weapon, rebind keys, tune balance in `iw4doom.toml`. ## Quick start You need your own copy of **MW2 (2009)** with multiplayer installed, and a **Doom WAD** ([which one?](#which-doom-version)). Runs on Linux and Windows 10/11. 1. Get the code: ```bash git clone https://github.com/Andrew2142/IW4DOOM.git cd IW4DOOM ``` 2. Drop your MW2 folder and your Doom WAD into `games/`: ```text games/ Call of Duty Modern Warfare 2/ doom2.wad ``` 3. Run it. Linux: ```bash ./iw4doom.sh ``` Windows (or double-click it): ```bat iw4doom.bat ``` The first run builds everything (15–20 minutes) and asks before installing anything that's missing. After that it starts in seconds. Need more detail? See the [full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md). ## Controls | Action | Default | | --- | --- | | Move | W A S D | | Look | Mouse | | Fire | Left mouse button, Ctrl | | Aim down sights | Right mouse button | | Use (doors, switches) | F | | Reload | R | | Sprint / hold breath while aiming | Shift | | Melee | V, mouse 4 | | Last weapon | Q | | Weapons | 1-7, mouse wheel | | Turn | Left / right arrow | Rebind them in `iw4doom.toml` (copy `iw4doom.example.toml`, which lists every setting at its default). The game reads `./iw4doom.toml`, then `~/.config/iw4doom/iw4doom.toml` on Linux or `%APPDATA%\iw4doom\iw4doom.toml` on Windows. ## Which Doom version Any Doom IWAD works. IW4DOOM uses the classic WAD files, not a newer engine. - **DOOM and DOOM II on Steam.** The Steam versions include the classic `DOOM.WAD` and `DOOM2.WAD`; find them in the game's install folder (on Windows under `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\`, for example `Ultimate Doom`) and copy or link them into `games/doom/`. Final Doom's `PLUTONIA.WAD` and `TNT.WAD` work too. - **Shareware Doom (free).** Episode 1 only. On Debian or Ubuntu: `sudo apt install doom-wad-shareware`, then `ln -s /usr/share/games/doom/doom1.wad games/doom/`. - **Freedoom (free and open).** A complete replacement IWAD: download `freedoom1.wad` / `freedoom2.wad` from [freedoom.github.io](https://freedoom.github.io) into `games/doom/`. With several IWADs, IW4DOOM prefers `doom2.wad`, then `doom.wad`, `plutonia.wad`, `tnt.wad`, `freedoom2.wad`, `freedoom1.wad`, `doom1.wad`. ## Weapons | Key | Doom weapon | MW2 weapon | | :---: | --- | --- | | 1 | Fist, chainsaw | (Doom's own) | | 2 | Pistol | USP .45 | | 3 | Shotgun | SPAS-12 | | 3 | Super shotgun | Ranger | | 4 | Chaingun | M4A1 | | 5 | Rocket launcher | RPG-7 | | 6 | Plasma rifle | MG4 | | 7 | BFG 9000 | Barrett .50cal | Shareware `doom1.wad` has no super shotgun, plasma rifle or BFG, so you get the USP, SPAS-12, M4A1 and

wozers0/kerosene.readme:
# kerosene

Fuel for [Octane](https://octane.wtf). Kerosene is a browser extension for the Octane Roblox revival (2021–2022 era). Works in **Chrome, Brave, Edge, Opera, Firefox and Zen**.

## Features

- **Era themes for octane.wtf** — Classic 2018 (light, blue top bar, Source Sans), Dark 2020 (Roblox 2020 dark, Gotham) and Modern 2026 (near-black, soft corners, Inter). Themes switch Octane's own light/dark mode, recolour its stylesheets and add era touches; going back to Original restores your own light/dark setting.
- **Custom backgrounds** — the animated character field, Baseplate, Midnight, Aurora, Sunset and Ocean presets, or your own image / GIF / video (link or upload), with dim and blur sliders.
- **Item values** from [Octomons](https://octomons.wtf) — value, demand, trend, projected and rare badges on limited item cards; a value panel on every limited's item page; total value on limiteds pages.
- **Trade helpers** — Value and RAP totals for both sides of every trade (and while you build one), plus a **WIN / LOSS / FAIR** banner with warnings for projected items, low demand, and rares you're giving away. Robux is counted after Octane's 30% fee.
- **Avatar Sandbox** — a **Sandbox** tab in Octane's avatar editor (octane.wtf/my/avatar) that looks like the rest of the editor but lists every item in Octane's catalog, on sale or not, by category, with search and sorting. The price sits under every item (cheapest reseller for limiteds), click to try it on (the preview renders it on your own avatar, in 2D or 3D), and the outfit's total shows next to your balance with **how much Robux you still need**. Save as many outfits as you like; they're stored locally, each with its price and what you'd still need.
- **Trade calculator** in the popup — add items to each side by name or acronym, add Robux, see the verdict.
- **Your limiteds' worth** — item count, total value and RAP in the popup.
- **Friends** — syncs your Octane friends list automatically, with avatars and live status: online, in Studio, or *playing <game>* with a Join button. Watch extra people by username or ID. Toolbar badge shows how many are online; optional alerts when a friend comes online or starts a game.
- **User lookup** by username or ID, **quick links**, and a **seasonal toggle** for Octane's Halloween decorations.
- **Interactive popup** — OLED-black background of drifting characters that light up around your cursor; click for a ripple.

## Install

Download the file for your browser from the [`dist`](dist) folder:

| Browser | File |
| --- | --- |
| Brave, Chrome, Edge, Opera | `dist/kerosene-chrome.zip` |
| Firefox, Zen | `dist/kerosene-firefox.xpi` |

### Brave (also Chrome / Edge / Opera)

1. Unzip `kerosene-chrome.zip` into a folder you'll keep (e.g. `Documents/kerosene`). Don't delete it afterwards — Brave loads the extension from there.
2. Go to `brave://extensions` (Chrome: `chrome://extensions`).
3. Turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
4. Click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder (the one containing `manifest.json`).
5. Click the puzzle-piece icon in the toolbar and **pin** Kerosene. Open octane.wtf once while signed in so it can find your account.

**Updating:** replace the folder's contents with the new zip, then press the ↻ reload button on Kerosene in `brave://extensions`.

### Firefox / Zen

Firefox only installs extensions permanently when they're signed by Mozilla. Pick one:

**Quick try (until you restart the browser)** — works in every Firefox and Zen:
1. Go to `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`.
2. Click **Load Temporary Add-on…** and choose `kerosene-firefox.xpi`.

**Keep it installed — Zen, Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR:**
1. Go to `about:config`, search `xpinstall.signatures.required`, set it to **false**.
2. Go to `about:addons` → ⚙️ → **Install Add-on From File…** → choose `kerosene-firefox.xpi`.

**Keep it installed — regular Firefox:** get a free signature from Mozilla. Sign in at [addons.mozilla.org/developers](https://addons.mozilla.org/developers/), click **Submit a New Add-on**, choose **On your own**, and upload `kerosene-firefox.xpi`. Mozilla sends back a signed `.xpi` (usually within minutes); install that from `about:addons` → ⚙️ → **Install Add-on From File…**.

**Updating (Firefox / Zen):** click the ↻ button in the Kerosene popup. Kerosene downloads the new signed version, a small Kerosene window opens and Firefox asks twice (**Continue to Installation**, then **Add**); your Octane page refreshes into the new version. Firefox also installs updates by itself about once a day.

After installing, pin Kerosene from the Extensions (puzzle-piece) menu. If the popup shows **"Kerosene needs permission…"**, click **Allow**.

## Using it

- **Themes / backgrounds:** open the popup → Themes or Backgrounds. Changes apply to open octane.wtf tabs instantly.
- **Trades:** open a trade on octane.wtf/trades — the WIN/LOSS banner sits above the offers and each side shows its Value and RAP. It updates live while you build a trade or type Robux.
- **Item values:** limited item cards show `V` (Octomons value) and demand badges; item pages get a value panel with a link to Octomons. Values refresh every 10 minutes.
- **Friends:** popup → Friends. Click **Join** to open the game a friend is playing.
- **Avatar Sandbox:** go to octane.wtf/my/avatar, hover **Sandbox** and pick a category. Click items to try them on and click again to take them off. **Copy My Avatar** starts from what you're wearing. **Save Outfit** keeps it, and **Sandbox → Saved Outfits** lists them with their prices. Nothing is bought or changed on your real avatar.

## Development

- `manifest.json` is the Chrome/Brave manifest; load the repo folder unpacked to develop.
- `python3 build.py` builds `dist/kerosene-chrome.zip` and `dist/kerosene-firefox.xpi` (the Firefox build swaps the service worker for background scripts and adds a Gecko ID).
- `popup/` — the toolbar menu
- `content/engine.js` — theme

yeahthisisrob/family-trivia.readme:
# Family Trivia > _"Assume everyone is trying their best, and be kind to each other."_ > — Christina Baker Kline AI-powered daily trivia, facts, and mini-games for families — built with React, AWS CDK, and Claude on Bedrock. --- ## In memory of…
**Elizabeth "Betty" D'Hondt** _1946 — 2026_ _She cared deeply, for every creature, for every story,_ _with a heart as big as the elephants she loved._
This project started as a way to stay connected with my mom. After retirement, as her physical health declined, I watched depression slowly take more of her light. I'd sit with her, listen, try to be there — sometimes love looks like a hard balance between helping, giving space, and simply showing up. Family Trivia gave her something to do every morning, gave us something to talk about, and helped us capture more memories of our family, together. May is **#MentalHealthMonth** 💚. Mental health struggles can be quiet — isolation, loss of identity, feeling like a burden when you're deeply loved. Check in, sit awhile, and make space for the conversations that matter. Let's have more good days, together. Resources: [mhanational.org/may](https://mhanational.org/may) **#WordsToRememberForNana** --- ## What it does - **Daily Trivia** — One AI-generated question per day per player, with catch-up mode for missed days. - **Daily Facts** — Share personal facts with the family. Weekly AI summaries. - **Game Modes** — Casino Rush, Slot Machine, Curling, Tetris. Utuglu/sky-stack.readme:
# Sky Stack: YouTube Playables oyunu

Tek dokunuşla oynanan bir kule oyunu. Kayan bloğu doğru anda bırakıp kuleyi büyütürsün. Taşan kısım kesilip düşer. Tam üstüne bırakırsan "PERFECT" kombosu yaparsın, 3 ve üstü kombo bloğu yeniden genişletir.

## Dosyalar

| Dosya | Görev |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Tek sayfa. YouTube SDK'sı oyun kodundan **önce** yükleniyor |
| `game.js` | Tüm oyun (canvas, ses, kayıt, reklam) |
| `style.css` | Tam ekran yerleşim |
| `dist/sky-stack.zip` | YouTube'a yüklenecek paket |

Toplam boyut yaklaşık 10 KB. Harici font, resim ya da kütüphane kullanılmıyor.

## Yerelde çalıştırma

```bash
python -m http.server 8123
```

Ardından tarayıcıda `http://localhost:8123` adresini aç. Yerelde SDK hiçbir şey yapmaz (no-op). Bu yüzden ödüllü reklam yerelde simüle edilir ve ödül direkt verilir.

## Karşılanan Playables şartları

- **SDK:** `https://www.youtube.com/game_api/v1`, `game.js`'ten önce yükleniyor.
- **firstFrameReady / gameReady:** İlk kare "Loading…" ekranıyla çiziliyor, sonra `firstFrameReady()` çağrılıyor. Kayıt ve dil yüklenip menü etkileşime hazır olunca `gameReady()` çağrılıyor.
- **Kayıt:** Sadece `loadData` / `saveData` kullanılıyor (localStorage yok). `saveData`, `loadData` bitmeden çağrılmıyor. Kayıt sürümlü bir JSON (`v: 1`) ve 1 KB'ın altında. Oyun bitince ve duraklatılınca kaydediliyor.
- **Skor:** `sendScore` her zaman kayıttaki en iyi skorla gönderiliyor.
- **Ses:** Sadece `isAudioEnabled` / `onAudioEnabledChange` kullanılıyor. Sessize alma butonu yok. Ses ilk dokunuştan önce çalmıyor.
- **Müzik:** Dosya kullanılmıyor, müzik WebAudio ile kodda üretiliyor (Am–F–C–G döngüsü, 100 BPM). Kule yükseldikçe katmanlar ekleniyor: menüde pad ve bas çalıyor, oyunda kick ve arpej ekleniyor, 20. kattan sonra hi-hat geliyor ve arpej bir oktav yükseliyor. Oyun bitince müziğin sesi kısılıyor. Notalar oyun döngüsünden planlandığı için duraklatma ve reklam sırasında müzik de duruyor. Ses efektleri müzikle uyumlu olsun diye aynı gamda (La minör pentatonik).
- **Duraklatma:** `onPause` gelince oyun döngüsü, ses ve girişler duruyor. `onResume` ile devam ediyor. Page Visibility API kullanılmıyor.
- **Dil:** `getLanguage()` ile seçiliyor (EN, TR, ES, PT, DE, FR), `navigator.language` kullanılmıyor. Varsayılan dil İngilizce.
- **Tasarım:** 9:32'den 32:9'a kadar tüm oranlarda çalışıyor. Ekran boyutu değişince oyun sıfırlanmıyor. Yüksek DPI ekranlarda net görünüyor. Dokunmatik, fare ve klavye (Space / Enter / ↓, devam için C) destekleniyor. Esc engellenmiyor (oyun sonunda menüye döner). Çıkış butonu, link, paylaşım çağrısı ve QR kod yok.
- **Gizlilik:** SDK dışında hiçbir dış isteğe çıkılmıyor. Kişisel veri ve giriş ekranı yok. Kod gizlenmemiş (obfuscate edilmemiş).
- **Hata raporlama:** Yakalanmamış hatalar `health.logError()` ile bildiriliyor.

## Para kazanma (monetization)

YouTube Playables'ta **sadece YouTube'un kendi reklamlarına** izin var. Uygulama içi satın alma ve harici reklam ağları **yasak**. Oyunda şu reklamlar var:

1. **Pre-roll:** Oyun yüklenirken YouTube otomatik gösteriyor, kod gerekmiyor.
2. **Ödüllü reklam (`requestRewardedAd('sky-stack-continue')`):** Oyun bitince, skor 3 veya üstündeyse "Continue (watch ad)" butonu çıkıyor. Her oyunda bir kez kullanılabiliyor ve oyuncu kaldığı yerden devam ediyor. Reklamı sadece oyuncu kendisi başlatabiliyor.
3. **Geçiş reklamı (`requestInterstitialAd()`):** Her 3 "Play again" tıklamasında bir, doğal bir molada gösteriliyor. Sıklık `game.js` içindeki `INTERSTITIAL_EVERY` ile ayarlanabiliyor.

Reklam açıkken oyun donduruluyor ve ses kesiliyor.

**Önemli:** Google'ın dokümanına göre Playables gelir paylaşımı şu an **pilot aşamada** ve sadece seçilmiş geliştiricilere açık. Reklamlar da şimdilik sadece bazı bölge ve platformlardaki kullanıcılara gösteriliyor. Kod hazır, ama gelir almak için Developer Portal'da monetization ayarını açman ve programa kabul edilmen gerekiyor.

## YouTube'a yükleme adımları

1. **Test:** [SDK Test Suite](https://developers.google.com/youtube/gaming/playables/certification/sdktestsuite)'i açıp oyunun yerel adresini (`http://localhost:8123`) yükle. firstFrameReady, gameReady, kayıt, ses, duraklatma ve reklam olaylarını orada dene.
2. **CSP testi:** [Test suite rehberine](https://developers.google.com/youtube/gaming/playables/reference/test_suite_guide) göre Chrome DevTools'ta YouTube'un CSP başlığını uygulayıp konsolda hata olmadığını kontrol et.
3. **Başvuru:** Playables geliştirici programına başvur ve Developer Portal'a erişim al ([Başlangıç sayfası](https://developers.google.com/youtube/gaming/playables/reference/getting_started)).
4. **Paket:** Portal'a `dist/sky-stack.zip` dosyasını yükle (kökte `index.html` var).
5. **Meta veri:** Başlık, açıklama, tür (Arcade / Casual) ve farklı oranlarda küçük resimler ekle. Küçük resimlerde ve açıklamada logo veya marka olmamalı. Erişilebilirlik etiketlerini sadece oyunda gerçekten olan özelliklere göre seç.
6. **Monetization:** Portal'da reklamları aç.
7. **İnceleme:** Sertifikasyona gönder.

Kodu değiştirdikten sonra paketi yeniden oluşturmak için:

```bash
python -c "import zipfile;z=zipfile.ZipFile('dist/sky-stack.zip','w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED);[z.write(f) for f in ['index.html','game.js','style.css']];z.close()"
```

PhantomOrion1/wikiracer.readme:
# 🏁 WikiRacer

Get from one Wikipedia article to another using only the links on the page. Fewest clicks wins.

**Play:** https://phantomorion1.github.io/wikiracer/

## Features

- **Daily challenge**: one hard pair per day (10:00 limit), the same for everyone, with one attempt. Ranked by clicks, then time. You get a percentile, a histogram of how everyone did, a streak counter and a shareable result. The other players' spread is simulated from a fixed model of typical hard-mode play, generated the same way for everyone each day, since there's no server.
- **Host handover**: if the host leaves, the next player in join order takes over the room automatically. Everyone else reconnects and the race carries on.
- **Live spectating**: follow a racer's scroll position and hovered link in real time.
- **No word search**: Ctrl/⌘+F is blocked mid-race, and link text is drawn with CSS so the browser's Find never matches a clickable link.
- **Time limits**: 2:30 easy, 5:00 medium, 10:00 hard.
- **Quick match**: join a random public race with strangers (up to 8 per room). Players vote on difficulty (public races lean Easy/Medium) and ready up; the race starts once most of the room is ready. Public rooms have codes (PUB01…) so friends can join the same one, and a private room's host can open it to the public.
- **Spectate**: once you're finished or out, watch any racer's screen live.
- **Lane Rush**: a quick racing mini-game (dodge traffic, grab flags) to play while you wait. Locked during countdowns and while you race.
- **Route comparison**: podium plus everyone's route side by side, with shared articles highlighted.
- **Anti-cheat**: leaving the tab costs +1 click after one warning. The host re-checks every route against Wikipedia's link data, and fake routes get flagged. Times and click counts are measured by the host, not trusted from players. Racers can't see each other's pages until they finish.
- **Security**: strict Content-Security-Policy, Subresource Integrity on the CDN script, Wikipedia HTML stripped of scripts and event handlers, and peer messages validated and rate-limited.

## Running it at scale

- **`config.json`** holds live settings you can edit on GitHub without touching code (takes ~10 min to apply): fill-in racers (`bots.maxPerRoom: 0` turns them off), number of public rooms, and an optional self-hosted PeerJS server.
- **Fill-in racers**: quick-match rooms that are short on people get up to 2 fill-ins (names in `bots.js`). They take real routes through Wikipedia's link graph, play at four skill levels, and always finish or give up within 75% of the time limit. They back off automatically once rooms have real players, or when other public rooms are already busy.
- **Pairs**: `vital.js` is a snapshot of Wikipedia's Vital Articles (~4,500 articles, by subject), giving about 4 million start/target combinations. Each browser remembers the last 4,000 pairs it played and never repeats them.
- **Wikipedia API**: responses are cached at Wikimedia's edge (`smaxage`), and failed requests retry with backoff.
- **Names** are filtered for slurs and profanity.

## Analytics

Anonymous analytics go straight to PostHog's capture API (no tracking script, no names, honours Do Not Track). They're off until you add a key:

1. Create a free project at posthog.com (free tier: 1M events/month).
2. Copy the project API key (`phc_...`) into `config.json` → `analytics.posthogKey`. Use `https://eu.i.posthog.com` as `posthogHost` if your project is in the EU.

Events: `app_open`, `race_start`, `race_end`, `daily_end`, `quick_match`, `room_created`, `room_joined`, `round_start` (humans vs fill-ins), `spectate_open`, `share`, `flappy_game`, `host_migrated`, `issue` (failed loads, matchmaking, joins), `client_error`.

## Modes

- **Solo**: Easy / Medium / Hard curated pairs, random articles, or your own custom pair. Personal bests are saved in your browser.
- **Duel**: create a room, send the invite link, and up to 8 people race the same pair live. You see everyone's click count while racing, and full routes once you finish. Wins are tallied across rounds.
- **Challenge links**: after a solo race, "Challenge a friend" copies a link with your start, target and score so someone else can try to beat it.

## How it works

No browser extension is needed. Articles are fetched from the Wikipedia API and rendered inside the game, so every link click goes through the game and is counted. Search, external links, and category/file/help pages are blocked. The in-game Back button costs a click.

Duels are peer-to-peer over WebRTC using [PeerJS](https://peerjs.com/). The host's browser acts as the room server, so there's no backend to run, and the whole thing is a static site on GitHub Pages.

## Run locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then open http://localhost:8000.

## Files

- `index.html`: screens (home, lobby, game, results)
- `app.js`: Wikipedia fetching and link handling, game logic, and duel networking
- `minigame.js`: the Lane Rush mini-game
- `pairs.js`: curated start → target pairs per difficulty
- `styles.css`: styles

Article content comes from Wikipedia under CC BY-SA.

kendallmark3/video-poker.readme:
# Carla's Video Poker Game

*Developed by Mark Kendall.*

A Jacks or Better video poker machine for the browser, built with React. It was built in small, verified steps from intent files, then attacked with an adversarial test suite to find what breaks.

**Play it:** http://carlas-video-poker-mkendall.s3-website.us-east-2.amazonaws.com

![Carla's Video Poker Game](screenshots/r9-wide.png)

## Features

- The full **9/6 Jacks or Better** paytable, with the 4,000-credit royal flush bonus on a 5-credit bet
- **Double Up** after any win: beat the dealer's card to double your winnings
- **Keyboard play**, real playing-card faces, and a win meter that counts up
- **Sound effects** synthesized in the browser (no audio files), off until you turn them on
- **Session stats**: hands, wagered, won, return %, best hand, biggest win
- **Saves automatically** in your browser; saved data is validated before it's trusted
- A **casino floor** around the machine, with marquee lights and a gold-coin shower when you win
- Works on **phones** with touch, and spreads out across **wide screens**

## Run it

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # play at the URL Vite prints (usually http://localhost:5173)
npm run build      # production build in dist/
```

## How to play

1. **Bet One** raises the bet by 1 (1 to 5, then back to 1). **Bet Max** sets the bet to 5 and deals.
2. **Deal** gives you five cards. Click or tap the cards you want to keep; they show **HELD**.
3. **Draw** replaces every card you didn't hold. Winning hands pay from the paytable, and the row lights up.
4. You start with 100 play-money credits. When you run out, **Start Over** resets to 100.

### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `1`–`5` | Hold or release that card |
| `Space` / `Enter` | Deal, Draw, or Start Over |
| `B` | Bet One |
| `M` | Bet Max (deals) |
| `D` / `C` | Double Up / Collect (after a win) |
| `1`–`4` | Pick a card during Double Up |
| `S` | Sound on / off (starts off) |

### Double Up

After any win you can **Double Up** or **Collect**.

1. **Start:** Double Up takes the win out of your credits as the stake, then shows the dealer's card and four face-down cards.
2. **Pick:** choose one of the four. Aces are high.
   - **Higher:** the stake is doubled and paid.
   - **Equal:** the stake is returned (push).
   - **Lower:** the stake is lost.
3. **Keep going or stop:** after a win or a push you can double again, collect, or just deal the next hand. Collecting or dealing keeps what you've won.

### Sound and stats

- **Sound:** effects are synthesized in the browser (Web Audio), with no audio files. Sound starts off; press `S` or the Sound button to turn it on.
- **Stats:** the panel under the paytable shows hands played, credits wagered and won, your return percentage, your best hand and your biggest win. Double Up results count toward credits won. Start Over keeps the session stats.

### Saving and reset

- **Saved automatically:** credits, bet and session stats are kept in your browser (`localStorage`) and come back when you reload. Saved data is checked on load, and anything invalid starts a fresh game.
- **Reloading mid-hand or mid-Double Up:** the bet or stake already taken stays taken, as if you walked away from a real machine. The machine comes back ready to deal.
- **Reset Session:** sets credits back to 100 and clears the stats, after you confirm.

## Rules (9/6 Jacks or Better)

| Hand | Pays per credit |
|---|---|
| Royal Flush | 250 (4,000 on a 5-credit bet) |
| Straight Flush | 50 |
| Four of a Kind | 25 |
| Full House | 9 |
| Flush | 6 |
| Straight | 4 |
| Three of a Kind | 3 |
| Two Pair | 2 |
| Jacks or Better | 1 |

Payouts include the bet, so a pair of jacks or better gets your bet back.

### Rule assumptions

- A single 52-card deck, freshly shuffled for every hand. Replacement cards come from the same deck, so a card never appears twice in a hand.
- Aces count high or low in straights (10-J-Q-K-A and A-2-3-4-5). Straights don't wrap (Q-K-A-2-3 isn't a straight).
- The bet is taken when the hand is dealt and can't change until the draw. If the bet is more than your credits, the game bets what you have left. The royal flush bonus needs a real 5-credit bet.
- **Bet Max** deals immediately, as on a real machine.
- Credits are play money only. They're saved in your browser, not on a server.

## Testing

There are two separate suites.

| Command | What it is | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `npm test` | **Regression suite**: 101 tests written alongside the code (rules, game flow, Double Up, stats, sound, saving, celebrations) | 101 passing |
| `npm run test:tdd` | **Adversarial suite** in [`TDD/`](TDD/): tries to *break* the game | 34 passing |
| `node TDD/mutate.mjs` | **Mutation check**: plants 7 deliberate bugs, one at a time, and confirms the adversarial suite catches each one | 7/7 caught |

### The TDD folder: trying to break the game

Tests written by the same author as the code tend to share its assumptions. The [`TDD/`](TDD/) suite is built to be fair rather than flattering:

- **Every test checks against an independent source, never against the code under test:**
  - **[MATH]** published counts for all 2,598,960 five-card hands
  - **[REF]** a second hand evaluator written a different way
  - **[RULES]** the paytable as written in the intent
  - **[STATS]** a chi-square test of shuffle fairness
  - **[BOOKS]** an accounting identity: credits = baseline + won − wagered, checked after every one of 90,000 random actions
  - **[INPUT]** the documented input domain
- **Proof the tests can fail:** [`TDD/mutate.mjs`](TDD/mutate.mjs) records which tests already fail, plants each bug, and counts it caught only if a test that previously passed now fails. It always restores the source.
- **Findings were reported, then fixed separately.** The first run broke the game in two places:
  - the bet accepted non-whole numbers
  - saves over 1 billion credits were silently thrown away

  Both were fixed in a follow-up inte

radosek/urban-cyborg-project.readme:
# URBAN – The Cyborg Project

A native, cross-platform port of **URBAN – The Cyborg Project** (1999), a side-scrolling DOS action
game by Thomas Nyberg and Jonas Borgström, released under the GNU GPL v2.

- `rust/` — the port: a complete rewrite in Rust on SDL2 (statically linked, single binary).
- `ref/` — the original C++ source (URBAN 1.2), lightly patched to build natively on SDL2 via
  `port/` (an Allegro 3.11 subset). It is the reference the Rust port is tested against.

The Rust port reproduces the original frame for frame (see *Verification*) and fixes the original
game's bugs listed in [docs/FIXES.md](docs/FIXES.md).

## Game data

This repository contains code only. The game data (graphics, levels, music) is not included.
Get the original 1999 release (it is widely mirrored as
`URBAN-The-Cyborg-Project_DOS_EN.zip`) and copy these from its `urban` folder:

    urban.dat  levels.dat  intro.dat  snd/

into a folder named `data` next to the `urban` executable (or set `URBAN_DATA=/path/to/them`).

## Download

Prebuilt binaries for Windows, Linux and macOS (universal URBAN.app) are attached to each
[release](https://github.com/radosek/urban-cyborg-project/releases), and to every CI run.

## Build from source

    cd rust
    cargo build --release        # needs CMake; SDL2 is built from source and linked statically

On Linux install the usual SDL build dependencies first (ALSA/PulseAudio, X11, Wayland headers;
see `.github/workflows/build.yml`).

## Play

    ./urban            # -i skip intro, -s no music, -x no sound effects, -b no backgrounds
    ./urban -f gamemaps/level11.map   # play one map

- Alt/Cmd+Enter toggles fullscreen (`URBAN_FULLSCREEN=1` starts fullscreen).
- **ESC** opens the pause menu: RESUME / SAVE / LOAD / OPTIONS / RESTART / QUIT.
- **F5** quick save, **F9** quick load, anywhere in a level. The game also autosaves at every
  level start and checkpoint; **CONTINUE** on the main menu resumes the latest save.
- Graphics (CONFIG → GRAPHICS, or in game): **F6** filter (PIXELS original / SMOOTH / SCALEX
  Scale3x / HQX hq4x), **F7** CRT look, **F8** widescreen 16:9. Saved in `video.cfg`.
- Keyboard by default: arrows, Ctrl fire, Space jump, Shift prev/next weapon, 1–7 weapons, P pause.
- Gamepads (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, …) via SDL; choose GAMEPAD in CONFIG → controls.
- Config, saves and highscores live in the per-user app data folder.

## Verification

The C++ reference and the Rust port run with identical scripted input and random seed. Every frame
(or every key read / pause in menus and cutscenes) is fingerprinted and compared. All identical:

    tools/diffall.sh 4 6000   # 18 levels x 4 random playthroughs x 6000 frames
    tools/savetest.sh         # new game, clear level, save, load
    tools/campaigntest.sh     # all 18 levels, ending, credits, highscore, second game
    tools/menutest.sh         # main menu, highscores, credits, config
    tools/seqtest.sh          # intro; RUN=outtro / RUN=credits KEYPRESSES=999999 for the others
    tools/flitest.sh          # all 11 intro animations
    tools/savestatetest.sh    # quick save mid-level, reload: identical afterwards (Rust only)

These need the game data in `ref/data` and the C++ reference build:

    brew install sdl2 libmikmod cmake pkgconf    # or the Linux equivalents
    cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build -j

`tools/next.sh`, `tools/diagnose.sh` and `tools/firstdiff.sh` explain a divergence (random-number
call sites, object states, collision pairs). Porting notes: [docs/PORTING.md](docs/PORTING.md).

## License

GPL v2 or later, as the original (`ref/copying`). Original game © 1999 Thomas Nyberg and Jonas
Borgström.

phakoda/bendchess.readme:
# BendChess

An original chess engine written in **Bend 2**, built to test one research
question: *can an engine play stronger at a fixed compute budget by
predicting how much search each candidate move will need, and allocating
search effort accordingly?*

Board representation, move generation, evaluation, alpha-beta search, the
complexity estimators, the complexity-aware search policy and the UCI
protocol loop are all Bend 2 code (`src/*.bend`), compiled to a native
binary. Python is used for tooling around the engine (match runner,
training pipeline, tablebase decoding, terminal UI). See
[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for the exact boundary.

**Status and results:** see [docs/RESULTS.md](docs/RESULTS.md) (measured
numbers, including negative results) and [docs/PROGRESS.md](docs/PROGRESS.md).

## Build

Requirements: git, [bun](https://bun.sh) >= 1.2, clang >= 14, Python 3 with
`python-chess` (tests and tools) and `numpy` (training). Stockfish is only
needed for benchmark matches and data labelling.

```sh
make setup      # clone Bend 2 (pinned: 2.0.37) into third_party/, create tools/bin/bend
make            # build/bendchess (native binary via Bend -> C -> clang)
make test       # perft suite + engine tests
make proofs     # check LAWS.bend with PROOF.bend (about 9 minutes)
```

If `bend` is already on your PATH, `make` uses it.

## Run

```sh
build/bendchess                   # UCI engine (stdin/stdout): point a GUI at this
build/bendchess perft 5           # perft from the start (or: perft D <FEN>)
build/bendchess divide 3 <FEN>    # per-move perft
build/bendchess bench 10          # fixed-depth bench (node-count signature + speed)
python3 tools/play.py             # play against it in the terminal
python3 tools/play.py --black --movetime 3000 --show-analysis
```

UCI options: `NullMove`, `LMR`, `Pruning` (speculative pruning switches),
`Complexity` 0-3 (the complexity-aware search policy, 0 = conventional
baseline), `TimePolicy` 1-3 (budget adaptation v1 [default]; v2 adds
best-move node effort; v3 adds the learned iteration-cost model),
`Threads` 1/2/4 (root-split parallel search), `Practical` 0-200 (margin in
cp for the practical-difficulty move choice, Module 8; 0 = off),
`EvalMode` (0 full feature eval, 1 PeSTO only [default], 2 light),
`NodesTime` (node clock for equal-node experiments), `SoftScale`,
`SyzygyPath`.

Extra UCI commands: `d` (position, eval, incremental state), `features`
(evaluation feature vector), and

```
position fen <FEN>
analyze depth 8 cdepth 4
```

which prints the game-state report (move counts, material, clocks,
repetitions, rights), the complexity quantities (A legal sequences, B
distinct positions, C game-continuation heuristic, D search effort; each
labelled as exact or estimated) and the ranked candidate-move table after
every iteration (exact score for every move, nodes, opponent replies,
forcing flags, score fluctuation, search priority).

Tablebases: `tools/fetch_syzygy.sh` downloads the 3-4-piece Syzygy tables
shipped with python-chess into `third_party/syzygy`; then
`setoption name SyzygyPath value <dir>`.

## Experiments

```sh
python3 tools/match.py bend sf:elo=2000 --games 100 --tc 10+0.1
python3 tools/experiments.py --list
python3 tools/experiments.py cas1_nodes cas2_nodes --games 200
python3 tools/magnus.py --games 100           # vs a Magnus-strength proxy
python3 tools/datagen.py && python3 tools/tune.py   # learning pipeline
```

## Repository map

| Path | Content |
|---|---|
| `src/core.bend` | squares, pieces, moves, signed scores, hashing (safe, proven) |
| `src/board.bend` | memory layout, position record, make/unmake (safe, proven) |
| `src/movegen.bend` | move generation, attacks, legality, FEN, perft |
| `src/eval.bend` | evaluation (PeSTO + features), eval hash, lazy eval |
| `src/search.bend` | PVS, quiescence, TT, pruning, ordering, draw rules |
| `src/root.bend` | root search, move ranking, complexity-aware allocation |
| `src/analysis.bend` | analysis report and complexity estimators |
| `src/uci.bend`, `src/main.bend` | UCI loop, time management, CLI |
| `LAWS.bend`, `PROOF.bend` | formal laws and their proofs |
| `tests/` | perft / rules / search / estimator tests |
| `tools/` | match runner, experiments, training, play UI, generators |
| `docs/` | architecture, research write-up, results, Bend notes |

## Honest limits

Not unbeatable, not "solved", not formally verified as a whole: the proofs
cover the specific laws in `LAWS.bend` (encodings, 0x88 geometry,
castling-rights table, selection, and the make-move state transition).
Movegen, search and evaluation are validated by tests. See
[docs/RESULTS.md](docs/RESULTS.md) for strength numbers and limitations.

# Adam: City Fixer (working title)

A single-player puzzle adventure for mobile (ages 10-17). Adam repairs a broken modern city, one district at a time.

**Status:** Milestone 1 greybox prototype. Plain shapes, no final art. Design documents are kept in the SkillNexus360 Venture Cell project folder.

## What works now
- Mechanic 2, **routing**: lay cable from the substation to every building, using a limited set of pieces (straight, corner, splitter). Tap a square to place, tap a cable to turn it, press and hold to take it back.
- Three levels (`levels/route/r01.json` to `r03.json`), a level map, stars (solve / best cable count / no hints), a hint that shows the next move of a shortest solution, and progress saved on the device.
- No network use, no accounts, no ads, no data collected.

## Engine and setup
- Godot **4.5.1** stable (GDScript), Compatibility renderer, portrait 720x1280.
- Open the folder in Godot 4.5.1 and press Play. No plugins or add-ons.

## Project layout
| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `scripts/route/route_board.gd` | Rules of the routing puzzle (no drawing) |
| `scripts/route/route_solver.gd` | Finds a shortest solution; used by tests and the hint |
| `scripts/route/route_view.gd` | Draws the board and turns taps into moves |
| `scripts/core/level_loader.gd` | Reads level JSON files |
| `scripts/core/save_game.gd` | Local save with backup (autoload `SaveGame`) |
| `scripts/ui/` | Map screen, level screen, shared UI helpers |
| `levels/route/` | Level data |
| `tests/` | Automated tests |

## Level file format
```json
{"id": "r01", "title": "Kiosk Row", "intro": "One-line briefing.",
 "width": 5, "height": 3, "par": 3,
 "cells": [{"x": 0, "y": 1, "type": "source", "sides": "E"},
           {"x": 4, "y": 1, "type": "target"},
           {"x": 1, "y": 0, "type": "block"}],
 "inventory": {"straight": 3, "corner": 0, "tee": 0}}
```
`type` is `source`, `target`, `block` or `wire` (a fixed cable). `sides` lists open sides (N, E, S, W). `par` must equal the length of the shortest solution; the tests enforce this.

## Tests
```
godot --headless --path . --import
godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/run_tests.gd          # rules, every level solvable at par, save/load
xvfb-run godot --path . --script res://tests/playthrough.gd -- /tmp/shots   # plays each level with real taps, saves screenshots
```

## Builds
GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/build.yml`) runs the tests and exports an Android APK and a web build on every pull request. On `main` it also publishes the APK as the **prototype** release and the web build to the `gh-pages` branch. The APK is signed with a throwaway debug key: for playtests only, not for the Play Store.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for changes and known issues.

# Запали Кристал чисел

Інтерактивна гра для онлайн-уроку «Змінні» (Minecraft MakeCode, 8 років).

Відкрийте `index.html` подвійним кліком — збирати нічого не треба.

- **H** — підказка
- **←** / **→** — назад / далі

# 中世紀模擬（Medieval Simulator）

14 世紀英格蘭一個家族的幾代人生：克魯賽德國王式的事件、個性和傳承，加上模擬市民式的家人、心情和往來。

- `simcore/`：C++20 的模擬核心和純文字試玩版。說明見 [simcore/README.md](simcore/README.md)。
- `design/`：遊戲設計（[GDD](design/GDD.md)、[架構](design/architecture.md)、[季回合](design/season-loop.md)……）。
- `research/`：工具和 Unreal 的調研。

## 在 Mac 上玩

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Zhengxian-Liu/medieval-simulator.git
cd medieval-simulator/simcore
bash scripts/play.sh
```

之後更新：在 `medieval-simulator` 資料夾裡 `git pull`，再跑一次 `bash scripts/play.sh`（會自動重新編譯）。

每個改動都要通過 `simcore/scripts/test.sh`，GitHub 上的 CI 會在 Linux 和 Mac（內建 bash 3.2）各跑一次。

Harlock123/AVARipOff.readme:
# AVA Rip Off

[![Build](https://github.com/Harlock123/AVARipOff/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Harlock123/AVARipOff/actions/workflows/build.yml)

A colour vector game in the style of Cinematronics' 1980 arcade game **Rip Off**, built with .NET 10 and
Avalonia UI. Eight fuel canisters stand in a depot in the middle of an open plain. Raiders come in from
every side at once to hook them and tow them off the edge of the screen. You have one tank, and you can't
be everywhere: shoot the raider dragging a canister away before it gets there. There are no lives. You can
lose your tank as often as you like, and the raiders get a free run until it's back. The game ends when the
last canister is gone.

## Features

- **The tank** turns on the spot, drives forward and back, and fires straight ahead, two shells at a time.
- **The fuel**: eight canisters round the depot.
  - A raider hooks one and tows it on a line the shortest way off the screen, slower with the weight behind
    it. An alarm sounds while any canister is in tow.
  - Shoot the raider and the canister drops where it was. It stays there, out in the open, for the next
    raider to come for.
  - Raiders spread themselves across the canisters rather than all going for one.
- **The raiders** come in together, from every side, weaving as they close in. They're worth more the more
  dangerous they are, multiplied by the wave:
  - **Runners** (50) are quick and unarmed: they want the fuel and nothing else.
  - **Gunners** (75), from the third wave, go for the fuel too. They charge the tank when it comes near and
    fire when it's in front of them.
  - **Hunters** (100), from the fifth wave, go for the tank first. They ram it or shoot it, and only then
    turn to the fuel.
- **Losing the tank** costs nothing but time. It comes back at the depot, safe for a moment, once no raider
  is standing on it.
- **Each wave** brings more raiders, quicker, firing more often. Holding a wave pays a bonus for the fuel
  left. Canisters don't come back.
- **The attract mode** plays itself. The computer player shoots first whatever is about to tow a canister off
  the edge, leads every shot, and swerves out of the way of shots and rams.
- **The sounds** are all synthesised: the tank's thump, the raiders' zap, the clank of a hook, a two-tone
  alarm, a canister lost, and a stalking title theme.

| ![Gunners](Images/AVARipOff-gunners.png) | ![A hunter](Images/AVARipOff-hunter.png) | ![A wave held](Images/AVARipOff-held.png) |

The screenshots are made by the tests, which play the game in a real (headless) window; see
[Tests](#tests).

## Download and run

Ready-to-run builds for Windows, macOS and Linux, on both Intel/AMD and ARM, are on the
[Releases page](https://github.com/Harlock123/AVARipOff/releases/tag/latest). **Latest build** is
rebuilt on every push to `main`. Each download is one self-contained executable: no .NET install is
needed.

| Platform | Archive |
|---|---|
| Windows | `AVARipOff-win-x64.zip`, `AVARipOff-win-x86.zip`, `AVARipOff-win-arm64.zip` |
| macOS | `AVARipOff-osx-arm64.tar.gz` (Apple silicon), `AVARipOff-osx-x64.tar.gz` (Intel) |
| Linux | `AVARipOff-linux-x64.tar.gz`, `AVARipOff-linux-arm64.tar.gz`, `AVARipOff-linux-arm.tar.gz` |

```bash
tar -xzf AVARipOff-linux-x64.tar.gz     # or linux-arm64, linux-arm, osx-arm64, osx-x64
./AVARipOff
```

On Windows, unzip and run `AVARipOff.exe`. On macOS, if Gatekeeper refuses to open it, run
`xattr -d com.apple.quarantine AVARipOff` once. Run with `--no-audio` for silence.

**Sound** comes through OpenAL Soft, built in for every platform. In a virtual machine the game
detects it and uses a larger audio buffer, so the sound doesn't break up.

**Gamepads** use SDL2, which is bundled for Windows, macOS and Intel/AMD Linux. ARM Linux builds need it
installed; without it the keyboard still works:

```bash
sudo apt install libsdl2-dev            # Debian / Ubuntu / Raspberry Pi OS
sudo pacman -S --needed sdl2-compat     # Arch / Omarchy
```

## Controls

| Action | Keyboard | Gamepad |
|---|---|---|
| Start | Enter or 1 | Start |
| Turn | Left / Right (or A / D) | Left stick / D-pad |
| Drive forward / back | Up / Down (or W / S) | Up / Down (or B for forward) |
| Fire | Space, Z, X or Ctrl | A, X or right trigger |
| Pause | P or Esc | Start |
| Quit (while paused) | Esc | Back |
| Sound on/off | M | |
| Screenshot | Ctrl+S (to your Pictures folder) | |

On the high-score table, type your initials, or use up/down and Space, then Enter.

## Tests

```bash
dotnet test AVARipOff.slnx
```

The engine has no UI and runs in fixed 60 Hz steps, so it plays the same at any frame rate, and a seed
always plays the same game. The tests check:

- **The depot and the tank:**
  - the ring of canisters with the tank in the middle
  - turning, speed, coasting, reversing, and staying on the screen
  - two shots at a time, only so far
- **The raiders:**
  - points by kind and wave
  - hooking the nearest canister, towing it slower on its line and off the screen for good
  - a shot tower dropping its canister for another to take
  - raiders spreading over the canisters
  - gunners firing at the tank in front of them (and runners never)
  - a hunter ramming t

AVA Rip Off: a colour vector game after Cinematronics' 1980 arcade game

Defend eight fuel canisters from raiders that come in from every side to
hook them and tow them off the screen. Runners, gunners and hunters;
no lives, the game ends when the last canister is gone. Includes a
computer pilot for the attract mode, synthesised sounds, gameplay and
headless screenshot tests, and a tuning probe.

## ด่านในเกม | เกาะ | วิชา | วิธีเล่น | |---|---|---| | 1 · เกาะแม่น้ำพี่จระเข้ | วิทยาศาสตร์ ป.2 | ตอบคำถามเพื่อกระโดดข้ามก้อนหิน | | 2 · เกาะคณิตของตะต้า | คณิตศาสตร์ ป.2 | วิ่งเข้าประตูคำตอบ กระโดดข้ามลาวา | | 3 · เกาะคำศัพท์เหนียวเหนียว | ภาษาไทย · อังกฤษ ป.2 | สู้ยักษ์ขโมยคำ ตอบถูกเพื่อชิงตัวอักษรคืน | | 4 · ภูเขาไฟนักทดลอง | วิทยาศาสตร์ ป.3 | สร้างบันไดบล็อกปีนหนีลาวา | | 5 · หอนาฬิกาของตะต้า | คณิตศาสตร์ ป.3 | อ่านเวลา ตั้งเข็มนาฬิกา หาเฟืองมาซ่อมหอนาฬิกา | | 6 · หอดูดาวพี่จระเข้ | วิทยาศาสตร์ ป.4 | เลือกภาพดวงจันทร์ เรียงดาวเคราะห์ จุดดาวกลุ่มดาวจระเข้ | | 7 · ตลาดน้ำเหนียวเหนียว | คณิตศาสตร์ ป.4 | นั่งเรือแวะซื้อของ 10 แผง หยิบเหรียญ/ธนบัตรจ่ายให้พอดี รวมราคา เงินทอน เศษส่วน และทศนิยม (โจทย์สุ่มใหม่ทุกรอบ) | ### English Path (ภาษาอังกฤษ ป.2–ป.3) เส้นทางแยกบนแผนที่ (แท็บ "English Path") นั่งรถไฟ English Express ไป 8 สถานี ตอบถูกได้ตู้รถไฟเพิ่มทีละตู้ แต่ละตู้บรรทุกภาพของคำที่เพิ่งตอบ | สถานี | ชั้น | เนื้อหา | |---|---|---| | 1 | ป.2 | ABC และเสียงตัวอักษร | | 2 | ป.2 | ตัวเลขและสี | | 3 | ป.2 | สัตว์และผลไม้ | | 4 | ป.2 | ตัวฉัน ครอบครัว ร่างกาย และคำทักทาย | | 5 | ป.3 | ห้องเรียน สถานที่ และ in / on / under | | 6 | ป.3 | กิจกรรมและ can / can't | | 7 | ป.3 | วัน สภาพอากาศ และความรู้สึก | | 8 | ป.3 | ประโยค a / an, is / are และพหูพจน์ |
