แต่ละสถานีมีโจทย์ 6 แบบ ได้แก่ ดูภาพเลือกคำ ดูคำเลือกภาพ ฟังเสียงเลือกคำ สะกดคำด้วยการแตะตัวอักษร เรียงคำเป็นประโยค และบทสนทนา/ไวยากรณ์ คำศัพท์และประโยคทั้งหมดอยู่ใน `assets/english-units.js` แก้หรือเพิ่มได้ง่าย ### สูตรคูณ (ฝึกคล่อง) แท็บ "สูตรคูณ" บนแผนที่ มี 26 ด่าน: แม่ 2 ถึงแม่ 12 → ด่าน "รวมแม่ 2–12" → แม่ 13 ถึงแม่ 25 → ด่าน "รวมแม่ 13–25" (ด่านรวมสุ่ม 20 ข้อ) ผ่านแม่ไหนแล้วแม่ถัดไปจะเปิด แม่ 13–25 ให้เวลา 3 ดาว 7 วินาทีต่อข้อ และคำใบ้สอนแยกตัวเลข เช่น 17 × 6 = 10 × 6 + 7 × 6 - **ฝึกท่องตามลำดับ** ตอบ ×1 ถึง ×12 เรียงกัน เห็นตารางค่อย ๆ เติม และมีเสียงท่องแบบไทย ("เจ็ดหนึ่งเจ็ด เจ็ดสองสิบสี่ ...") ไม่จับเวลา - **แข่งจับเวลา** นั่งรถรางแข่งกับรถของเพื่อนที่วิ่งตามเวลา 3 ดาว (หรือตามสถิติเดิม ถ้าเร็วกว่า) พิมพ์คำตอบด้วยแป้นตัวเลข ตอบถูกรถพุ่งไปข้างหน้าและมีป้ายคำตอบขึ้นข้างทาง - ตอบผิดแล้วเหนียวเหนียวใบ้ด้วยการนับเพิ่มทีละขั้น ผิดซ้ำจะบอกคำตอบพร้อมคำท่อง - 3 ดาว: ผิดไม่เกิน 1 ข้อ และเร็วกว่า 5 วินาทีต่อข้อ · 2 ดาว: ผิดไม่เกิน 3 ข้อ - บันทึกสถิติเวลาของแต่ละแม่ไว้บนแผนที่ ข้อที่ผิดขึ้นในสมุดผู้ปกครองเป็นหัวข้อ "สูตรคูณแม่ ..." - กันการเล่นซ้ำเพื่อปั่นดาว: ได้ดาวสะสมเข้ากระเป๋าเฉพาะรอบแรกของแต่ละวัน รอบที่ทำลายสถิติ หรือรอบที่ได้ดาวมากกว่าเดิม

### เกาะโค้ดดิ้ง (วิทยาการคำนวณ) แท็บ "โค้ดดิ้ง" บนแผนที่ มี 20 ด่าน เรียงบล็อกคำสั่งแบบ Scratch พาตัวละครเดินบนเกาะบล็อกไปเก็บเพชรให้ครบ | ด่าน | ฝึกเรื่อง | บล็อกที่ใช้ได้ | |---|---|---| | 1–2 | ลำดับคำสั่ง | เดินหน้า | | 3–6 | การเลี้ยว (ซ้าย/ขวาของตัวละคร) | + เลี้ยวซ้าย เลี้ยวขวา | | 7–8 | การกระโดดขึ้นที่สูง | + กระโดด | | 9–12 | การวนซ้ำ (จำกัดจำนวนบล็อก ต้องหาแบบแผนที่ซ้ำ) | + วนซ้ำ | | 13–14 | วนซ้ำซ้อนวน | วนซ้ำใส่ในวนซ้ำได้ (ซ้อนได้ 3 ชั้น) | | 15–17 | เงื่อนไข (เพชรย้ายที่สุ่มทุกครั้งที่กดเริ่ม ต้องเช็กก่อนเก็บ) | + เก็บเพชร, ถ้าเจอเพชร | | 18–20 | ฟังก์ชัน (สร้าง "ท่า" ของตัวเอง ตั้งชื่อเอง แล้วเรียกใช้ซ้ำ) | + เรียกท่า | - กด "เริ่ม" ให้ทำงานทั้งโปรแกรม หรือกด "ทีละคำสั่ง" เพื่อไล่ดูทีละบล็อก (หาจุดผิดแบบ debug) - บล็อกที่ทำงานอยู่จะมีกรอบเหลือง ถ้าตกน้ำหรือชนที่สูง บล็อกนั้นขึ้นกรอบแดงพร้อมบอกสาเหตุ - 3 ดาวเมื่อใช้บล็อกไม่เกินเป้าหมาย ผิด 3 ครั้งเหนียวเหนียวใบ้วิธีทำ - ได้ดาวสะสมรอบแรกของแต่ละวันหรือเมื่อได้ดาวมากกว่าเดิม (กฎเดียวกับสูตรคูณ) - ด่านทั้งหมดอยู่ใน `assets/code-levels.js` เพิ่มด่านใหม่ได้โดยวาดแผนที่เป็นตัวเลขความสูง

danelxdev/dragon-ball.readme:
# Dragon Ball Survivors

Fan game de supervivencia por hordas (estilo *Vampire Survivors* / *PokeSurvivor*) con temática de Dragon Ball Z.
Hecho con HTML5 Canvas y JavaScript puro: sin dependencias ni paso de compilación.

> Proyecto **no oficial y sin ánimo de lucro**. Dragon Ball es propiedad de Akira Toriyama, Bird Studio, Shueisha y Toei Animation.
>
> - **Personajes y técnicas:** sprites hechos por fans (LukasAhl1, qsab101, MV95, thekrillmaster, Manikdx2000, PeculiarDoc y otros; la lista
>   completa está en `assets/credits.json` y en la pantalla de créditos), del pack «Dragon Ball Sagas» publicado en
>   [Internet Archive](https://archive.org/details/04-mangas-dragon-ball) y de las hojas de sprites de esos artistas en DeviantArt.
> - **Música:** original, compuesta para el juego.
> - **Escenarios, efectos, objetos e interfaz:** Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku y Buu's Fury (Webfoot Technologies / Atari, GBA), vía
>   [VGMaps](https://www.vgmaps.com/Atlas/GBA/), rips de The Spriters Resource (Mister Man, Omega, ApplePie) y los proyectos fan
>   [Legacy-of-Goku-Maker-Engine](https://github.com/Arikuvfx/Legacy-of-Goku-Maker-Engine),
>   [Dragon-Ball-Z-Buu-s-Fury](https://github.com/Chakib08/Dragon-Ball-Z-Buu-s-Fury),
>   [DBZ-Legacy-of-Goku-3](https://github.com/briansukhnandan/DBZ-Legacy-of-Goku-3) y
>   [TheLegacyOfGokuClone](https://github.com/enriquefdez5/TheLegacyOfGokuClone).
>
> No lo uses con fines comerciales.

## Cómo jugarlo

**Abre `index.html` con doble clic** y listo: usa la versión empaquetada de `dist/`, con las imágenes incrustadas, así que
funciona sin servidor. También funciona tal cual en **GitHub Pages** (*Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch → main*).

### Desarrollo

`dev.html` carga directamente los módulos de `src/`, pero necesita un servidor (`npm run dev` y abrir `http://localhost:8080/dev.html`).
Después de cambiar el código o los sprites, regenera la versión empaquetada con:

```bash
npm run build   # crea dist/assets-data.js y dist/game.js
```

## Controles

| Acción | Teclado | Móvil |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Moverse | WASD / flechas | Arrastrar el dedo |
| Cambiar de ranura de técnicas | 1-4 o Q / E | Tocar la ranura (abajo) |
| Ataque definitivo (barra de ki llena) | Espacio | Botón KI |
| Elegir mejora / deseo / vínculo | 1, 2, 3 o clic | Tocar la carta |
| Cambiar opciones | R | Botón |
| Pausa | Esc / P | Botón II |

## Contenido

**La partida avanza por fases, cada vez más difíciles**, de saga en saga: la llegada de Raditz, los Saiyajin (Nappa),
Vegeta, Namek (Zarbon), las Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu, Freezer, los androides (Cell semiperfecto), los Juegos de Cell,
Majin Buu, Broly, Golden Freezer, Goku Black (Zamasu fusionado), el Torneo del Poder (Jiren) y Bills. Cada fase termina al
derrotar a su jefe (con una entrada al estilo del anime) y la siguiente tiene enemigos más fuertes; tras Bills empieza otra
ronda aún más dura. Para llegar lejos hay que conseguir guerreros mejores, **entrenarlos** con Zeni y comprar mejoras:
cada guerrero tiene un **Poder de combate (PC)** que se compara con el recomendado para la siguiente fase.

Funciona como PokeSurvivor: coleccionas guerreros con un gacha por sagas y los llevas a sobrevivir a las hordas.

- **Solo empiezas con Goku.** Los demás se consiguen invocando.
- **56 guerreros en 6 sagas** con **más de 130 formas**, incluidos Goku niño, Goku GT, Ten Shin Han, Goten, Trunks niño,
  Gohan (La resurrección de F), Vegeta copia, Trunks del Futuro (Super), Broly (Super), Jaco y Super Janemba.
  Cada uno se transforma durante la partida al subir de nivel.
- **Ranuras de técnicas (formato PokeSurvivor):** cada técnica nueva ocupa una ranura (hasta 4) y **solo dispara la activa**.
  Al derrotar a un jefe ganas un **vínculo** para fusionar dos ranuras y lanzar hasta 4 técnicas a la vez (+12% de daño por técnica).
- **Ki y ataques definitivos:** la barra de ki se llena luchando; llena, lanzas el definitivo de tu guerrero (Super Kamehameha,
  Final Flash, Genkidama, Súper Kamikaze Fantasma...) con un corte de anime.
- **Técnicas con arte de verdad:** rayos con destello y cabeza, Kikoho en espiral, ondas de llamas, fantasmas de Gotenks,
  explosiones, discos y auras, sacados de hojas de sprites de la comunidad. Gemas de ki y Bolas de Dragón dibujadas en píxeles.
- **31 técnicas y 20 técnicas definitivas por evolución** (nuevas: Ráfaga Renzoku, Hellzone Grenade, Lluvia de meteoros,
  Teletransporte y Puño del Dragón): técnica al máximo + la habilidad adecuada = carta dorada con la técnica definitiva.
- **Invocación:** se paga con **Cristales de Ki** o **tickets** (x1 y x10); el **Zeni** es para mejoras y objetos. Rarezas Común,
  Raro, Épico y Legendario, brillantes (✦), x10 con Épico garantizado y **pity** (Legendario seguro a las 70). Animación de cápsula.
  Cristales y tickets se consiguen en las partidas (jefes, élites, cápsulas), en las misiones y con el regalo diario.
- **Objetos:** uno equipado por partida; los jefes sueltan otro y eliges si cambiarlo (queda desbloqueado).
- **Animaciones:** los guerreros vuelan inclinados con estela de imágenes residuales, adoptan su pose de lanzar ki al
  atacar y parpadean al recibir golpes; enemigos, élites y jefes también tienen pose de ataque y de vuelo.
- **Enemigos:** Saibaman (normales, de colores y kamikaze), soldados de Freezer (tres tipos), Appule, Cui, Bio-Men, Cell Jr.,
  guerreros Majin, copias de Zamasu y luchadores de los universos 6 y 11, según la fase. Algunos disparan, otros embisten
  (avisan con una línea roja) y otros son tanques; al morir salen despedidos. **Élites** con contorno dorado que lanzan ráfagas de ki: Nappa, Raditz, Dodoria, Zarbon, Ginyu, Burter,
  Babidi, Pui Pui, androides... Y **14 jefes** con ataques propios: embestidas, anillos y ráfagas de ki, rayos y lluvias de ki
  que avisan en el suelo, espirales de balas, discos que te persiguen, esferas gigantes, refuerzos y teletransporte.
- **Durante la partida:** cápsulas rompibles con potenciadore

commits.msg:
Turn the run into escalating saga phases with new bosses, enemies and techniques

- 14 phases from Raditz to Beerus, each with its own zone, enemy lineup,
  elites and boss; the phase ends when the boss falls and the next one is
  harder (HP and damage scale per phase); after Beerus a tougher round starts
- 14 bosses with movesets built from a new attack library: dash, ki ring,
  aimed shots, barrage, telegraphed beam, bullet spiral, ki rain with ground
  warnings, reinforcements, homing discs,

Add animated enemies, timed elites and attack/fly/hurt animations

- New minions from community sheets: three kinds of Frieza soldiers, Appule,
  Cui and Cell Jr., wave lineups per zone (Earth, Namek, destroyed Namek)
- Elites now depend on the moment of the run (Nappa, Dodoria, Zarbon,
  Ginyu, Burter, Babidi, Pui Pui...) and fire three-shot ki bursts
- Pose detection for the Sagas pack (tools/pose_detect.py,
  tools/build_anims.py) and per-sheet poses in build_extra.py: 74 attack
  and 100 fly

Tone down the neon GBA ground and add ground detail

The Legacy of Goku tiles were authored oversaturated for the GBA screen, so the
grass looked lime green. Each biome now color-grades its tiles (and the decor)
at load time and draws a detail layer on top with soft light patches, grass

coderblack15/listener-game.readme:
# Prophecy of the Listener: Relicsong Card Game

A small card game you play in your web browser. You are the Listener, singing against the Resonance Storm. Reach 10 Resonance before the Storm's Instability reaches 10 or your Health runs out.

**Play it here:** https://coderblack15.github.io/listener-game/

**New to the game?** Read the [rules for beginners](https://coderblack15.github.io/listener-game/rules.html).

## How it works

- Each turn you can play up to 3 cards, then the Storm takes its turn.
- Every card has a tone: Calm, Empathetic, Reflective, Curious or Vulnerable. Cards that match your chosen tone give a bonus, and cards that don't match cost you.
- Shield blocks the Storm's hits, and Paradox stops your tone bonus, so keep an eye on both.

## Files

- `index.html` is the game.
- `rules.html` is the beginner's guide.

There's nothing to install. Open `index.html` in any browser to play.

Farathim89/rom-collection-checker.desc: See what you have, what's missing and what's a mess in your retro game collection (No-Intro, by content)
Farathim89/rom-collection-checker.readme:
# ROM Collection Checker

See what you have, what's missing and what's a mess in your retro game collection - a small Windows app,
the sister of [Book Collection Checker](https://github.com/Farathim89/book-collection-checker).

**Work in progress** - expect rough edges and changes.

## What it does
- **Have / missing per console** - every game file is matched against [No-Intro](https://no-intro.org)'s list of
  known dumps **by its content** (CRC), so badly named files, copier headers (SNES, PC Engine, Mega Drive â€¦), iNES
  headers, `.smd` interleave and N64 byte order don't matter. Zip, 7z and rar are read inside.
  - Regions: the picker has USA / Europe / Asia / Other (World releases always count); Settings → Regions lists every
    region of your lists (Germany, Canada, Korea …) under its group, each its own tick. Any version counts as having it.
  - Count only official games, or also unlicensed, prototypes, demos, homebrew â€¦
  - Box art (libretro thumbnails), every No-Intro version of a game with the ones you have ticked.
  - **Copy / save the missing list.**
- **Sort an inbox folder** (new downloads, packs): each game is recognised by its checksum (else its file type),
  compared with what you have and gets a plan - *move it in*, or leave it (*you have it*, *bad dump*, *hack*,
  *unknown console*). ROMs are taken out of their archives (not Nintendo DS: emulators read `.7z`) and can get their
  No-Intro name. Nothing moves until you press Apply; every sort can be undone. Afterwards the inbox is tidied: what's now in
  your collection goes to `_Duplicates\<inbox name>`, empty folders go.
  - Packs are read by their folder names too (`Atari 2600\roms`, `Sega 32X`), arcade sets (MAME, Neo Geo) are set
    aside, and other dumps of a game you already have stay in the inbox.
  - *Make console folders* adds empty `Maker\Console` folders to the inbox, laid out like your collection: a game you
    drop in one is sorted to that console.
- **Downloads** - paste links (http / https) and they download into the inbox, a few at a time, with progress,
  pause / resume / retry; unfinished ones go on after a restart, and a finished file never overwrites one that is
  there. Optionally the inbox is sorted when all are done. It downloads the links you give it - it doesn't search.
- **Clean names** - known dumps get their official No-Intro name (`smb.nes` â†’ `Super Mario Bros. (World).nes`),
  with a preview and undo.
- **Free homebrew** - browse [Homebrew Hub](https://hh.gbdev.io)'s ~1,600 free games, demos and music for Game Boy,
  Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance and NES (shared by their authors), with screenshots and licenses, and download them
  into `<console folder>\0 - Homebrew`.
- **A second check** - what No-Intro doesn't list is looked up in TOSEC and libretro's hacks and homebrew lists
  (Settings â†’ Tools & lists): known translations, hacks and releases aren't problems, Problems shows what each one
  is, and Clean names gives them their TOSEC name.
- **Problems** - duplicates, files No-Intro doesn't know (bad dumps, hacks, translations), games in the wrong console
  folder, unreadable archives.

A `0 - Name` folder in a console folder (`0 - Homebrew`, `0 - Translations`, `0 - Randomizer`) is a collection of
its own: games No-Intro doesn't know are expected there, so they are not listed as problems
([MediaDeck](https://github.com/Farathim89/MediaDeck) shows each as a tab).

Nothing is ever deleted for good: what you remove goes to the Recycle Bin. On a drive whose Recycle Bin is off the
checker refuses, and Undo parks copies in `RomChecker-data\undo\removed copies` instead.

Console folders are found by themselves in your games folder (also inside maker folders like `Nintendo\SNES`), or
chosen per console in Settings. Cartridge consoles: NES, Famicom Disk System, SNES, N64, Game Boy / Color / Advance,
Nintendo DS, Virtual Boy, Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000, Mega Drive, 32X, PC Engine, Atari 2600 / 5200 / 7800 /
Lynx, WonderSwan / Color, Neo Geo Pocket / Color, ColecoVision, MSX / MSX2.

**Nintendo Switch**: games are named by the title ID in their file names (the files are encrypted) and counted against
[titledb](https://github.com/blawar/titledb) (US eShop). Updates and DLC are shown with their game, and Problems →
*Switch updates* lists the games whose update is older than the newest.

**Disc consoles** are checked against [Redump](http://redump.org): PlayStation 1 / 2 / 3, PSP, GameCube, Wii, Saturn,
Mega-CD, Dreamcast, Xbox / 360, CD-i, PC Engine CD, PC-FX, 3DO, Amiga CD32 and CDTV.
- `.iso` and `.bin` tracks by checksum; one `.bin` with all tracks merged is checked by its first (data) track.
- `.rvz` / `.wbfs` / `.gcz` through Dolphin's `DolphinTool.exe` (found by itself, or set in Settings).
- `.cdi`, `.pbp`, `.cso`, `.chd` and repacked Xbox images can only be matched by name - shown as *by name*.
- **Quick check** (on by default): discs, DS and N64 games are named by their header - the serial and revision, a few KB per file - so a scan takes seconds; they are marked ◇ *identified*. **Verify** on a console page does the full checksum check. `.7z` archives are checked from their own index, without unpacking. PS3 game folders are named by their `PARAM.SFO`, Xbox 360 images by their `default.xex`. Sort inbox names big disc images (over 1 GB) by their header first, so it doesn't read them whole.
- Sort inbox puts a disc in a folder of its own when your discs each have one (Wii `<game>\<game>.wbfs`), and moves a disc of several files (`.cue` / `.gdi` + tracks) as one into `<console>\<Redump name>\`.

## Download
Grab the latest [release](https://github.com/Farathim89/rom-collection-checker/releases):
- **ROMCollectionChecker-portable.zip** - unzip anywhere and run `ROMCollectionChecker.exe`; settings, the No-Intro
  lists, the scan cache and the undo logs stay in the `RomChecker-data` folder next to it.

No install, no Python. Windows 10/11. SmartScreen may warn because the exe is

# Five Nights at Walid's

![Five Nights at Walid's](images/promo.png)

A FNAF-style horror game made in **TurboWarp** (Scratch) by **Tijnv50**.

You've taken the night shift. Watch the cameras, close the doors, keep an eye on your power and survive until 6 AM.
Walid isn't alone: Robo-Walid, Shadow Walid and Scrap Walid all want in. Six nights, a custom night, English and Dutch.

## Download

| Platform | File | How to play |
|---|---|---|
| **Browser** (PC, Mac, iPad, Chromebook) | [`FNAW-web.html`](download/FNAW-web.html) | Download it and open it in your browser. Works offline. |
| **Windows** | [`FNAW-windows.zip`](download/FNAW-windows.zip) | Unzip, then run `five-nights-at-walids.exe`. If Windows warns you, click *More info* → *Run anyway*. |
| **Mac** | [`FNAW-mac.zip`](download/FNAW-mac.zip) | Unzip, then **right-click** the app → *Open* (the first time only; it isn't signed by Apple). |
| **Linux** | [`FNAW-linux.zip`](download/FNAW-linux.zip) | Unzip, then run `start.sh`. |
| **TurboWarp / Scratch file** | [`FNAW.sb3`](FNAW.sb3) | Go to [turbowarp.org](https://turbowarp.org), *File → Load from your computer*, pick `FNAW.sb3`, press the green flag. |

On the download page of a file, press the **download** button (top right of the file view).

The game needs **TurboWarp**: it won't run on scratch.mit.edu (it uses TurboWarp extensions for saving and controllers).

## Controls

Keyboard, touch screen or a game controller: pick yours in the game's **CONTROLS** menu, it shows every button.

## Saving

Your progress (the night you're on and your stars) is saved in the browser / app automatically.
**SETTINGS → RESET SAVE** wipes it.

![Screenshots](images/preview.png)

## Credits

- Game, idea and Walid: **Tijnv50**
- Built with [TurboWarp](https://turbowarp.org) and the [TurboWarp Packager](https://packager.turbowarp.org).
- Sound effects: CC0 recordings and sounds made from scratch.

Fan game inspired by *Five Nights at Freddy's* by Scott Cawthon. Not affiliated with it.

# Shell Shockers — Gun Sounds **Swap your weapon sounds in [Shell Shockers](https://shellshock.io) for a meme sound or your own MP3.**
[![Install Gun Sounds](https://img.shields.io/badge/Install_Gun_Sounds-one_click-2ea44f?style=for-the-badge&logo=tampermonkey&logoColor=white)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Virojet/Shell-Shockers-Gun-Sounds/main/Shell-Shockers-Gun-Sounds.user.js) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.3-0E7697?style=flat-square)](./Shell-Shockers-Gun-Sounds.user.js) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE)
--- ## Install 1. **Get Tampermonkey** for your browser: [Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/tampermonkey/dhdgffkkebhmkfjojejmpbldmpobfkfo) · [Edge](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/tampermonkey/iikmkjmpaadaobahmlepeloendndfphd) · [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/tampermonkey/) · [Opera GX & others](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) 2. **[Click here to install Gun Sounds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Virojet/Shell-Shockers-Gun-Sounds/main/Shell-Shockers-Gun-Sounds.user.js)**, then press **Install** 3. **Reload [shellshock.io](https://shellshock.io)** > [!TIP] > Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera need **Allow User Scripts** turned on: Extensions → Tampermonkey → Details. ## What it does Pick a sound for each weapon slot. It plays for **every weapon in that slot**, whatever the gun or skin. | Slot | Weapons | |---|---| | **Primary** | Every primary gun (and any added later) | | **Secondary** | Cluck 9mm | | **Melee** | Every melee weapon | - **Sounds:** **AWP**, **Punch**, **Reverb Fart**, **Tuturu**, **Vine Boom**, **Game sound** (leave that slot alone), or **My MP3**. - **My MP3:** choose **Choose MP3 file…** in a slot's list and pick a file (MP3, OGG or WAV, up to 4 MB). Its name shows next to the slot, and it's kept in your browser, one per slot. - **Your shots only** by default. Tick **Everyone's weapons** to change other players' weapons too. - **Volume** slider, plus the game's **Sound Effects** volume. - Works alongside [Valorant Kill Sounds](https://github.com/Virojet/Shell-Shockers-Valorant-Kill-Sounds) and [Better HUD](https://github.com/Virojet/Shell-Shockers-Better-Hud-Mod). - Updates itself through Tampermonkey. Works on shellshock.io and its mirrors. The meme sounds aren't in the script. The first time you pick one it downloads from this project's [sounds](./sounds) folder and is kept in your browser. ## Settings **Settings** ▸ the **speaker tab** ▸ **Gun Sounds**, under Language and Kill Sounds. **Test** plays a slot's sound. Changes are kept when you press **Confirm**. If the settings are taller than your screen, scroll them. ## Changelog ### 1.0.3 - **Fixed:** the sounds now play when you shoot in a real match. Earlier versions missed your own shots, because the game plays them from your egg's position like everyone else's. Other players' weapons still keep their sounds unless **Everyone's weapons** is ticked.
Older versions ### 1.0.2 - The settings popup scrolls when it's taller than your screen, so Confirm and the close button are always reachable. - The lists show the full sound names, and the labels match the game's. - Your own file is picked from the list (**Choose MP3 file…**), and its name shows next to the slot, so the settings don't grow. ### 1.0.1 The Gun Sounds settings are now one short strip (Primary, Secondary and Melee side by side). ### 1.0.0 First release.

# Jagoan Kotak

Game petualangan-tarung 3D bergaya dunia kotak (ala Minecraft) yang dimainkan dengan **gerakan badan** di depan webcam. Tujuannya mengubah waktu main HP yang diam jadi aktivitas fisik: makin banyak bergerak, makin kuat jurusnya. Semua karakter **tanpa wajah**.

## Gerakan

| Jalan di tempat (angkat lutut bergantian; kalau lutut tidak terlihat, dibaca dari goyangan naik-turun badan) | Maju; cepat = lari | W / ↑ (Shift = lari) | Stik ke atas |
| Toleh kepala **atau** miringkan badan ke kiri / kanan | Belok (di mode kamera jagoan juga pelan-pelan menghadap monster terdekat) | A / D, ← / → | Stik kiri / kanan |
| Dongak / tunduk | Lihat atas / bawah (membidik kelelawar) | Tahan Q / E | Tahan ☁️ |
| Tinju ke depan (kiri / kanan) | Pukulan angin dari tangan itu | J / K atau klik kiri / kanan | 👊 |
| Kedua tangan di depan wajah | Perisai (tangkis serangan dari depan) | Tahan L | Tahan 🛡️ |
| Lompat sungguhan | Lompat | Spasi | 🦘 |
| Lompat lagi saat jagoan masih di udara | Lompat ganda + salto | Spasi 2× | 🦘 2× |
| Jongkok lalu langsung lompat | Lompat tinggi | Tahan C + Spasi | Tahan 🙇 + 🦘 |
| Jongkok | Merunduk (hindari sambaran kelelawar) | Tahan C | Tahan 🙇 |
| Angkat kedua tangan saat energi penuh | Jurus Hentak Bumi (kena semua monster di sekitar) | U | ⭐ |

## Mekanik

- **Gelombang monster**: slime (pecah jadi dua slime kecil), monster kotak (gemetar dulu sebelum memukul, jadi ada waktu untuk menangkis), kelelawar (gemetar lalu menyambar setinggi kepala, jadi harus jongkok, menangkis, atau ditinju sambil mendongak), dan monster besar di gelombang lanjut.
- **Energi jurus** terisi dari **langkah kaki**, pukulan yang kena, dan tangkisan, jadi anak didorong untuk terus bergerak.
- **5 nyawa**. Monster menjatuhkan 💎 permata dan kadang ❤️. Setiap gelombang yang selesai memberi +1 ❤️.
- **Latihan gerakan** 8 langkah sebelum main pertama kali, dan bisa diulang dari layar akhir.
- **Ringkasan aktivitas** di akhir: langkah, tinju, lompat, menit bergerak, perkiraan kalori, dan monster yang dikalahkan.
- **Kunci pemain**: orang lain yang lewat di depan kamera diabaikan. Game berhenti sejenak kalau pemain tidak terlihat lebih dari 2 detik.
- **Lemari 👕**: baju (warna & berpola: jaket, belang, ninja, zirah, emas), celana, sepatu, rambut, kulit (selalu gratis), topi (pet, kupluk, ikat kepala, baling-baling, viking, helm ksatria, mahkota), dan punggung (ransel, jubah, pedang, jetpack, sayap). Dibeli dengan 💎 dari monster dan **bonus gerak** di akhir game (1 💎 per 20 langkah + 2 💎 per gelombang); pemain baru mendapat 30 💎. Barang hanya kosmetik, semua tanpa wajah. Coba dulu sebelum membeli; tersimpan di perangkat.
- **Jalan → lari** mulus: laju naik bertahap, badan makin condong, lengan berayun lebih lebar, debu di setiap jejak; di mode kamera lari mulai di 2.4 langkah/dtk dan kembali jalan di bawah 1.9.
- **Menu utama**: jagoan 3D memamerkan gerakan, halaman *Cara main*, tombol suara/musik, serta catatan rekor gelombang, total langkah, dan monster yang dikalahkan (disimpan di perangkat).
- **Layar akhir**: 1–3 bintang, lencana *Rekor baru*, ringkasan aktivitas.
- **Bidik ramah anak**: pukulan otomatis sedikit membelok ke monster di depan. Kelelawar di atas tetap harus dibidik dengan mendongak.

## Anti pusing

Tombol 🌀 di menu (bawaan: menyala). Dasarnya riset *motion sickness* di game: pusing muncul saat mata melihat gerakan yang tidak dirasakan badan. Pemicu terbesarnya putaran kamera, perubahan laju, kamera yang bergerak sendiri, frame tersendat, serta goyangan atau kelip layar.

- **Belok patah** di mode kamera: setiap toleh atau miring langsung memutar 30° tanpa putaran yang terlihat (riset *snap turning*: rasa mual turun sekitar 40%). Kalau 🌀 dimatikan, belok tetap halus, maksimal 69°/detik, dengan awal dan akhir yang pelan.
- **Tidak ada kamera yang berputar sendiri.** Monster yang tidak terlihat ditunjukkan dengan panah di tepi layar.
- **Laju berubah pelan**, dan lari lebih pelan saat 🌀 menyala.
- **Dongak** hanya sedikit menggeser kamera, dan getaran kepala diredam.
- Kamera yang terhalang pohon maju lebih lembut dan mundur pelan, tidak maju-mundur cepat.
- **Deteksi pose di Web Worker**, jadi gambar tetap 60 fps rata di mode kamera.
- Tekstur tanah tidak berkelip di kejauhan (mipmap linear + anisotropi) dan kontras rumputnya lebih lembut.

## Teknis

Performa: peta bayangan dunia dibuat sekali saja (karakter memakai bayangan bulat), menu dan jeda dibatasi 30 fps, resolusi turun/naik otomatis sesuai kemampuan perangkat, shader monster dikompilasi di awal, dan geometri barang/efek dipakai ulang supaya game tidak makin berat seiring waktu.

Cara membaca gerakan (`js/motion.js`): MediaPipe memberi 33 titik tubuh per frame. Semua jarak dibagi panjang badan (bahu–pinggul), jadi tidak tergantung jauh-dekatnya pemain. Kalibrasi 3 detik merekam pose tegak sebagai titik nol. Langkah = satu lutut naik sementara lutut lain tetap; belok = posisi hidung terhadap telinga dan geser bahu terhadap pinggul; tinju = pergelangan maju cepat (kedalaman 3D) atau hentakan cepat menjauh dari bahu (2D); perisai = kedua tangan di depan wajah; lompat/jongkok = pinggul naik/turun dibanding kalibrasi.

Statis tanpa build: Three.js 0.160 (importmap CDN) dan MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.14 (Pose Landmarker lite, 2 orang, landmark 2D + dunia). Dunia dibuat dari balok InstancedMesh dengan tekstur piksel dari kanvas, dan suara serta musik disintesis dengan Web Audio. Gambar kamera hanya diproses di perangkat.

```
python3 -m http.server 5190     # buka http://localhost:5190/   (?debug untuk window.__game)
```

File: `js/main.js` (loop game), `js/wardrobe.js` (lemari, dompet, aksesori 3D), `js/pose-worker.js` (MediaPipe di Web Worker), `js/motion.js` (membaca gerakan, bisa diuji dengan landmark buatan), `js/world.js`, `js/characters.js`, `js/audio.js`.

subbu5280/local-ai-android.readme:
# Local AI

A private AI assistant that runs **on your Android phone**. Chat, ask questions about your own documents, run small
agents, and review code, with a language model under 4B parameters that works offline once it is downloaded. Built
for six languages: English, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam.

Nothing you type, import or record is uploaded. The network is used only for downloads you confirm, live questions
you ask (weather, news, prices), and MCP servers you add yourself.

This is a separate, enhanced successor to [AI-ChatBot](https://github.com/subbu5280/AI-ChatBot), whose features it
carries over without needing its laptop backend.

## Features

| | What you can do | Guide |
|---|---|---|
| 💬 **Chat** | On-device answers in six languages; Stop; Copy, Reply, Speak; prompt preview; saved chats | [User guide](docs/user-guide.md) |
| 📄 **Documents** | Import TXT, Markdown, CSV, PDF, Word, Excel, scans and photos (OCR); search; cited answers; exact spreadsheet totals | [Documents](docs/documents.md) |
| 🤖 **Agents** | Tasks run as checked tool steps; reusable skills and workflows | [Agents](docs/agents.md), [Skills and workflows](docs/skills-and-workflows.md) |
| ⌨️ **Code** | Ask about, debug and review a project folder; approve proposed changes file by file | [Coding assistant](docs/coding-assistant.md) |
| 🌦 **Live info** | Weather, time, prices and news from free services, with sources | [User guide](docs/user-guide.md#live-information-online) |
| 🎙 **Voice and photos** | Speak in six languages; ask about a photo with an on-device image model | [User guide](docs/user-guide.md#voice) |
| 🎮 **Games** | Tic-Tac-Toe, Rock Paper Scissors, Number Guessing, Memory Match, full screen or in chat | [User guide](docs/user-guide.md#games) |
| ⏰ **Scheduled tasks** | "Schedule daily 08:00 …" reminds you with a notification | [User guide](docs/user-guide.md#scheduled-tasks) |
| 🔌 **Connections** | Opt-in remote MCP servers; every tool off by default, every call confirmed | [User guide](docs/user-guide.md#connections-mcp-online) |
| 🛡 **Your data** | Password-encrypted backup and restore, storage report, cleanup | [Backup and restore](docs/backup-and-restore.md) |

## Requirements

- Node.js 22.11+, JDK 17, Android SDK (compileSdk 37, NDK 27.1).
- An arm64 Android phone (or an x86_64 emulator) with about 2 GB free for the chat model. Tested on a Samsung
  Galaxy M35 (Android 16, 8 GB RAM).

## Setup

```sh
git clone https://github.com/subbu5280/local-ai-android.git
cd local-ai-android
npm install
```

On Windows, run `npm install` from PowerShell or cmd, not Git Bash: llama.rn's install script calls `tar`, and Git
Bash's GNU tar misreads `C:\...` paths.

## Run

```sh
npm start             # Metro bundler
npm run android       # build and install the debug app on a connected phone or emulator
```

For a standalone release build: `cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease` (output in
`android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/`). Signing and the release checklist: [docs/release.md](docs/release.md).

## Usage

1. Open the app and tap **Get model** (1.1 GB, once; Wi-Fi recommended). It is checked against its SHA-256 first.
2. When the status shows **● On-device · offline ready**, type in any of the six languages and tap **Send**.
3. Try:
   - `Kafka గురించి చెప్పండి` gets an answer in Telugu.
   - **Docs → Import** a PDF, turn on **Docs**, ask `What is the refund period?` and get an answer with its source.
   - `What is the total amount for North?` about a spreadsheet is calculated exactly by the app.
   - `Schedule daily 08:00 Give me one interview question`.
   - `Play tic tac toe`.

The language rules can also be used directly in code:

```ts
import { detect, instruction } from './src/core/language';

const lang = detect('Kafka గురించి చెప్పండి');  // { code: 'te', source: 'script', bcp47: 'te-IN', ... }
instruction(lang);                               // "Language: Respond in Telugu written in Telugu script. ..."
detect('ok', lang.code).code;                    // 'te': a short reply keeps the chat's language
```

## Tests

```sh
npm test               # 430 Jest tests
npm run release-check  # typecheck, lint, tests, manifest, permission and secret checks
```

More, including evaluations, emulator and phone checks, and what has been verified on which device:
[docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md).

## Known limits

- **Translation into Indian languages is poor** with the 1.5B model (chrF 10–20 of 100); the app shows a caution.
  [Measured results](eval/results/translation-m13.md).
- OCR is reliable on clean print; photos of handwriting or poor scans will contain mistakes.
- The model runs only while the app is open; scheduled tasks remind you rather than answer in the background.
- Not yet run on the phone: backup and restore, MCP with a real server, live data, voice and the image model.

## Documentation

| Guide | For |
|---|---|
| [User guide](docs/user-guide.md) | Everything on the phone, screen by screen |
| [Documents](docs/documents.md) | Formats, search, OCR, meaning search, Docs mode |
| [Agents](docs/agents.md) · [Skills and workflows](docs/skills-and-workflows.md) | Tools, plans, runs, formats |
| [Coding assistant](docs/coding-assistant.md) | Workspaces, review, proposals, approval |
| [Backup and restore](docs/backup-and-restore.md) | Encryption, format, restore modes |
| [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) | Routing, native modules, schema, project layout |
| [Security](docs/security.md) | Threat model, permissions, boundaries |
| [Testing](docs/testing.md) · [Evaluation](eval/README.md) | How it is tested and measured |
| [Release](docs/release.md) | Building, signing, release checks |
| [Demo script](docs/demo.md) | A 10-minute walkthrough |

## Licenses

App code: this repository. Models and components are downloaded separately, each under its own license:
Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (Apache-2.0), multilingual-e5-small (MIT), Tesseract and tessdata_fast (Apache-2.0).

# Highway 1

A tiny, private, chaotic arcade driving game set on 15 real miles of **Iowa Highway 1,
from the IA-22 four-way stop in Kalona to the US-218 interchange at Iowa City.**
Made for fun with friends; not for sale. The full plan is in [PLAN.md](PLAN.md).

**Play it:** grab `HighwayOne-windows.zip` from the
[latest release](https://github.com/DBYoder/Driving-Game/releases/latest), unzip, run
`HighwayOne.exe`. (Windows will warn about an unknown publisher: *More info → Run anyway*.)

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Traffic north of Kalona](docs/screenshots/mile-1-traffic.png) | ![Corn near mile 5](docs/screenshots/mile-5-corn.png) |
| ![The long view down into the valley at mile 9](docs/screenshots/mile-9-long-view.png) | ![Drone view at mile 7](docs/screenshots/mile-7-drone.png) |
| ![The garage](docs/screenshots/garage.png) | ![A beat-up Legend](docs/screenshots/legend-beat-up.png) |
| ![A Johnson County deputy on a Windstar's tail](docs/screenshots/speed-trap-chase.png) | ![Deer crossing near the creek at mile 4](docs/screenshots/deer-crossing.png) |

## Status

**v0.4: cops and deer.** Sheriff's deputies run speed traps (one in Washington County,
three in Johnson County, in different spots every run). Blow past one and they chase
you. Stop and you're busted; lose them, or drag the Washington County deputy over the
county line, for points. Deer bolt across near the creeks: hold your line and they
miss you, or don't and they won't.

The cars (since v0.3) are a 1998 Windstar, a Tercel and an Acura Legend. Each has its
own handling, toughness and points multiplier, plus dents and signature parts that fly
off; you pick one and a paint color in the garage. They drive the actual Highway 1:
real curves, hills, crossroads, street names and passing zones from USGS data, with a
long view (haze out to 3 km) and deep corn fields.

It's a score attack from Kalona to the US-218 overpass: smash mailboxes, fences and hay
bales, plow corn, get air, near-miss oncoming traffic, get around Amish buggies and
tractors, and don't wreck. Low-poly, built to run on a potato. See the roadmap in
PLAN.md for what's next.

## Layout

```
game/                  Godot 4.6.3 project (GL Compatibility renderer)
  data/route/          baked road, terrain and horizon (generated, committed)
  scripts/route/       RouteData, TerrainTiles, HorizonTerrain: loading and querying the baked data
  scripts/world/       road and terrain meshes and colliders, streaming, roadside signs
  scripts/car/         raycast car physics, the three cars (CarStats), models and damage,
                       drivers, engine sound
  scripts/game/        run rules, scoring and combos, timing and records, QA test drives
  scripts/props/       mailboxes, fences, hay bales, corn clumps and the corn canopy
  scripts/traffic/     other road users and crashing into them
  scripts/cops/        speed traps, chases and their rules, the deputies' driving, the siren
  scripts/hazards/     deer
  scripts/ui/          the HUD, results and the garage (car select)
  shaders/             flat-shaded terrain and road paint
  tests/               headless GDScript tests
tools/                 Python pipeline that bakes the road from USGS data
docs/                  route previews, screenshots, the README that ships in the zip
.github/workflows/     CI: tests, Windows/Linux export, screenshots, releases
```

## Developing

**Game:** install [Godot 4.6.3](https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.6.3-stable/)
(standard build, not .NET), open `game/project.godot`, press F5.

```sh
godot --headless --path game --import                   # first time, or after adding files
godot --headless --path game -s res://tests/run_tests.gd  # unit tests
godot --path game -- --car=tercel --station=15000 --view=3  # skip the garage, mid-route, drone view
godot --path game -- --autopilot --autopilot-mph=90       # watch the autopilot drive (and pass)
godot --path game -- --station=2400 --traffic-near        # start with traffic in view
godot --path game -- --car=windstar --station=6000 --chase  # a deputy already on your tail
godot --path game -- --station=6600 --deer=25 --view=1     # deer crossing just ahead

# Automated test drives, headless and ~25x faster than real time:
godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path game -- --qa-drive            # autopilot, all 15 miles
godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path game -- --qa-stress --seed=1  # hooligan inputs
godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path game -- --qa-drift            # scripted handbrake turn
godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path game -- --qa-cops=bust --no-traffic  # get busted (or =line)
godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path game -- --qa-deer --no-traffic       # a herd, then a hit
godot --path game -- --benchmark                                      # fps, draw calls, triangles
godot --path game -- --car=legend --damage=0.7 --orbit                # look at the damage
godot --path game -- --tune=handbrake_grip:0.5                        # try a CarStats tweak
```

**Road data:** only needed to re-bake (the baked files are committed).

```sh
pip install -r tools/requirements.txt
python tools/bake_route.py     # downloads ~190 MB of USGS road data once, caches it in tools/.cache/
python tools/preview_route.py  # writes docs/route-preview/*.png to eyeball the result
python -m pytest tools/tests
```

Pushes to `main` build a Windows zip and publish it as a GitHub release.

## Data credits

- Road centerlines: USGS National Transportation Dataset (NTD) for Iowa, public domain.
- Elevation: USGS 3D Elevation Program, 1/3 arc-second DEM, public domain.
- Engine: [Godot](https://godotengine.org), MIT license.

# Brain Training

Brain-training games plus a murder-mystery campaign: each minigame she wins
reveals a clue, and she works out who did it, where and with what on a house
map and a cross-out grid.

React + TypeScript + Vite, installable as a PWA, no backend.

## Run it

Needs Node 22.18 or newer.

```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # open the URL it prints; on your phone use the Network URL
npm test             # engine unit tests
npm run check-cases  # generate 300 cases and confirm each has exactly one solution
```

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `src/content/` | House, suspects, items. Placeholder names; swap the theme here. |
| `src/engine/` | Seeded generator, clue pool, solver and clue trimmer. No React. |
| `src/game/` | The casebook: clues, map, grids, accusation, saved progress, game screens. |
| `src/games/` | Puzzle logic: Wordle scoring, cat puzzle and sudoku generators. No React. |
| `src/dev/CaseInspector.tsx` | Dev page (add `#dev` to the URL): step through cases, see clues and the answer. |
| `scripts/check-cases.ts` | The 100-cases-per-difficulty uniqueness check. |

## How a case is made

1. The case number becomes a seed, so case 7 is always the same case.
2. The truth is rolled: each suspect gets a room and an item; one is the murderer.
3. Every true clue is listed (in/not in a room, holding/not holding an item,
   either/or rooms, next to a room, neighbouring suspects).
4. Clues are added in a weighted random order until only one answer is left,
   then any clue the others make redundant is removed.
5. Each clue is assigned to a minigame that will reveal it.

Difficulty changes the number of suspects and which clue types are allowed.

## Deploying

`.github/workflows/deploy.yml` runs the tests and the case check, builds, and
publishes to GitHub Pages on every push to `main`. Turn it on once in the repo's
Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions.

## Status

- [x] Phase 1: content data
- [x] Phase 2: generator and solver
- [x] Phase 3: casebook UI (map, cross-out grid, accusation)
- [x] Phase 4: minigames that deliver clues (Wordle, cat puzzle, sudoku, questioning, final questioning)
- [ ] Phase 5: modes, campaign progression, saved progress
- [ ] Phase 6: playtest and tuning

# Next Read

Live NFL drive predictions: for the team with the ball, each receiver's chance of at least one target and one catch before the drive ends.

## What's in here

| Folder | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `model/build_model.py` | Builds the model from free nflverse play-by-play and runs the backtest |
| `out/model.json` | The built model (2026 season through Week 6) |
| `out/backtest_summary.json` | Weeks 3–5 backtest results |
| `app/template.html` | The app (one page, works on phones and desktops) |
| `app/build_page.py` | Puts the model into the page |
| `server/` | Small Node server: hosts the page, `/api/games` (live scoreboard) and `/api/game/:id` (players out, catches so far) |

## Update the model each week (Tuesday, after Monday night)

```bash
mkdir -p data
for y in 2024 2025 2026; do
  curl -L -o data/pbp_$y.csv.gz https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/download/pbp/play_by_play_$y.csv.gz
done
curl -L -o data/rosters_2026.csv https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/download/weekly_rosters/roster_weekly_2026.csv
pip install pandas numpy
DECAY=0.85 K_CTX=40 A_SHARE=15 CAL=0.8 K_LIVE=25 KC_LIVE=10 python3 model/build_model.py data data out
python3 app/build_page.py
```

To re-check accuracy on a finished week (example: Week 6), add `--holdout-week 6`.

## Run it with live data on your computer

Needs Node 18 or newer.

```bash
cd server
node server.js
```

Open http://localhost:3000. Every game this week is listed. Tap one and the board follows whoever has the ball, refreshing every 4 seconds.

## Put it online for free (website + phone app)

1. Make a free GitHub account and upload this folder as a new repository.
2. On render.com, create a **Web Service** from that repository.
   - Build command: `echo ok`
   - Start command: `node server/server.js`
   - Instance type: Free
3. Open the URL Render gives you.
4. On a phone, open that URL and choose **Add to Home Screen**. It then opens like an app.

The free Render tier sleeps after about 15 minutes with no visitors, so the first load can take up to a minute.

## Before charging anyone

- `server.js` reads ESPN's public scoreboard. That feed is unofficial and meant for personal use.
- Point `liveFeed()` in `server.js` (and its `simplify()` parser) at a licensed feed, such as API-Sports or BallDontLie, before charging subscribers.
- Add Stripe Payment Links for the $9.99/month plan.
- Keep the disclaimer and the 1-800-GAMBLER line in the footer.

# سين جيم القرآن

**أُنس ومُدارسة** — a Quran trivia party game for 1–4 players, built around المتشابهات.

## Concept

- Jeopardy-style board: 4 categories × 5 point values (100–500).
- Categories: أكمل الآية · الخاتمة · ما بعدها؟ · من أي سورة؟
- Players take turns picking a tile; a wrong answer lets the next player steal for half points.
- Lifeline per player: ٥٠:٥٠.

## Text accuracy rule

Every piece of Quran text shown is verbatim from a verified source (Tanzil / KFGQPC / quran.com).
Nothing is generated or altered: wrong options are real fragments from *other* ayahs, so the
question is always "which one belongs here?", never "is this real?".

## Content pipeline

```sh
npm install
npm run content                       # build corpus + generate questions + report
npm run preview -- complete 300 5     # print samples: [category] [level] [count]
```

1. **Corpus** (`scripts/build-corpus.ts`): parses the Tanzil text into words with `surah:ayah:word`
   addresses and fails unless every ayah rebuilds byte-for-byte from the stored words. The basmala
   prefixed to ayah 1 is split off (detected by normalized form; 95 and 97 write it as بِّسْمِ).
2. **Curated inputs** (`data/curated/`): surah familiarity tiers and alternate names, famous ayahs
   (tier 1 overrides), exclusion rules.
3. **Generators** (`scripts/generators/`), one per category, run over the whole Quran:
   - `complete` — phrases shared between places; options are what follows in each place.
   - `ending` — recurring closing formulas; options are similar formulas.
   - `rhyme` (also خاتمة الآية) — last word of ayahs in well-known short surahs; short ayahs get the
     previous ayah as context; options are rhyming last words from the same surah, then other surahs.
   - `next` — next ayah's opening; options follow similar ayahs or sit nearby.
   - `surah` — ayahs worded in exactly one surah; options are surahs with similar ayahs.
4. **Checks** applied to every candidate: one correct answer for the stated context (otherwise the
   ayah number is shown, or the question is dropped); fragments end only at ۖ ۗ ۚ ۘ or the ayah end
   (never ۙ); no wrong option that the true ayah also continues with; options ≤ 10 words, prompts ≤ 15.
5. **Difficulty**: `0.55·tier + 0.3·similarity of closest wrong option + 0.15·prompt shortness (+0.1 if
   the ayah number is needed)`, mapped to 100–500 by fixed thresholds.

Output (git-ignored, rebuilt on demand): `data/build/questions.json` holds **addresses only**, never
copied text; `data/build/report.md` is the coverage report.

## App

```sh
npm run dev     # http://localhost:5173 — copies the built data into public/data first
npm run build   # regenerate content, typecheck, build to dist/
```

- `src/data.ts` loads `corpus.json`, `questions.json`, `surahs.json` and rebuilds all displayed text from word addresses.
- `src/board.ts` fills each tile with a random question from its category × level pool; no ayah appears in two
  questions on one board; questions already shown on this device (localStorage) are skipped until the pool runs out.
- `src/main.ts` runs the game: turns, timer, 50:50, steal for half points, reveal with sources.

## Layout

- `index.html`, `src/` — the web app.
- `mockup/index.html` — original standalone visual mockup.
- `scripts/` — content pipeline.
- `data/source/` — pinned Tanzil text and metadata.
- `data/curated/` — hand-maintained inputs.

jbman03/starwake.readme:
# Starwake (working title)

An original 2D space trading and combat game inspired by the classic
Escape Velocity series (EV, Override, Nova). It runs in the browser and
installs as an app on PC and phone.

All names, story, art and sound are original. EV's mechanics are the
inspiration; none of its copyrighted content is used.

## Play

https://jbman03.github.io/starwake/

## Development

```
npm install
npm run dev        # dev server at http://localhost:5173
npm test           # unit tests (vitest)
npm run test:e2e   # end-to-end tests (Playwright, chromium)
npm run build      # typecheck + production build into dist/
```

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs typecheck, unit tests and e2e on every
push and pull request. Pushes to `main` deploy to GitHub Pages
(`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`).

## Controls

### PC

Arrow keys fly: Up thrusts, Left/Right turn, Down reverses. Default hotkeys
(rebindable in settings):

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Space | Fire primary weapon |
| Shift | Fire secondary weapon |
| X | Auto-stop |
| Tab | Next target |
| R | Nearest hostile (refuel while landed) |
| F | Face target |
| L | Land (leave while landed) |
| J | Hyperspace jump |
| G | Autopilot |
| M | Map |
| Esc | Pause / back |

### Phone

- Play in landscape; the on-screen controls sit in side rails.
- Tap a planet to land on it.
- Install it: browser menu, then Add to Home Screen, to run full screen
  and offline.

## Stack

- **Engine:** Phaser + TypeScript, built with Vite
- **App shell:** PWA (installable, full screen, works offline)
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages, auto-deploy on push to `main`
- **Game data:** JSON files for ships, outfits, systems, missions
- **Saves:** browser storage first, cloud sync later

## Roadmap

1. Flight prototype: one ship in one system, touch + keyboard controls
2. Galaxy: hyperspace jumps, map, landing on planets
3. Economy: trading, shipyard, outfitter
4. Combat and AI: pirates, escorts, factions
5. Missions and storylines

See `docs/design-notes.md` for the game vision.

Saupernova13/ts3-online.readme:
# ts3-online

**4-player co-op for *Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3* on PC, built to be played online with each
player on a screen of their own.**

The PC release (*Toy Story 3 Complete Edition*, Steam app 4049180) has 2-player local split
screen and no network play. This project raises the player limit to 4 with a runtime patch loader,
and plans to put each player's quarter of the screen online by game streaming over a private
network (Tailscale). No game files are included or modified; everything is applied in memory to
your own install.

## Status

| | |
|---|---|
| 4 players join from their own pads (drop-in) | working |
| 4-way split screen with a follow camera per player | working |
| All 4 players move and play | working |
| Leaving and re-entering a level with 4 players | working (players 3/4 press Start again) |
| Force 4 quarters for streaming (`enable=quadrants`) | built, not yet tested in game |
| Borderless window placement (`window=`) | built, not yet tested in game |
| HUD for players 3/4 (health, ammo, compass) | missing |
| Streaming each quarter to a remote player | designed, not built ([PLAN, phase 6](docs/PLAN.md)) |

Tested in Toy Box with four virtual Xbox 360 pads. Story levels have not been played with 4
players yet; their scripts assume at most two avatars, so expect rough edges there.

## How it works

1. **Loader.** `dinput8.dll` is a proxy DLL: the game loads it from its own folder, it patches the
   game in memory before the game starts, then forwards to the real system DLL. It checks the exe's
   build and every original byte first, and patches nothing if anything differs.
2. **Player limit.** The game's player manager is compiled for 2 players. The loader moves it to a
   larger buffer with room for 4, raises about 120 `idx < 2` checks to `< 4`, and replaces join, bind,
   controls and level-teardown code that hardcodes player 1 with Rust functions that take the
   player index. The renderer and input already handle 4 views and 4 pads. Every change is listed
   in [docs/PATCHES.md](docs/PATCHES.md).
3. **Online (planned).** The host runs the game at 3840x2160 with a fixed 2x2 split. One streaming
   server per player (Apollo/Sunshine) sends a 1920x1080 quarter to that player's Moonlight client
   over Tailscale, and each client's pad comes back as a virtual XInput pad. See
   [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md) for the rig design and its open problems.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 x64 with the Steam version of *Toy Story 3 Complete Edition*. The loader only
  patches the build it was made for (exe TimeDateStamp `0x6abf29b6`) and leaves any other build
  untouched; a Steam update means the addresses have to be found again.
- Up to 4 XInput controllers (Xbox pads, or virtual ones).
- To build: a Rust toolchain with the `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` target, and Git Bash for the
  helper scripts.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Saupernova13/ts3-online
cd ts3-online/loader && cargo build --release && cd ..
tools/deploy_loader.sh            # copies loader/target/release/dinput8.dll into the game folder
```

`deploy_loader.sh` finds the game through Steam's library list, or set `TS3_DIR` to the game
folder. Launch the game from Steam as usual. `tools/deploy_loader.sh --remove` deletes the DLL again
(only if it is ours).

Toy Box autosaves. Back up `%APPDATA%\Disney\Toy Story 3 Complete Edition` before trying it.

## Playing with 4 players

1. Start a level with player 1, for example Toy Box.
2. On each extra pad, press **Start** and pick a character in the JOIN IN menu. Taken characters
   are spawned again, so two players can both be Woody.
3. The screen splits into 2, 3 or 4 views as players join.

After a level change, players 3 and 4 press Start again; the game itself only brings back
players 1 and 2. The character select before a level also only knows players 1 and 2.

## Configuration

Optional `ts3online.ini` next to the game exe, `key=value` lines:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `1` | `0` turns the loader off entirely |
| `watch` | `1` | log player-manager, input and split-screen state changes |
| `watch_interval_ms` | `500` | how often the watcher samples |
| `enable` | (none) | optional patch groups, comma-separated. `quadrants` always splits into 4 equal quarters |
| `window` | (none) | `x,y,w,h`: make the game window borderless at that rect and keep it there |

The game window size comes from the game's own `-dxresolution WxH` launch option.

The loader writes `ts3online.log` next to the exe on every start. A `ts3online.patches.json` next
to the exe replaces the built-in patch set.

## Known limitations

- No HUD for players 3/4. The HUD screens define player 1 and 2 instances by name in the game's
  screen assets.
- Players 3/4 have to re-join after every level change.
- Shared-screen moments (players close together, scripted shots) drop to one full-screen view,
  as in the original game.
- Only tested in Toy Box so far.

## Building and testing

```sh
cd loader
cargo build --release     # -> target/release/dinput8.dll
cargo test                # patch document parsing, encodings, config
```

In-game tests can be driven with virtual pads (`tools/pad.py`, ViGEmBus + `vgamepad`); the route
and checks are in [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md). The loader's watcher log shows each step.

## Reproducing the analysis

Everything in [docs/FINDINGS.md](docs/FINDINGS.md) can be reproduced with headless Ghidra. Needs
Ghidra 12.x, a JDK 21+, Python 3 with `pefile`, and Git Bash on Windows.

```sh
export GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR=/path/to/ghidra_12.x
export JAVA_HOME=/path/to/jdk-21

# one-off: import and analyse the unpatched exe (10-20 minutes)
tools/ghidra.sh import "/path/to/Toy Story 3 Complete Edition.exe"

# run a query file; output goes to work/out/<name>.txt
tools/ghidra.sh query queries/01-input-and-split-mode.cmd

# player-manager map and MAX_PLAYERS bound sites
tools/ghidra.sh script PlayerMgrDump.java "$(cygpath -w work/out/pm_du

# Berghittn

Browser-first wave-survival shooter. Design: see `GAME_DESIGN.md`.

## Toolchain (recorded at project start)

- Godot **4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf**, Compatibility renderer (WebGL2)
- Web export template variant: single-threaded, no GDExtension (`thread_support=false`)
- Node.js 24.21.0, wrangler 4.151.1 (run via `npx wrangler@latest`)

## Build

```
godot --headless --import      # first run only / after adding assets
node tools/build_web.mjs       # headless export + wasm packing, prints every file size
```

Output goes to `export/` (gitignored). The script exits non-zero if any file is over 20 MiB.

### Why the wasm is packed

The Godot 4.7 engine wasm is ~37.7 MiB, over Cloudflare Pages' 25 MiB per-file limit.
`tools/build_web.mjs` gzips it (~9.7 MiB), splits it into parts if still above 16 MiB,
and writes `index.wasm.parts.json`. `web/wasm_parts_loader.js` (injected via the preset's
`html/head_include`) wraps `fetch` so Godot's loader receives the original wasm.
Gzip is done by us because Pages serves unknown extensions uncompressed.
Needs `DecompressionStream` (Chrome 80+, Firefox 113+, Safari 16.4+).

## Controls

WASD / arrows move, mouse look, left click shoot, right click the gun's secondary mode (pistol: aim
down the sights, Stutzen: scope, Jagdflinte: both barrels), V melee (shovel), R reload, 1 / 2 / Q / mouse wheel
switch gun, Space jump, Shift sprint (forward only; the gun is lowered and cannot fire until 0.2 s after), C crouch (not Ctrl: Ctrl+W closes the browser tab),
E interact (hold at a window to board it up; press at a door or wall-buy to buy), Esc or P pause,
F3 debug overlay (FPS and position). While the overlay is on, F4 adds 1000 points (testing doors and
wall-buys).

F5, Ctrl/Cmd+R, F11 and F12 go to the browser: `web/browser_shortcuts.js` stops them before
Godot's web runtime, which otherwise calls `preventDefault()` on every key.

In browsers Esc never reaches the game; it releases pointer lock and the game pauses
because the lock is gone. Resume stays disabled for ~1 s since Chrome refuses an
immediate re-lock.

## Physics layers

1 `world`, 2 `player`, 3 `enemy`, 4 `player_blocker` (window openings: blocks players,
lets enemies through), 5 `hitbox` (enemy body/head hurtboxes; hitscan rays test `world` + `hitbox`).

## Map and zones

"Die Hütte" (section 4) is seven zone scenes in `scenes/zones/`, joined by buyable doors
(`ZoneDoor`, `scenes/zones/door.tscn`, placed in `main.tscn` under `World/Doors`): a loop
Stube – Küche – Skiraum – Seilbahn – Schuppen – Terrasse – Stube, plus the Matratzenlager upstairs off
the Stube gallery. The Küche scene owns the outer walls of the Küche + Lager wing (two storeys);
`lager.tscn` holds what is inside the Lager. Upper-floor windows are `window_upper.tscn` (bars and a
player blocker, no barricade). Windows facing the terrace deck set `outside_floor` so their navigation
link starts on the deck. Zone names and door costs are in
`data/zone_table.tres`; `ZoneMap` (node `Zones` in main) tracks which are open. Adjacency comes from
the doors, so a door's `zone_a` / `zone_b` is the only layout setting. A door costs what the zone behind
it costs, and opens by itself once both its zones are open (the loop's last door). Each window is a
`scenes/zones/window.tscn` instance (barricade, player blocker, bars, navigation link) on a hole in the
zone's wall CSG. `SpawnPoint` markers outside each zone's windows carry their zone id; the wave manager
only uses those whose zone is open or next to an open one. The Terrasse is open air: a fence with gaps
keeps players in and lets enemies through. Wall-buys (`WallBuy`, a chalk outline per gun) sell the
Jagdflinte (Stube) and the Stutzen (Skiraum), and once you carry the gun, ammo at `ammo_cost` (half price).
Two gun slots: a new gun goes in the free slot, otherwise it replaces the gun in hand.
All viewmodels hang under `WeaponMotion` (`Motion` under the `WeaponHolder`): walk bob, the sprint pose,
lag behind mouse turns, strafe lean, and lift/dip on jumps and landings, all turning around the grip.
Right click is `WeaponData.secondary` (section 6: every weapon gets its own fitting mode): `AIM` and
`SCOPE` zoom to `aim_fov`, tighten the spread and slow walking (no sprint); the scope shows
`ScopeOverlay` with a slow sway; `ALL_BARRELS` fires every loaded round in one blast. Quick shots add
bloom (`bloom_*` in `WeaponData`) to the spread, and the crosshair arms move out by the same amount.

Outside (`scenes/zones/exterior.tscn`) the hut stands on an Alm: the walkable snow is a flat CSG
disc (radius 37 m around the hut), and `AlmTerrain` generates the mountain beyond it at load
(flat-shaded, rock on steep faces, pines below the tree line and rocks above as two MultiMeshes,
no collision since nobody can get there). `MountainBackdrop` draws two rings of far peaks that
ignore fog and fade into the fog color at their foot, so the summits show through the storm.

## Navigation

One `NavigationRegion3D` (`World/Navigation` in main) with `scripts/zones/navmesh_baker.gd` bakes
the whole map, both floors, at load from the colliding CSG shapes (~25 ms on desktop), and rebakes from cached faces
whenever a door opens. Windows are one-way `NavigationLink3D`s; enemies hop through them when the
agent reaches a link. Enemies have no step climbing, so every level change is a ramp with side curbs,
`agent_max_climb` is 0.2 (two cells: a 35° ramp rises 0.14 per cell) and agents follow waypoints
within 0.3 m; looser, they cut corners onto ramps and get stuck.
`navigation/world/region_use_async_iterations` is off: with it on, Godot 4.7 never pushes
the runtime-baked mesh to the navigation server (paths come back empty).

## Waves, barricades, points

`scripts/waves/wave_manager.gd` runs the waves from `data/wave_table.tres` (section 8 formulas and the
enemy mix). Every window has a `Barricade` (`scripts/zones/barricade.gd`) with 6 boards: an enemy that
reaches the window's navigation link tears them off (`b

Ekekwecharles/coin-dash-arena.readme:
# Coin Dash Arena

A three.js arena game for [start.ng](https://start.ng). You play as your own start.ng character on a floating island: grab coins to keep the clock alive, dodge the spike balls, and see how long you last.

![Coin Dash Arena](cover.png)

## How to play

| Thing | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Coin | +1 point and +1.5 seconds |
| Time orb (blue) | +5 seconds |
| Spike ball | -5 seconds and a knockback |
| Dash (Space / Shift, or the Dash button on phones) | A quick burst that also lets you pass through danger |

Move with WASD or the arrow keys. On phones, use the joystick. Spike balls come faster and more often the longer you survive.

## How it uses start.ng

- **Logged-in players:** the game asks start.ng who is playing through the hidden connect page (`startng:whoami`, with an origin check). See `startng.js`.
- **Character styling:** `character.js` builds the 3D character from the player's `style`. Every field is used: `body`, `primaryColor`, `secondaryColor`, `skinColor`, `hairColor`, `hair` (short, afro, braids, bun, ponytail, dreads, bald), `hat` (none, cap, beanie, tophat, crown) and `accessory` (none, glasses, earrings, beard, scarf, backpack). Unknown values fall back to sensible defaults. Change your look on start.ng and come back to the tab: the character rebuilds itself.
- **Guests** get start.ng's guest look and a Sign in button.
- **Profile card** with the face picture, character name and `@account` at the top left.
- **Leaderboard** with two columns from `startng.json`: Coins and Survived time. Runs are saved for signed-in players.

## Files

```
index.html      page and UI
style.css       styles
game.js         scene, gameplay, camera, HUD
character.js    start.ng style -> three.js character
startng.js      connect-page helper (whoami, score, leaderboard, sign in)
startng.json    leaderboard columns
cover.png       1600x1000 card picture
vendor/         three.js r186 (bundled, no CDN needed)
fonts/          Bungee and Rubik (bundled, OFL)
```

No build step. start.ng serves these files as they are.

## Run it locally

ES modules need a local server (opening `index.html` as a file will not work):

```bash
npx serve .
# or
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Locally there is no start.ng player, so you play with the guest look. To preview a look, add it to the address:

```
http://localhost:8000/?name=Snow&style={"body":"male","hair":"dreads","hat":"cap","accessory":"glasses","primaryColor":"%23e74c3c"}
```

## Publish to start.ng

1. Push this folder to a **public** GitHub repo.
2. Check it:

   ```bash
   curl -X POST https://api.start.ng/games/check \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"repo_url":"https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/coin-dash-arena","name":"coin-dash-arena"}'
   ```

3. Publish it:

   ```bash
   curl -X POST https://api.start.ng/games/publish \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"repo_url":"https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/coin-dash-arena","name":"coin-dash-arena"}'
   ```

4. Open the `approve_url` from the reply, sign in, and approve. The game goes live at `https://coin-dash-arena.start.ng` (or whatever name you chose).

After that, every `git push` updates the game automatically.

# 🚀 銀河英語闖關

國小三～五年級的英文闖關小遊戲，結合「銀河單字卡」的翻卡學習與「NYT Crossword」的格子拼字。

## 玩法

- **過關動畫**：每關過關會先播一段約 3 秒、有音效的小動畫（`assets/video/`），可以按「跳過」。
  第 5、10、15 魔王關各有專屬的華麗動畫；一般關卡各一段，句型關卡重複使用這些動畫。
  動畫會依螢幕大小自動縮放（手機約佔螢幕寬度 92%，電腦最大 640px）。
- **單字星球（15 關）**
  1. 單字卡翻出來，系統念一次英文（點圖示或「再聽一次」可以重聽）
  2. 顯示中文和「諧音記憶」，例如 apple ≈ 阿婆，可按「聽諧音」
  3. 拼字：格子會隨機先給一個字母（位置不固定），點打散的字母泡泡會自動跳進下一個空格；點格子可以把字母退回
  4. 💡 提示會直接幫忙放一個正確字母；第 4 關起多 1 個干擾字母，第 9 關起多 2 個
- **魔王複習關（第 5、10、15 關）**：字母像俄羅斯方塊一樣慢慢掉下來，上方顯示中文，照順序點出單字的字母。
  - 沒點到的字母會堆在下面；點錯字母，底部會升起一層懲罰方塊，掉落速度也變快（每次 ×1.25）
  - 錯 4 次，懲罰方塊剛好碰到懲罰線而失敗；漏掉的字母堆起來也會提早碰線
  - 每拼完一個單字，掉下來的字母全部消掉（懲罰方塊留著）
  - 失敗時會列出這回合的單字，告訴小朋友要回第幾關複習，並有按鈕直接前往
  - 第 5 關從第 1～4 關的單字隨機出 5 題，第 10 關從第 6～9 關、第 15 關從第 11～14 關出題（速度稍快）
- **句型星球（9 關）**：念出問句（例如 How are you?），從三個選項中選出正確回答；
  選項的中文要按「💡 提示」才會出現
- 系統朗讀速度為 0.7（偏慢，方便小朋友聽清楚）
- 每關隨機抽 5 題、選項與字母順序也隨機，所以每次玩都不一樣
- 依錯誤次數拿 1～3 顆星，過關解鎖下一關
- 闖關進度會自動記在瀏覽器裡（localStorage），首頁有「繼續闖關」

## 怎麼開

直接用瀏覽器打開 `index.html` 就能玩（建議 Chrome 或 Edge，語音最完整）。

## 新增題目

編輯 `js/data.js`：

- 單字：`['apple', '蘋果', '阿婆', '🍎']` → 英文、中文、諧音、圖示
- 句型：`['How are you?', '你好嗎？', "I'm fine, thank you.", '我很好，謝謝。', [[錯誤選項, 中文], ...]]`
  - 錯誤選項放 3 個以上，每次會隨機挑 2 個

## 檔案

```
index.html     主頁面
css/style.css  樣式
js/data.js     題庫
js/game.js     遊戲邏輯
```

s-milly/super-bowl-defense.readme:
# Does Defense Win Championships?

A look at every Super Bowl team (Super Bowls I through LX, the 1966 through 2025 seasons) and how each one ranked in the regular season on offense and on defense.

**See the charts and write-up: https://s-milly.github.io/super-bowl-defense/**

Growing up, coaches would always say, "Defense wins championships." After a debate with my roommate about whether you'd rather have the best offense or the best defense in the league, I built this project to find out which has mattered more for winning a Super Bowl.

## What's here

| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | The chart page, served by GitHub Pages |
| `site/page.html` | Source for the chart page (charts are drawn with plain JavaScript and SVG, no libraries) |
| `data/super_bowl_rankings.csv` / `.json` | The dataset |
| `data/raw/` | Untouched game results the dataset is built from |
| `scripts/build_dataset.py` | Builds the dataset from the raw game results |
| `scripts/build_page.py` | Builds `index.html` from `site/page.html` and the dataset |

## The data

`data/super_bowl_rankings.csv` (also available as `.json`) has 120 rows, one for each Super Bowl winner and loser.

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `super_bowl` | Super Bowl number (I to LX; Super Bowl 50 is written as `50`) |
| `season` | Regular season the game capped (Super Bowl LX was played in February 2026 and capped the 2025 season) |
| `result` | `Winner` or `Loser` |
| `team`, `opponent` | Team names as they were that season (e.g. Baltimore Colts, Oakland Raiders) |
| `franchise` | Current franchise code, to group a franchise across moves |
| `sb_points_for`, `sb_points_against` | Super Bowl score |
| `league` | `NFL`, or `AFL` for AFL teams before the 1970 merger |
| `teams_in_league` | Teams the ranks are out of |
| `reg_wins`, `reg_losses`, `reg_ties`, `reg_games` | Regular-season record |
| `points_scored`, `points_allowed` | Regular-season totals |
| `points_scored_per_game`, `points_allowed_per_game` | Totals per game (useful for 9-game 1982 and 17-game seasons since 2021) |
| `offense_rank` | Rank in points scored (1 = most) |
| `defense_rank` | Rank in points allowed (1 = fewest) |
| `offense_percentile`, `defense_percentile` | Rank scaled to league size: 1.0 = best, 0.0 = worst. Lets a 9-team AFL and a 32-team NFL be compared |
| `better_unit` | Which unit ranked higher that season: `Defense`, `Offense` or `Even` |

## Method

- Offense and defense are measured by **scoring**: points scored and points allowed over the regular season. Playoff games are not included.
- Ranks are computed from every regular-season game score, not copied from a table. Tied teams share the better rank (two teams tied for 2nd are both 2nd, next is 4th).
- Before the 1970 merger the AFL and NFL played separate schedules, so for 1966 to 1969 each team is ranked within its own league.
- The 1982 (9 games) and 1987 (15 games, including replacement games) strike seasons count as played.

## Sources

- **1966 to 1998:** [FiveThirtyEight `nfl-elo-game`](https://github.com/fivethirtyeight/nfl-elo-game) game results.
- **1999 to 2025:** [nflverse `nfldata`](https://github.com/nflverse/nfldata) game results.

Raw files are kept unchanged in `data/raw/`.

## Checks

Each run of `scripts/build_dataset.py`:

1. Confirms all 60 Super Bowl scores in the data match the official results.
2. Compares the two sources on every team's points scored and allowed for the 22 seasons they overlap (1999 to 2020). They agree on all of them.

## Rebuild

```
python3 scripts/build_dataset.py
python3 scripts/build_page.py
```

Python 3, standard library only. To add a new season, refresh `data/raw/nflverse_games.csv` from nflverse and add the game to `SUPER_BOWLS` in the script.

## Possible next additions

- Yardage ranks (total yards gained and allowed), a second way to measure offense and defense.

# SKIRM: modern tactical skirmish (proof of concept)

A minimal, playable version of the whole loop in `todo.md`:

**Briefing → Insertion → Tactical (turn-based isometric hex) → Extraction → Debrief → next Briefing**

**Play in the browser:** https://smiley-gpu.github.io/SKIRM/. This is `index.html`, a standalone build where the rules engine and AI are ported to JavaScript. It needs no server, works on phones, and saves in browser storage.

**Alternative mode: Ops board** (`ops.html`). Missions resolve as a route of decision stages: pick an approach, pick a lead and supporters, spend gear, and roll dice with the odds shown. It replaces the hex battle and keeps the same briefing, classes and debrief. See `docs/abstract-mission-design.md`. The hex version is saved as tag `hex-v1`.

In the Java version below, the server owns the game and the browser only displays it.

## Run

Needs JDK 17+ only. There are no other dependencies and no build tool.

```powershell
.\run.ps1                # http://localhost:8080
.\run.ps1 -Seed 42       # reproducible campaign
.\run.ps1 -Test          # headless smoke test (bot plays 120 missions)
```
```sh
./run.sh  |  ./run.sh --seed 42  |  ./run.sh test
```
`pom.xml` is there only so IDEs can import the project.

## What's in the proof

| Stage | Implemented |
|---|---|
| **Briefing** | Generated operation: codename, area, time and weather (affect vision and accuracy), primary and secondary objectives, a vague threat estimate. Buy **Satellite** imagery (reveals terrain) and **Deep intel** (enemy count, positions, reinforcement timing). Pick a team of up to 4, weapon, armor and utility per operator from a limited **armory**, and insertion/extraction transport (helicopter / convoy / on foot), all paid from **requisition points**. |
| **Insertion** | Dice-driven complications by vehicle, scaled by darkness: hot LZ (alerted), hard landing or IED (injury), roadblock or bad terrain (fewer turns). |
| **Tactical** | Procedural 18×12 hex map: a walled compound, cover, brush, water and ruins, with a connectivity check. 4 AP per operator. Movement over terrain costs, line of sight, fog of war with last-seen markers, cover and concealment, itemised hit chances, frag grenades with friendly fire, medkits, an intel pickup that drops if its carrier dies. Stealth: enemies start unaware, and a silent kill on an unaware target doesn't raise the alarm. Enemy AI has two states (patrol, or engage by scoring positions). Reinforcements, and a turn limit tied to the extraction window. |
| **Extraction** | Hot extraction if alerted hostiles are near the zone. Operators left behind try to get out on foot, and some become MIA. |
| **Debrief** | Wounds (light, or heavy = sits out the next mission), KIA/MIA, XP leading to **promotions** (+accuracy), gear lost (dead operators' kit, used consumables), gear gained (captured weapons, caches), requisition reward, replacement recruits. |

## Architecture

```
src/main/java/skirm/
  core/      Hex (axial coords, distance, lines), Rng (seeded), Json, RuleException
  model/     Data and balance tables: Item, Terrain, Vehicle, Environment, Rank, Soldier, Armory, TacticalMap
  mission/   MissionGenerator, MapGenerator, Transit (insertion/extraction), Debrief
  tactical/  Battle (rules), Pathing (Dijkstra), Combat (hit math), EnemyAi, Unit, BattleEvent
  game/      Game (phase state machine facade), Campaign, StateView (view model + fog boundary)
  server/    GameServer (JDK HttpServer: JSON commands + static files)
web/
  index.html, style.css
  js/render.js   isometric hex renderer (pure view: scene in, pixels out)
  js/app.js      phase screens, input → commands, event playback
```

Main design decisions:

- **The server is authoritative.** The client sends *intents* (`MOVE unit→hex`, `SHOOT unit→target`). Every rule check lives in `Battle`, and a command is fully validated before anything changes.
- **Fog of war is enforced on the server.** `StateView` is the only place that serialises game state, and it never sends hidden enemies or unexplored terrain. Events are filtered when they are created. For example, a shot from an unseen enemy arrives without a `from` position. The smoke test checks that nothing leaks.
- **Deterministic.** All randomness comes from seeded `Rng` instances (campaign → mission → battle). The same seed plus the same commands gives the same game, which makes replays, bug reports and future multiplayer lockstep easy.
- **Results come back as events.** Each command returns a snapshot plus the events it caused. The client animates the events (paths, tracers, damage numbers) and renders the snapshot. Animation timing never affects game logic.
- **The client precomputes nothing.** The server sends each operator's reachable hexes (with path parents), valid targets with hit chance and modifier breakdown, and the available actions. The UI can't drift from the rules.
- **Balance lives in enums.** Weapons, armor, vehicles, intel and ranks are each one table, so tuning means editing one file.
- **Generated content is checked.** Maps are rejected and regenerated unless the insertion zone, objective and every extraction zone are connected.
- **The tests play the game.** `SmokeTest` plays 40 seeded campaigns × 3 missions through the public `Game` API. It checks invariants (no shared hexes, HP and AP bounds, units only on passable tiles), round-trips every snapshot through JSON, and checks that illegal commands are rejected.

### HTTP API
`GET /api/state` · `POST /api/campaign/new` · `POST /api/briefing/intel {intel}` ·
`POST /api/briefing/launch {team, loadouts, insertion, extraction}` · `POST /api/continue` ·
`POST /api/battle/action {unit, type, q?, r?, target?}` · `POST /api/battle/end-turn` · `POST /api/battle/abort`
Every call responds with `{phase, campaign, catalog, mission, battle|report|debrief, events}`. A rule violation returns `400 {error}`.

## Controls (tactical)
Click an operator to select it. Click a highlighted hex to mo
